scope.interpretation_summary: The Mobile Health Apps and Solutions Market encompasses applications and platforms designed to support health management, wellness, and medical services through mobile devices. Participants include app developers, health
scope.market_definition: The Mobile Health Apps and Solutions Market encompasses applications and platforms designed to support health management, wellness, and medical services through mobile devices. Participants include app developers, healthcare providers, and technology companies operating globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the creation and design of mobile health applications.
This layer focuses on integrating mobile health solutions with healthcare services.
This layer involves the management and analysis of health data collected through mobile applications.
This layer includes devices that complement mobile health apps by providing additional data.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Teladoc Health is a leading provider of virtual healthcare services, offering 24/7 access to a wide range of medical care, including primary care, mental health support, chronic disease management, and specialty services. The company caters to individuals, employers, and healthcare organizations, delivering comprehensive solutions designed to enhance patient outcomes and improve overall health management through innovative technology and personalized care.

# Connecting you to better health

Teladoc Health connects patients and care providers for medical care, mental health, chronic
condition management and more.

[ Get care now ][87]
[ No insurance needed ][88]

## The care you need, all in one place

[ A mother and daughter sitting on a couch, talking virtually to a healthcare provider.]

## 24/7 Care

Talk to a medical provider anytime, day or night. Whether it’s cold and flu symptoms, allergies or
infections, get the care you need from anywhere.

[Learn more][89]
[Learn more][90]
[ A man speaks virtually with a healthcare provider while holding a bottle of prescription
medication.]

## Primary Care

Stay on top of your health with board-certified providers supporting your checkups, preventative
care and prescriptions.

[Learn more][91]
[Learn more][92]
[ A man sits on his couch, holding a tablet.]

## Mental Health

Access a network of licensed therapists and psychiatrists to help navigate anxiety, stress,
depression and more.

[Teladoc Health Mental Health][93] [BetterHelp][94]
[Teladoc Health Mental Health][95]
[ A woman uses a medical device to take her blood pressure reading.]

## Condition Management

Get personalized coaching and connected devices for diabetes, weight and blood pressure management
built to last.

[Diabetes][100]

Consult with specialists to review your case and guide you through everything from minor concerns to
major diagnoses.

The company caters to individuals, employers, and healthcare organizations, delivering comprehensive solutions designed to enhance patient outcomes and improve overall health management through innovative technology and personalized care.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Epic Systems is a leading healthcare software company dedicated to improving patient care through innovative technology. Its core products include electronic health records (EHR) and AI-driven solutions that streamline clinical workflows, enhance communication, and support personalized care across various health systems. Targeting healthcare providers, Epic aims to create comprehensive medical records that facilitate better health outcomes for patients and future generations.

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Epic Systems is a leading healthcare software company dedicated to improving patient care through innovative technology. Its core products include electronic health records (EHR) and AI-driven solutions that streamline clinical workflows, enhance communication, and support personalized care across various health systems. Targeting healthcare providers, Epic aims to create comprehensive medical records that facilitate better health outcomes for patients and future generations.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Fitbit is a leading health and fitness technology company that specializes in wearable devices, including smartwatches and fitness trackers, designed to help users monitor their health and wellness. The company's core products, such as the Fitbit Sense 2 and Charge 6, offer personalized health insights and exercise tracking, catering to health-conscious consumers seeking to enhance their fitness journeys. Additionally, Fitbit integrates advanced technology, including AI features, to provide a seamless user experience across its devices.

## Frequently asked questions

#### How much does a doctor visit with HealthTap cost?

With insurance, you pay your copay based on your plan. We accept most plans, including Medicare.

Without insurance, online doctor visits are $129. You can become a HealthTap member and pay
$44/visit. Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership.

#### Do you accept health insurance?

Yes! We accept all major insurance plans—including Medicare Advantage and traditional Medicare. We
also accept HSA and FSA cards.

#### Do you accept Medicare?

Yes! We accept traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans. The price of the visit will be
your copay.

#### How much would an online doctor visit cost if I don't have insurance or if my deductible is
#### very high?

Without insurance, online doctor visits are $129. You can become a HealthTap member and pay
$44/visit. Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership.

#### Can I pay with my HSA and FSA card?

Yes, we accept HSA and FSA cards.

#### What is HealthTap membership and how much does it cost?

Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership. Members get unlimited texting
with their doctors, $44 primary care visits, $59 urgent care visits, and more.

#### What kind of technology or software do I need for an online doctor visit?

You can join with any device that has a stable internet connection—including your phone, tablet, or
laptop.

#### How can a HealthTap doctor help me?

Our primary care doctors are available for checkups, sudden illness, chronic conditions,
prescription refills, and more. They're here to listen and be a partner in your health journey for
years to come.

#### Does HealthTap give doctor's notes?

Yes. HealthTap doctors can provide notes to verify that you've seen a doctor about your overall
health or for a specific medical condition. These can be used for participation in sports programs,
for school programs, or given to your employer.

#### Are there any medications that HealthTap doctors cannot prescribe?

There are some medications that are always prescribed in-person and cannot be prescribed by
HealthTap doctors (or any other doctor seeing a patient online). These include opioids and other
controlled substances and some psychiatric and lifestyle drugs.

#### What credentials do HealthTap doctors have?

HealthTap doctors who conduct online doctor visits are based in the U.S. and have at least one
medical degree. Additionally, they are board-certified with an accredited American Board of Medical
Specialities (ABMS) or American Osteopathic Association (AOA) speciality board. They have a valid
and unrestricted license to practice in one or more U.S. states and no significant adverse
professional action against the doctor's medical license.

#### Should I download the HealthTap mobile app?

If you plan to use HealthTap on your smartphone or tablet, the HealthTap app makes it even easier to
take advantage of our features, including scheduling and conducting online doctor visits.

## Have a health question?

Create a free HealthTap account and ask any health question to our 90K+ doctors. No topic is too
embarrassing — it's 100% confidential. Most questions are answered the same day.

## Frequently asked questions

#### How much does a doctor visit with HealthTap cost?

With insurance, you pay your copay based on your plan. We accept most plans, including Medicare.

Without insurance, online doctor visits are $129. You can become a HealthTap member and pay
$44/visit. Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership.

#### Do you accept health insurance?

Yes! We accept all major insurance plans—including Medicare Advantage and traditional Medicare. We
also accept HSA and FSA cards.

#### Do you accept Medicare?

Yes! We accept traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans. The price of the visit will be
your copay.

#### How much would an online doctor visit cost if I don't have insurance or if my deductible is
#### very high?

Without insurance, online doctor visits are $129. You can become a HealthTap member and pay
$44/visit. Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership.

#### Can I pay with my HSA and FSA card?

Yes, we accept HSA and FSA cards.

#### What is HealthTap membership and how much does it cost?

Membership is $55 for three months and $180 for a yearly membership. Members get unlimited texting
with their doctors, $44 primary care visits, $59 urgent care visits, and more.

#### What kind of technology or software do I need for an online doctor visit?

You can join with any device that has a stable internet connection—including your phone, tablet, or
laptop.

#### How can a HealthTap doctor help me?

Our primary care doctors are available for checkups, sudden illness, chronic conditions,
prescription refills, and more. They're here to listen and be a partner in your health journey for
years to come.

#### Does HealthTap give doctor's notes?

Yes. HealthTap doctors can provide notes to verify that you've seen a doctor about your overall
health or for a specific medical condition. These can be used for participation in sports programs,
for school programs, or given to your employer.

#### Are there any medications that HealthTap doctors cannot prescribe?

There are some medications that are always prescribed in-person and cannot be prescribed by
HealthTap doctors (or any other doctor seeing a patient online). These include opioids and other
controlled substances and some psychiatric and lifestyle drugs.

#### What credentials do HealthTap doctors have?

HealthTap doctors who conduct online doctor visits are based in the U.S. and have at least one
medical degree. Additionally, they are board-certified with an accredited American Board of Medical
Specialities (ABMS) or American Osteopathic Association (AOA) speciality board. They have a valid
and unrestricted license to practice in one or more U.S. states and no significant adverse
professional action against the doctor's medical license.

#### Should I download the HealthTap mobile app?

If you plan to use HealthTap on your smartphone or tablet, the HealthTap app makes it even easier to
take advantage of our features, including scheduling and conducting online doctor visits.

## Have a health question?

Create a free HealthTap account and ask any health question to our 90K+ doctors. No topic is too
embarrassing — it's 100% confidential. Most questions are answered the same day.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: HealthTap is a virtual healthcare provider that offers accessible online primary and urgent care services, catering to individuals seeking affordable medical consultations with or without insurance. The platform features a membership model for ongoing care, allowing patients to book video visits with licensed doctors, manage chronic conditions, and receive online prescriptions. HealthTap serves a diverse range of patients, including those in rural communities and organizations looking for comprehensive healthcare solutions.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Medtronic plc is a global leader in medical technology, specializing in the development and manufacturing of innovative products and therapies that address a wide range of health conditions. The company offers advanced surgical technologies, cardiac rhythm management solutions, and various medical devices aimed at improving patient outcomes across diverse markets, including the Indian Subcontinent and other regions worldwide. Medtronic is committed to enhancing healthcare through its cutting-edge solutions and dedication to patient care.

Medtronic is committed to enhancing healthcare through its cutting-edge solutions and dedication to patient care.

relevant_companies.company_summary: MyFitnessPal is a health and fitness platform that offers a mobile app designed to help individuals track their diet and exercise, ultimately supporting them in achieving their fitness goals. The app features calorie tracking, exercise logging, community support, and personalized goal setting, catering to users who are looking to improve their overall health and wellness. While the app is free to use, it also offers an optional premium subscription for enhanced features.

company.description: MyFitnessPal is a mobile app and website that helps users track their diet and exercise to achieve their fitness goals.

products.name: MyFitnessPal App
products.description: A mobile application that allows users to track their food intake, exercise, and weight loss progress.
products.target_customers: Individuals looking to improve their health and fitness

relevant_companies.key_products: MyFitnessPal App
relevant_companies.polished_summary: MyFitnessPal is a health and fitness platform that offers a mobile app designed to help individuals track their diet and exercise, ultimately supporting them in achieving their fitness goals. The app features calorie tracking, exercise logging, community support, and personalized goal setting, catering to users who are looking to improve their overall health and wellness. While the app is free to use, it also offers an optional premium subscription for enhanced features.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Samsung Electronics Co. is a leading global technology company that specializes in the design and manufacturing of a wide range of consumer electronics and appliances. Its core product offerings include smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearables, televisions, and home appliances, catering to diverse markets and consumer needs. With a strong emphasis on innovation and advanced technology, Samsung aims to enhance everyday living through its cutting-edge products and smart solutions.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: WellDoc is a healthcare technology company that specializes in delivering clinically validated, AI-driven solutions for managing cardiometabolic conditions. Their platform transforms fragmented health data into actionable insights, offering personalized coaching and support for weight management, diabetes, hypertension, and other complex conditions. WellDoc partners with a diverse range of organizations, including health plans, employers, and healthcare providers, to enhance patient care and improve health outcomes through innovative technology.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Zocdoc is a healthcare technology company that simplifies the process of booking medical appointments by connecting patients with local doctors who accept their insurance. The platform offers a wide range of specialties, including primary care, dentistry, and mental health services, allowing users to browse providers, read verified reviews, and schedule appointments online. Targeting both patients seeking convenient healthcare access and healthcare providers looking to expand their patient base, Zocdoc enhances the overall patient experience in the medical appointment process.

The platform offers a wide range of specialties, including primary care, dentistry, and mental health services, allowing users to browse providers, read verified reviews, and schedule appointments online. Targeting both patients seeking convenient healthcare access and healthcare providers looking to expand their patient base, Zocdoc enhances the overall patient experience in the medical appointment process.

## What is Medical Device Registration?

[Medical Device Registration]

Medical Device Registration is a regulatory process that includes the submission of information and
documents to a government agency and regulatory authority. The process is done to obtain approval or
authorization to market and distribute medical devices in a particular jurisdiction. It is necessary
to ensure safety, efficacy, and quality standards.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Doxy.me is a leading telemedicine platform designed specifically for healthcare professionals, enabling them to connect with patients remotely through a HIPAA-compliant, user-friendly video interface. The platform offers features such as virtual waiting rooms, session documentation, and advanced video tools, catering to solo clinicians, small clinics, and health systems. With a commitment to security and privacy, Doxy.me has successfully facilitated over 12 billion minutes of telehealth video, making it a trusted choice for providers seeking efficient and effective remote care solutions.

# Our mission is to make *health* a daily practice.

Our journey began in Finland, and today, Oura is a part of the health journey for millions of users
in the US and around the world. Optimism is in our DNA - we see the opportunity for everyone to live
a balanced life. Oura is a product of meticulous craftsmanship, combining thoughtful design and
advanced technology to fit seamlessly into your life.

[Image of a woman looking out a car window]

10 years ago, we created a tool that seamlessly fits into your lifestyle, allowing you to
conveniently make your health your priority. Oura gives you unlimited access to accurate data and
information about your body, so that you can make more informed decisions, and lead a better,
healthier life. Our promise is that we will always meet you where you are– as you are– to help guide
you on your journey to discovering what’s within.

## The Oura *Difference*
* [Picture of a person holding a piece of fabric over their head]
* [Picture of a smiling person]
* [Picture of a person reading]

**5.5M+ Rings**sold worldwide.
**900+ Employees**across countries and continents.
**12+ Years**of research and product development.
**30+ PhDs**working across an in-house interdisciplinary science team.
[Picture of a person in a medical coat smiling]

#### Strict Data Protection

We are GDPR compliant and adhere to Europe's strictest data privacy laws. Data is de-identified and
protected.

[Picture of a person in a medical coat smiling]

#### Medical Advisory Board

Partnered with experts across the field to conduct research and advise in development of features.

[Learn More][6]

## Our Values

Not Me, We: Ubuntu

At Oura, we are one team. We each have a significant role to play–but we don’t win in silos. We know
in order to succeed, we must do it together. We embrace the diversity of our locations,
perspectives, and experiences to succeed as one company.

We Are Human First

Humanity is present in all that we do. We are passionate about building products that celebrate and
support uniqueness, inclusivity, and diversity. We meet people where they are, as they are, and
prioritize accessibility, by connecting with kindness and empathy.

Trust Matters

If we say we’ll do something, we do it. We always show up with integrity, and we prioritize privacy–
because it doesn’t just matter to us, but to you, as well. We do the right thing, even when no one
is looking. It is vital to us that our community and teammates know that they can rely on our
products, information, and perspective.

We Aim Higher

Good enough isn’t good enough—we want to be the best. We are bravely curious and optimistic about
our ideas for the future, and exploration is in our DNA. We act with courage, challenge the status
quo, take risks, and discover new. We execute with excellence.

We Find Solutions

We confront obstacles head-on. Even if we disagree, we share one common goal: solving the problem,
together.

Grace W.

Guava is like MyChart on steroids, and allows me to combine my medical info from multiple places (my PCP, specialists, Quest, even my fitbit). I’ve lost weight, found a healthy diet not just for how my body looks, but how it feels, identified issues in my sleep schedule, and helped make adjustments in my overall routine. With Guava, I’ve been able to work with my doctors to choose the right medication and therapy plans. It encourages me even when I feel defeated.
It has truly changed my life.

This is groundbreaking for someone who has spent years tracking symptoms in excel spreadsheets!

traveled to visit our far flung 4 children. Over the course of such visits, we have needed unexpected

medical history. Having become a member of Guava, it is comforting to know that full, accurate and

# Guava's mission is to empower people to understand and improve their health

To accomplish our mission, people need complete access and control over their health information,
and they need to be able to understand it simply to make informed decisions. We’re building a
best-in-class solution that is bridging the information gap.

Our goal is to build an enduring company that measurably improves both our own health and the health
of our fellow humans worldwide. This is reflected in our business model - we sell products directly
to you and to those trying to keep you healthy so that our incentives are directly aligned with your
health goals.

#### Our Principles

Think long term
Simplify
Provide positive value to humanity
Think holistically
[ See all of our principles ][21]

### The Guava Team

Our team has diverse backgrounds in health and technology. The founders, Alex and Dylan, are
engineers who built the personal assistant team at Graphiq, which was acquired by Amazon Alexa in
2017 to power Alexa's Q&A.

The team at Guava includes ex-Amazon employees who worked closely together for years, and executives
with decades of experience in healthcare, medicine, and privacy law. Some of our team members manage
chronic conditions themselves, ensuring we relentlessly build with the patient in mind.

# Leadership Team

Intelegain’s leadership spans countless years of experience in Management, Entrepreneurship,
Operations, Consulting, Technology Innovation, Software Implementation, and Business Strategy.
[Let's Talk][85]
Kapil Chopra
CEO

Kapil is a digital entreprenur having 25 years of experience in various roles such as CEO, founder,
investor and mentor. He has helped businesses grow and succeed in the digital space by providing
them with strategic guidance, marketing expertise, technology solutions and proactive leadership.

As CEO of Intelegain Technologies, he leads the vision and direction of the company across five
entities and locations: Mumbai, Dallas, Singapore, Sydney and London.

He also is an active mentor and investor in early stage start-ups through accelerators and
incubators. He has backed two online platforms that connect equity researchers and educators:
Researchbytes.com and Moneypot.in.

Over the years, he has been at the forefront in devising Go-To-Market strategies, Sales, innovation,
alliances, Entrepreneurship.

[more ][86]

Neeraj Gargi
Co-Founder & CTO

Neeraj is responsible for the overall IT operations at Intelegain with over 23 years of experience
in the IT industry. He has orchestrated Intelegain’s growth trajectory in Microsoft’s Dynamics 365
ecosystem across 5 World geographies.

As CTO, he has been overseeing business process driven technology improvements within the
organisation.

He has been mentoring and providing leadership to project managers, team leaders and grooming young
talent.

His acute business and technical acumen serves as the bridge and helps customers make disciplined
and proactive IT investment decisions.

[more ][87]

Shalini Chopra

Kapil Chopra

As CEO of Intelegain Technologies, he leads the vision and direction of the company across five

### [Mintti Vision][66]

Mintti Vision is a portable and easy-to-use device that monitors vital signs using advanced
sensors and proprietary algorithms. It measures temperature, blood pressure, blood glucose, SPO2,
respiratory rate, and heart rate, and syncs with a smartphone app for convenient monitoring and
data sharing with family members or doctors.
* [ [Digital-Stethoscope-2] ][67]

### [Digital Stethoscope Mintti Smartho-D2][68]

Mintti Smartho-D2 Electronic Stethoscope, is a digital smart stethoscope featured with powerful
amplification and active noise cancellation, which enables doctors and nurses to hear heart beat
and lung sounds with greater clarity.
* [ [ECG-Monitor-2] ][69]

### [ECG Patch, Mintti Heartbook][70]

Mintti Heartbook Wearable Dynamic ECG Monitor, is a lightweight and comfortable ambulatory
adhesive patch suitable for real-time monitoring cardiac monitoring at home or in any healthcare
environment.
* [ [Ear-Thermometer-2] ][71]

### [Ear Thermometer, Mintti Breeze][72]

Mintti Breeze infrared forehead and ear thermometer integrates with the latest built-in smart chip
and AI algorithm. It can measure temperature with the highest degree of medical accuracy for all
ages. Whether you are at home or work as a physician, Mintti Breeze allows you to monitor your
temperature easily.
* [ [Wearable-Thermometer-2] ][73]

### [Wearable Thermometer, Mintti Coola][74]

The Mintti Coola Continuous Monitoring Thermometer is a wearable smart medical device designed to
be placed under the armpit. It allows parents to monitor their child’s temperature continuously,
anytime and anywhere, especially when the child is feeling unwell or uncomfortable.

# About Us

[Minttihealth][59] > About Us

## Our Story

During our early days, when MinttiHealth was being established, we found that there were many people
who were unable to work due to certain chronic diseases, resulting in high medical expenses, which
not only reduced their quality of life, but also affected the quality of life for their families.
Though technology had made our lives easier, faster and better, there were some people who – for
various reasons – could still not receive benefits of modern healthcare technology. We dug deep into
our hearts & minds, to ask ourselves the meaning of our existence. We found that the love of family
and friends is the connection that holds our hearts together. We want the best care for them,
because we care about them. We are always there for them whenever they need us. And that’s when we
realized that the meaning of our existence was to develop technology products that enabled people to
easily provide care for their families.

We decided to provide digital solutions to address the challenges brought about by chronic diseases
and health care expenses. We wish to care for everyone who comes into contact with us. We hope to
convey the meaning of life through our solutions to our employees and their families, our dealers,
our users, and everyone we come into contact with. We express our care and love for them with our
products and solutions. We hope that we can help people become healthy regardless of race,
ethnicity, and religion, so that everyone can equally access the joy of life that health brings to
them. With this in mind, we decided to build MinttiHealth as a brand with a warm soul and unique
quality. We needed to know what users want before they do, and we have been engaged in the effort to
make better products from all aspects such as materials, ergonomics, aesthetics, etc. Our aim to
ensure that our users can enjoy basic medical services even at home as long as they have our
products in hand.

### [Mintti Vision][66]

Mintti Vision is a portable and easy-to-use device that monitors vital signs using advanced
sensors and proprietary algorithms. It measures temperature, blood pressure, blood glucose, SPO2,
respiratory rate, and heart rate, and syncs with a smartphone app for convenient monitoring and
data sharing with family members or doctors.
* [ [Digital-Stethoscope-2] ][67]

### [Digital Stethoscope Mintti Smartho-D2][68]

Mintti Smartho-D2 Electronic Stethoscope, is a digital smart stethoscope featured with powerful
amplification and active noise cancellation, which enables doctors and nurses to hear heart beat
and lung sounds with greater clarity.
* [ [ECG-Monitor-2] ][69]

### [ECG Patch, Mintti Heartbook][70]

Mintti Heartbook Wearable Dynamic ECG Monitor, is a lightweight and comfortable ambulatory
adhesive patch suitable for real-time monitoring cardiac monitoring at home or in any healthcare
environment.
* [ [Ear-Thermometer-2] ][71]

### [Ear Thermometer, Mintti Breeze][72]

Mintti Breeze infrared forehead and ear thermometer integrates with the latest built-in smart chip
and AI algorithm. It can measure temperature with the highest degree of medical accuracy for all
ages. Whether you are at home or work as a physician, Mintti Breeze allows you to monitor your
temperature easily.
* [ [Wearable-Thermometer-2] ][73]

### [Wearable Thermometer, Mintti Coola][74]

The Mintti Coola Continuous Monitoring Thermometer is a wearable smart medical device designed to
be placed under the armpit. It allows parents to monitor their child’s temperature continuously,
anytime and anywhere, especially when the child is feeling unwell or uncomfortable.

# Wearable Thermometer, Mintti Coola

The Mintti Coola Continuous Monitoring Thermometer is a wearable smart medical device designed to be
placed under the armpit. It allows parents to monitor their child’s temperature continuously,
anytime and anywhere, especially when the child is feeling unwell or uncomfortable.

[Request a Demo][72]
[Download][73]
[How to Operate][74]
Category: [Wearable Thermometer][75]
* [ Description ][76]
* [ Faq ][77]
* [ Download ][78]

## Description

Mintti Coola is the first digital thermometer patch featuring a graphene probe, which provides
measuring results 5 times faster than the copper probe. It can display an accurate reading to
parents within one minute and upload the reading to the Cloud through an Android or iOS APP from a
mobile device.

Through remote monitoring, Mintti Coola can intelligently track your children’s temperature with a
temperature curve and send helpful alerts to your mobile devices when the temperature reaches a
certain point set by the parents.

Without the need to interrupt the patient’s or children’s daily activities or sleep, Mintti Coola
can give you peace of mind with easily set medication reminders and continuous data, which can be an
important guide to patient care.

****Fast and Precise****

The graphene sensing probe used in Mintti Coola Smart Thermometer is 5 times faster than the copper
probe, with a measurement precision of ±0.1°C.

****Audible Alerts for Rising Temperature****

It continuously monitors temperature for up to 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and gives alerts when
the temperature rises abnormally.

****Non-invasive and Comfortable****

Mintti Coola is easily applied to patients with a gentle 3M medical-level double-sided material,
providing comfort during wear and easy removal.

****Intelligent and Customizable****

The Mintti Coola APP is compatible with different phones, offering real-time temperature readings,
temperature record history, customizable automatic notifications, and medication reminders.

## Faq

**1. Q: What functions are included in Mintti Coola APP?**
A: Temperature record history, temperature alarm setting, medication reminder.

**2. Q: Has Mintti Coola got any medical device approval?**
A: Mintti Coola is CE-certificated and is going through FDA medical device process as well.

**3. Q: Where is the best measuring position? How long do you need to measure with the Mintti
Coola?**
A: Mintti Coola shall be placed under the armpit. The minimum measurement time is 2 minutes, though
we suggest 10 minutes at least.

**4. Q: How accurate is Mintti Coola Continuous Monitoring Thermometer?**
A: Mintti Coola uses graphene probe, which is by far the thinnest and the hardest nano material.
Quick in heat conduction, it is often used as a thinner, faster conducted electronic component or
transistor of the new generation.
Here is the accuracy range.
* lower than 35.3 ℃ ±0.3℃；
* 35.3℃~36.9 ℃ ±0.2℃；
* 37.0℃~39.0℃ ±0.1℃；
* 39.1℃~41.0℃ ±0.2℃；
* Higher than 41.0℃ ±0.3℃。

**5. Q: How long can Mintti Coola be used for once?**
A: The new CR2016 battery can keep 6 months stand-by and 7 days continuous monitoring.

**6. Q: Can I switch between Fahrenheit °F and Celsius °C (Centigrade)?**
A: Yes, you can switch easily by setting your measurement units.

# Ear Thermometer, Mintti Breeze

Mintti Breeze infrared forehead and ear thermometer integrates with the latest built-in smart chip
and AI algorithm. It can measure temperature with the highest degree of medical accuracy for all
ages. Whether you are at home or work as a physician, Mintti Breeze allows you to monitor your
temperature easily.

## Description

To meet the users’ different needs and circumstances, Mintti Breeze can measure temperatures with
contact or contact-free methods. The contact-free method with the silent mode is ideal for infants
without waking them up while taking the temperature. You can also easily switch to ear reading to
ensure more accurate reading on older children and adults.

With the world’s first front-facing LED display, you don’t have to turn Mintti Breeze over to check
the reading as the display is right in front of you. It can make taking temperature so convenient.
Self-measuring becomes more comfortable and much easier.

**Fast & Accurate Measuring**

Combining the cutting-edge sensor with a smart chip and optimized AI algorithms, Mintti Breeze can
prevent false reading and offer the highest degree of accuracy within one second.

**Intelligent Performance &User Friendly**

It features with a built-in fever alarm to prevent guesswork and an auto shutdown for power saving.
With one-touch operation, it is simple to use even for children and elderly people.

**Easy-to-Read ****Front Facing LED Display**

With the world’s first front-facing display, it makes self-measuring so easy. There is no need to
turn it over to check the temperature as it is right in front of you.

**More Durable with Long-lasting Battery**

The long-lasting battery with approximately 3000 readings per year and 200 minutes for constant use
makes it more reliable and durable to use.

**Preventing Infection with ****the Contact-free Forehead Measuring Mode**

With the contact-free forehead measuring mode, it can prevent infection and cross-contamination and
minimize the disease from spreading among users.

**Ergonomic and Elegant Patented Design**

The ergonomic design of Mintti Breeze makes taking temperature more comfortable and much easier.
With a unique upright patented design, it looks more like an artwork rather than a thermometer.

## Faq

it is with the highest degree of medical accuracy.

A: Mintti Breeze is a dual-functional thermometer. For the forehead measuring mode, it is a
non-contact thermometer. For the ear measuring mode, it is a contact-free one.

**4. Q: What is the measuring distance for the forehead non-contact mode of Mintti Breeze?**
A: The measuring distance is within 3cm from the forehead.

**5. Q: What are the advantages of Mintti Breeze?**
A: Mintti Breeze has a unique patented design, dual measuring modes (both forehead and ear), an
extra-large and bright LED display and a muted mode.

**6: Q: Can I switch between Fahrenheit °F and Celsius °C (Centigrade)?**
A: Yes, you can switch easily by setting your measurement units.

# ECG Patch, Mintti Heartbook

Mintti Heartbook Wearable Dynamic ECG Monitor, is a lightweight and comfortable ambulatory adhesive
patch suitable for real-time monitoring cardiac monitoring at home or in any healthcare environment.

[Request a Demo][71]
[Download][72]
[How to Operate][73]
Category: [ECG Patch][74]
* [ Description ][75]
* [ Faq ][76]
* [ Download ][77]

## Description

With one of the most effective methods of cardiac monitoring, Mintti Heartbook can detect
arrhythmia, abnormal heart rate or rhythm, providing complete waveform annotations, accurate
parameters extraction, smart abnormality lock-up and rapid diseases information entry.

As an intelligent medical-grade wearable ECG monitor, Mintti Heartbook can be used in after-surgery
tracking (health management) for cardiac patients and continuous monitoring for the elderly, extreme
sports enthusiasts, people under high pressure, or the sub-healthy people as well.

**Lightweight and Antibacterial**

Mintti Heartbook is lightweight and ultra-thin, comfortable with unique antibacterial plastic
material for medical use.

**Customizable Algorithm for Online Diagnosis**

Online doctor consultation builds up the patient’s exclusive cardiovascular disease diagnosis.

**Thorough Review of Heart Health**

Mintti Heartbook makes a continuous ECG record and also monitors respiratory rate, activity
tracking, heart rate, heart rate variability which provides a thorough review of your health
condition.

**Real-time Emergency Alert**

With a Multi-parameter cardiac telemetry system, Mintti Heartbook can have a real-time alert on
APB, VPB, long interval, tachycardia and bradycardia.

**Intelligent and Accurate**

With complete waveform annotations, accurate parameters extraction, smart abnormality lock-up, and
rapid diseases information entry, Mintti Heartbook provides convenient and instant diagnosis for
users by simple operation.

**Efficient and Timely**

By using doctor’s limited time to complete the analysis in a timely manner, Mintti Heartbook can
save averagely 23 hours to get access to medical reports,compared with hospital routine Dynamic ECG
Recorder (Holter).

## Faq

**1. Q: Who should use Mintti Heartbook? **
A: It is ideal for physicians, healthcare professionals, patients, or health-conscious individuals
to detect and monitor arrhythmia, abnormal heart rate or rhythm. It can also be used as a response
to treatment of cardiac disorders.

2. Q: Can Mintti Heartbook be used with a pacemaker?
A: If you have a pacemaker or other implanted device, we recommend you to talk to your doctor before
using Mintti Heartbook.

**3. Q: Is Mintti Heartbook water resistant?**
A: Yes, Mintti Heartbook is water resistant. However, Mintti Heartbook is not intended to use during
activities if the device will be completely submerged in water.

**4. Q: Is Mintti Heartbook able to check HRV?**
A: Yes, Mintti Heartbook can check HRV.

**5. Q: When does the device begin measuring? Is it as soon as the device is placed on body or is
there a command to be sent?**
A: A command will be sent to start measuring by software.

**6. Q: How can I read a MAC address? **
A: The mac address can be obtained by scanning the host BLE.

**7. Q: What is the real-time emergency alert by Mintti Heartbook?**
A: With a built-in body posture sensor, Mintti Heartbook can send SMS alerts to the owner or
guardian’s devices when a tumble occurs. It can also send real-time alerts about APB, VPB, long
interval, tachycardia and bradycardia.

**8. Q: What’s the best record duration?**
A: Mintti Heartbook is an all-weather ECG device enabling a long-term heart rate recording.
Generally, the longer you use the device, the more accurate ECG recording you will get. A continuous
measurement should be no less than 60 minutes every day and at least once a week with a measurement
more than 10 hours throughout the day are recommended.

# Digital Stethoscope Mintti Smartho-D2

Mintti Smartho-D2 Electronic Stethoscope, is a digital smart stethoscope featured with powerful
amplification and active noise cancellation, which enables doctors and nurses to hear heart beat and
lung sounds with greater clarity.

[Request a Demo][70]
[Download][71]
[How to Operate][72]
Category: [Digital Stethoscope][73]
* [ Description ][74]
* [ Faq ][75]
* [ Download ][76]

## Description

Mintti Electronic Stethoscope can be paired with a free app to see the phonocardiogram in real-time
and record auscultation signal data for future playback. The data will be securely saved and only
shared for non-commercial purpose.

Without any off-the-shelf software, the Smartho-D2 incorporates an embedded software which controls
all features of the product, including sound capture, digital signal processing, volume control,
OLED display and Bluetooth function.

With its smart hardware, cloud storage and live stream, Mintti Smartho-D2 can be used in
telemedicine, education, research and electronic medical records (EMR) for cardiopulmonary diseases
and physical assessment.

**Cloud Storage**

Cloud storage for users. Record and share sounds via your iPhone, iPad, Android or Mac/PC. Complete
recording and improve diagnosis accuracy.

**Visual Diagnosis**

Real-time audio curve displays with a function of recording auscultation signal data which can be
viewed and played back at any time.

**Intelligence and Powerful**

The smart Mintti Electronic Stethoscope integrates weak signal detection with acoustic signal
analysis and artificial intelligent in one device to detect potential heart diseases.

**Simple but Efficient **

It is lightweight and easy to carry, making them convenient for medical professionals who need to
move between patients quickly. Cardiopulmonary sounds and other data will be analyzed for heart
murmurs, atrial fibrillation and other parameters indicative of heart and lung diseases.

## Faq

**1. Q:Is Mintti Smartho-D2 Electronic Stethoscope FDA-certificated?**
A: Yes. Smartho-D2 has been FDA certificated for a Class II diagnostic device.

**2.Q: Which device can I use with the Smartho-D2 mobile kit?**
A: You can use Smartho-D2 with any mobile device, such as smartphone, tablet, or laptop.

**3.Q: What is the amplification rate of the Smartho-D2 ?**
A: Amplification on the Smartho-D2 is more than 100X that of a traditional stethoscope.

**4. Q: What is the difference between the bell mode and the diaphragm mode of the Mintti
Stethoscope? **
A: With the bell mode of Mintti Stethoscope, you can hear heart beat sound more clearly whereas you
can hear lung sound more clearly with diaphragm mode.

**5. Q: What is the difference between listening to heart beat sound and lung sound when plugs in a
headphone and connects to a mobile phone? **
A:When you listen to heart beat sound or lung sound directly with the stethoscope, you may not be
able to hear the sounds clearly becasue the signal on the device is the original signal which is
weak and not very clear. However, when you listen to the sound with our APP, you can hear the sound
more clearly as the data is uploaed to a mobile phone via Bluetooth with signal processing
algorithm.

# Mintti Vision

Mintti Vision is a portable and easy-to-use device that monitors vital signs using advanced sensors
and proprietary algorithms. It measures temperature, blood pressure, blood glucose, SPO2,
respiratory rate, and heart rate, and syncs with a smartphone app for convenient monitoring and data
sharing with family members or doctors.

## Description

Syncing with a smartphone APP of Mintti Vision, it makes health monitoring simple and comfortable.
You can share your personal health data with your family members or directly with your doctor
without even leaving home.

****Multifunctional, 6 in 1 Health Tracking****

Mintti Vision Health Tracker is a multifunctional 6 in 1 health monitoring device. It can measure,
store and share the user’s data of blood pressure, oxygen saturation, heart rate, temperature,
respiratory rate and blood glucose.

****Simple and Convenient****

Mintti Vision is compact enough to fit in your pocket or handbag, making health tracking extremely
easy and convenient. You can read your vital signs anytime and anywhere.

****Best Care at Lower Cost ****

Mintti Vision enables organizations to deliver the highest quality of care without having to invest
much in extra staff, resources, or training.

****Data Security and Privacy****

Mintti Vision keeps each and every user’s data safe, secure and private with its encrypted
multi-user feature which makes it the perfect fit for the family. Every family member can track
their health condition while keeping their privacy separate.

## Faq

** 1. Q: How long does Mintti Vision take to charge an empty battery to full?
**A: Around 3-4 hours from empty to 100% full.

**2. Q: How long will Mintti Vision last on a full charge?**
A: Around 20 days for standby time, 200-300 test times for blood pressure, oximetry and 2000-3000
times for body temperature.

**3. Q: Does Mintti Vision or the related APP tell you when the battery is low?**
A: Yes. The user can check the battery on the APP. When the battery is low, you will receive a low
battery alert.

**4. Q: How do you clean the cuff? Is it washable?**
A: Yes, the cuff can be washed by hand. Just use water or some alcohol-based detergent when
necessary.

**5. Q: Is Mintti Vision a subscription service or an additional feature that I need to pay?**
A: No, the usage of service provided by Mintti Vision is free.

**6. Q: Is the battery rechargeable? If so, does Mintti Vision come with a recharging cord?**
A: Yes, Mintti Vision uses Lithium battery with each pack containing one convenient USB recharging
cord.

**7. Q: Will all records get wiped out if I forget to charge the battery when it runs out?**
A: No. The data will be saved on the cloud and your smartphone.

**8. Q: As for blood glucose, does it only work with the stick from Mintti Vision? **
A: Yes, it only works with sticks from Mintti Vision.

**9. Q: Where can I download the APP of Mintti Vision?**
A: You can search “Healthmonitor” from Google Play.

**10. Q: Is it necessary to wrap the cuff tightly when using Mintti Vision for blood pressure
measuring?**
A: Loosen or tighten the cuff until you feel comfortable with it. There is no need to wrap it very
tightly.

**11. Q: Is there any problem with measuring temperature in places other than the forehead (ears)?**
A: Yes, for temperature measuring, Mintti Vision can only be used as a forehead thermometer. So if
you measure your temperature in other places other than forehead, the result will not be accurate.

**12. Q: Is Mintti Vision waterproof?**
A: Yes, Mintti Vision is a waterproof health monitor rated IP22, which won’t be damaged by
vertically dripping water.

higher levels of personalization and engagement.
* [Mintti Vision helps provide personalized health monitoring][67]

## The COVID has resulted in a broader adoption of telehealth among hospitals, health systems and
## providers

Telehealth can improve monitoring, timeliness, and communications within the healthcare system,
avoid unnecessary visits to emergency rooms or urgent care centers for healthcare issues that can be
solved over video or phone, and help individuals avoid COVID-19 infection.

✔ get timely expert reports and early health warnings;

### Chronic Care

## How to help patients have control over their own health care?

Help people living with chronic conditions monitor their health at home by providing high-quality
personalized support with medical devices to manage their chronic illnesses, such as diabetes,
hypertension, heart diseases etc.
* [Connected Device for Diabetes][66]
* [Track Body Temperature][67]
* [Improve Heart Health][68]

## Want to have a broad overview of patients’ health?

With Mintti Vision, healthcare providers can:

✔ assess patients’ well being;

✔ prevent misdiagnosis;

✔ detect patients’ underlying health problems;

✔ help motivate patients’ lifestyle changes.
* [Connected Medical Devices for Telemedicine Solutions][69]

## Why patients would be healthier and happier by remote monitoring?

With Mintti Vision, patients can：

✔ actively participate in their health care;

✔ monitor their health vitals and send that information back to
health care providers at any time;

✔ cut down care costs and increase confidence in test results;

✔ recover in the comfort of home.
* [Vital Signs Monitoring][70]

## Improve confidence for self-management of medical condition in patients with chronic illnesses

✔ reduce cost and decrease the chances of
readmission to the hospitals;

✔ recover from their home, an environment that puts them
at ease where they’re surrounded by their loved ones;

✔ invite family members to join in lifestyle changes to
ease a chronic condition;

✔ live independently at home, continue doing everyday tasks
like walking, bathing, and even preparing for meals.
* [Blood Pressure Measurement][71]
* [Heart Rate Monitoring][72]

accelerate a new era of connected remote care for patients who can: ✔ get timely expert reports and

### Respiratory Health

## Why is the degree of diagnostic accuracy dependence on chest auscultation decreasing?

Is it possible to develop a standardized system to analyze respiratory sounds accurately to overcome
the subjectivity of auscultation? Is it possible to examine patients in hard-to-reach area?

## Artificial Intelligence Algorithm-Assisted Auscultation is a promising new way to help detect
## heart disease.

The AI-powered digital stethoscope Mintti Smartho-D2 in telemedicine can help identify pediatric
pneumonia and structural heart disease with great accuracy whether the patient is in their own home,
a clinic, or a virtual health center in rural areas.

## For healthcare providers, a digital stethoscope Mintti Smartho-D2 in telemedicine can：

✔ help make a proper diagnosis during a tele-consultation
with a patient in a rural clinic;

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is RingConn Gen 3 Gift Card?
RingConn Gen 3 Gift Card is a premium gifting package designed for a seamless smart ring gifting
experience.
Each package includes:
- A RingConn sizing kit
- A physical redemption card with a unique QR code

The recipient can confirm their ring size first, then redeem their RingConn Gen 3 online.

Does this package include the RingConn Gen 3 ring?
Not immediately.
This package includes a sizing kit and a redemption card.
The RingConn Gen 3 ring is redeemed separately after the recipient confirms their size.

How does redemption work?
Use the included sizing kit to find the best fit
1. Scan the QR code on the redemption card
2. Select preferred color and ring size
3. Submit shipping information
4. Receive RingConn Gen 3 after redemption is completed

Which product can be redeemed?
Each redemption card is valid for one RingConn Gen 3 smart ring.
To learn more about RingConn Gen 3 features, health tracking, battery life, and specifications,
please visit the Gen 3 [here][40] .

Why is the sizing kit included?
RingConn Gen 3 uses a proprietary sizing system that differs from other RingConn rings, standard
jewelry rings, and other smart ring brands. The included sizing kit helps ensure a precise fit
before redemption, reducing guesswork and making the gifting experience simpler, more convenient,
and more accurate.

How long is the redemption card valid?
The redemption card is valid for 5 years from the date of purchase.
For the best product availability and experience, we recommend redeeming within 12 months.

Can the redemption card be used more than once?
No.
Each redemption card is valid for one-time use only and can be redeemed for a single RingConn Gen 3
device.

Can the redemption card be exchanged for cash?
No.
Redemption cards:
- Cannot be redeemed for cash
- Cannot be reloaded or resold
- Cannot be transferred for commercial use

Can the recipient choose color and size?
Yes.
The recipient can select their preferred available color and confirmed ring size during redemption.
Available options may vary by region and inventory availability.

When will my order ship?
Gift card orders are typically processed within 1–3 business days.
Shipping timelines may vary depending on destination and local carrier conditions.

When will the RingConn Gen 3 ring ship?
The RingConn Gen 3 ring ships after redemption is completed and ring size is confirmed.
Shipping timelines may vary based on inventory availability and fulfillment region.

What if the redemption card is lost?
Please treat the redemption card like cash.
Lost, stolen, damaged, or unauthorized-used cards may not be replaceable.
If you need assistance, please contact [ RingConn Support][41] with your order information.

## FAQ

### How to install?

Step 1:
Locate the Marking onthe ring Protector.

Step 2:
Align the Marking with the Ring's bottom, and cover the Protecter.

### Maintenance Tips

1. Due to the nature of the material, it's normal for the ring protector's surface to yellow over
time, especially with prolonged contact with sweat and other acidic or alkaline substances.
2. Avoid contact with sharp objects during use to prevent breakage, scratches, or other damage.
3. If the surface or interior becomes dirty or dusty, please use hand soap or mild detergent to
clean and air dry before use.
4. Avoid contact with cosmetics such as lipstick and hand cream. If contact occurs, please wash it
off promptly.

At SISGAIN, we combine advanced technologies with real-world business understanding to deliver scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions. As a leading digital transformation company and AI app development company, we help organizations adopt the right technologies—not just the latest ones—to drive measurable results.

Artificial Intelligence

AI delivers real value when it aligns with your business processes. We implement intelligent systems that enhance decision-making, automate operations, and improve efficiency at scale—helping organizations move from manual workflows to intelligent ecosystems.

Generative AI

Generative AI becomes powerful when integrated into daily operations. We embed Gen AI into business systems, customer interactions, and internal workflows—ensuring enterprise-grade security, governance, and practical usability.

Agentic AI

We help forward-thinking organizations adopt autonomous AI systems that can execute tasks across workflows. Our approach ensures these AI agents remain transparent, controlled, and aligned with business objectives.

Machine Learning

As a trusted custom software development company, we build machine learning models designed for stability and long-term performance—adapting continuously to changing data, user behavior, and business environments.

Blockchain

We implement blockchain where trust, transparency, and traceability are critical—building secure, decentralized systems for multi-party environments and digital transactions.

Computer Vision

We develop computer vision solutions that automate inspection, monitoring, and analysis in real-time environments—reducing errors, improving speed, and enhancing operational accuracy.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Modern cloud systems require more than migration. As an experienced IT solutions company, we design cloud-native architectures that are secure, scalable, and optimized for long-term performance and cost efficiency.

Data Science & Analytics

We transform raw data into actionable insights by building reliable data ecosystems. Our solutions empower organizations to make informed decisions without complexity or dependency on fragmented systems.

Cybersecurity

Security is embedded into everything we build. From architecture to deployment, our systems are designed to meet enterprise-level compliance, mitigate risks, and ensure continuous protection against evolving threats.

IoT (Internet of Things)

We connect physical systems with digital intelligence, enabling businesses to monitor, control, and optimize operations in real time through scalable IoT ecosystems.

AR/VR

Our immersive solutions are built to solve real business challenges—enhancing training, enabling remote collaboration, and improving simulation experiences across industries.

into patient flow, resource utilization, and hospital performance.

## The Best Patient Portal Solution Features
## We Design and Build for You

Why develop patient portal software? A custom patient portal solution provides your clients and
patients with a secure platform to interact with your healthcare organization and physicians without
requiring human administrators for each request. Our custom patient portal development team can help
you implement a range of healthcare portal technologies, such as AI-powered assistants, and

### Patient Authorized Access

It’s important to implement a range of user access options in patient portals to:
* Prevent unauthorized access via personal login/password for each patient and multi-factor
authorization for medical data enhanced security.
* Add biometric patient authorization options like fingerprint and voice recognition as
alternatives.
* Implement voice command execution and other helpful options for alternatively-abled patients.

### Scheduling Doctor’s Appointments

This is one of the most important patient portal features, allowing patients to plan their
appointments with medical specialists:
* View physician schedules and calendars to identify unoccupied time slots from a weekly or monthly
perspective.
* Book empty time slots and schedule appointments with required medical specialists remotely,
without calling the medical center front desk.
* Get automatic confirmations, notifications, and reminders ahead of medical appointments, so
patients and physicians will never miss one.

### Convenient Interfaces for Patients

User-friendly patient portals must be supportive of a wide spectrum of physical and cognitive
capabilities found among different patient groups:
* Configurable interfaces for differently-abled patients along with simplified dialogs with an
augmented option-selection process.
* Large titles and buttons for elderly people or people with challenged vision; voice or visual tips
can be added for elderly users and other patient categories with a gap in tech skills.
* Optimized software dialogs that allow patients to achieve their goals in a minimized cascade of
steps to avoid confusion.

### Patient Analytics, Profiles, and Dashboards

Build patient portals with the ability to access personal profiles, personalized settings,
analytical features, and data visualizations:
* Collect and visualize data from medical IoT devices and wellness wearables such as fitness
trackers and professional-grade adhesive sensors.
* Aggregate data from various sources and represent it through custom patient dashboards and charts:
individualized patient stats, healthcare service efficiency reports, insurance cost information,
and more.
* Share information and files with healthcare providers and medical specialists within integrated
patient portal solutions, like DICOM images and diagnostic conclusions from third-party care
providers.

### Medical Record Integration

the EHR/EMR systems of your choice:

professionals.

## FAQ

Get the answer you need about AppMaster Professional Services.

[FAQ icon]How much do Professional Services cost?
Many factors affect the cost: the required functionality, the number of applications and resources,
whether you need e-commerce or other 3rd party integrations, etc. We’ll do our best to find the best
option for your business and your budget and provide you with a price and payment plan in advance.
[FAQ icon]How can I get Professional services from the AppMaster team?
There are several ways to order professional app development from the AppMaster team: you can book a
demo of the platform and discuss details of your project during the demonstration, fill in the form
here with a description of your project so our specialists can contact you, or contact us at
[[email protected]][57].
[FAQ icon]What kind of software could be built with AppMaster?
You can develop server applications with the source code generated on GoLang, web apps (SPA) based
on the Vue2 framework, and native Android and iOS applications on Kotlin and Swift UI. All
applications are built without a single line of code. A powerful mechanism to work with the business
processes allows developing business applications of any complexity. Visual drag-n-drop builders
make development faster and more efficient.
[FAQ icon]Where can I deploy my applications?
All applications are published with one click. You can choose to publish with AppMaster Cloud or any
other cloud platform, for example, AWS, GCS, Azure, or even use your own cloud server. After

[FAQ icon]What frameworks do you use to create native no-code applications?
Applications are written in SwiftUI for iOS, and Kotlin/JetPack Compose for Android. We are using a
server-driven UI. The interface is created according to the principle similar to the creation of
pages on the Internet: elements are positioned using flexbox, all parameters such as margin,
padding, and many others are set for them. At the same time, the applications are entirely native.
You can use all hardware features: camera, Bluetooth, wi-fi, and various specific features, for
example, special gestures for control.
[FAQ icon]What triggers, actions and conditions are available in the mobile application editor?
AppMaster.io supports several triggers and actions: offer level, screen level, widget level, and
module level. All triggers and actions are developed using mobile business processes. They are
implemented as simple blocks with which you can create screen navigation, send notifications to
mail, and fully manage the properties of widgets/components. In addition, AppMaster.io has such
blocks of business processes: type conversion, mathematical operations, string processing, working
with arrays, local and global variables, loops, and checking if-else conditions. All this helps
carry out the entire processing of many cases on the client-side without the server's participation.
[FAQ icon]How long does it take to publish an application in the app store and play market?
The time of publication is determined by its verification. It depends not on AppMaster.io, but the
Apple Store and Play Market moderators. But we made sure to speed up the process of publishing
updates. Applications made on AppMaster.io need only be published once, and after verification and
publication, AppMaster.io can deliver updates instantly via the cloud. The user does not even need
to download a new version of the application; he will receive updates automatically.

## FAQ

Learn more about AppMaster Business Process Designer and more information about how to work with our
no-code platform.

[Read Docs][70]
[FAQ icon]What is a business processes editor?
The business processes editor is the main tool for creating application logic. Here, using simple
visual blocks, you can create data processing schemes: from elementary to the most complex ones.
It's like a LEGO: we take blocks that are small logic elements, indicate the connection between them
and the execution sequence, and thus create circuits of any level of complexity.
[FAQ icon]What can I do with the BP editor?
The business process editor allows you to carry out everything related to working with data. It can
be used to calculate, search, retrieve, update, delete, change and perform all actions in your
project, within the server side. If some information processing can be described by a clear
algorithm of actions, then you can do it in the business processes editor.
[FAQ icon]Where can I get BP blocks?
All available blocks are located on the left panel of the editor. You can take and place them on the
canvas, creating links. And you can also connect additional modules that expand the number of
available blocks.
[FAQ icon]Can I try AppMaster for free?
We have a free subscription to learn and explore the platform. We don’t require credit card
information to get a free subscription. Also, we have discounts of up to 95% for some categories of
customers.

## Get the answer you need about Pricing Plans

[Can I try it before buying subscription?]Can I try it before buying subscription?
You can test out AppMaster with a free subscription to experiment with your first project. You can
upgrade your plan on the Billing settings page if you like it.
[Can I cancel my account plan at any time?]Can I cancel my account plan at any time?
Your account plan automatically renews at the end of each billing cycle, but you can stop renewing
at any time, no refund is provided.
[What happens if the payment is declined?]What happens if the payment is declined?
We try to process the payment 3 times during two weeks approximately. If we are not succeeding in
it, your subscription will be canceled.
[What kind of support does AppMaster provide?]What kind of support does AppMaster provide?
We offer email support to accounts with a Business Plan or higher and prioritized help for
enterprise accounts. Community support is available with any subscription.
[Can I export my applications or my source code?]Can I export my applications or my source code?
Downloading source code available only for accounts with Enterprise Plan. Contact us to request
Enterprise plan.
[Does AppMaster have a partner program?]Does AppMaster have a partner program?
AppMaster has an partner program for developers. Read more about our program here. Also, each user
is provided with a personal referral link.

## What Drives Us

###### Trust

###### Integrity

###### Customer Success

###### Radical Ownership

###### Pragmatic Thinking

###### Empathy

We trust each other to get things done, even when the coffee machine breaks down. If we can handle
that, we can handle anything.

last slice of pizza... then, integrity is optional.

Your success is our success. We’re your biggest cheerleaders—just without the pom-poms (maybe next

We own it all—good, bad, and occasionally, the random bug that pops up five minutes before the
deadline.

We get things done the right way. If it works, we run with it. If not, we pivot, adapt, and usually
order more snacks to power through.

We’ve been there—late nights, tight deadlines, and the panic when the Wi-Fi goes down. We get it,
and we’ve got your back (with snacks).

## What to Expect When You Work With AppVerticals

### Every Engagement Is Led by a Senior Architect

Every AppVerticals engagement is led by a US-based solution architect with 10+ years of production
experience. The person you speak with in the first call is the person who owns your project.

### We Scope Before We Propose

We do not send generic proposals. Every recommendation is based on a direct conversation about your
product, your constraints, and your market. You receive architecture guidance before you see a
price.

### Your Timeline Is Treated as a Hard Constraint

We build delivery plans around the dates that matter to your business — funding rounds, product
launches, board commitments. Milestones are fixed at the start of every engagement, not adjusted
after the fact.

### Your Idea Is Protected From the First Message

We sign an NDA before any technical discussion begins. Your product concept, architecture decisions,
and business model are fully confidential across every member of the AppVerticals team.

### Transparent Pricing From the First Proposal

Every proposal includes milestone-based pricing with no hidden costs, no scope creep clauses, and no
surprise invoices. What is agreed at the start is what appears on every invoice.

### The Engagement Does Not End at Launch

Every AppVerticals project includes 30 days of post-launch optimization as standard. Long-term
retainer partnerships are available for teams that need ongoing engineering support beyond the
initial build.

##### About The Client

## Empowering Digital Growth Across Divisions

Al Rostamani Group, one of the UAE’s most respected business conglomerates, partnered with us to
modernize its digital presence. Our goal was to create a unified online ecosystem for six
divisions—each distinct yet consistent—strengthening their reach and delivering seamless user
experiences across every platform.

### Overview

Al Rostamani Group is a family-owned conglomerate headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with roots going back
to the 1950s. Operating across automotive, real estate, travel, financial services, construction,
communications, and renewable energy — the group is one of the most established names in the region.
To keep pace with digital growth, they required a unified and modern online presence for six
divisions, including Al Rostamani Group, Al Rostamani Travel, Al Rostamani Exchange, Al Rostamani
Communications, Abdulla Al Rostamani Properties, and Emirates Electrical Engineering.

##### Accessibility

Creating a user-friendly experience for all types of target audiences, including users with visual

##### Ease of Management

Managing six websites efficiently required a unified backend. We built a centralized CMS that allows

Spruce is a U.S.-based home and property services platform for multifamily communities and
short-term rentals. It connects residents, service pros, and property managers with on-demand and
scheduled cleaning, chores, and partner services like laundry pickup and pet care.

## The Mission & the Make

We rebuilt Spruce’s nationwide home services platform, launching a Service Pro mobile app, upgrading
manager tools, and adding capacity, pricing, and reporting so residents, pros, and admins run
bookings, operations, and growth on one fast, role-aware system.

##### Problem

OCSRs supported unattended kiosks through a patchwork of tools like Teams, AnyDesk, and Splashtop.
Access often required on-site consent, schedules lacked visibility, and monitoring was thin. CPCG
needed one secure system to view assignments, unlock kiosks, and manage sessions.

##### Solution

We delivered a unified remote support system that automates kiosk unlocking, enforces schedule-based
access, and centralizes session control. OCSRs get dashboards and chat; managers get tracking,
audits, and role-based controls. Skill-based assignment and live reporting replaced scattered tools.

### The Roadblocks We Had to Clear

Had to Clear Before CPCG’s new system could take shape, we had to confront the gaps slowing their
remote support. These challenges shaped our approach and defined the solutions we engineered.

#### Disconnected Tools Slowing Support

Kiosk operations relied on Teams, AnyDesk and Splashtop, creating delays and extra steps.
Representatives wasted time switching between apps, while managers lacked a single place to oversee
all activity.

#### Unclear and Unreliable Access

Schedules sat in spreadsheets with no real visibility. Representatives faced failed connections
during valid shifts, while idle kiosks went unused. Coordination became harder, and access was never
guaranteed.

#### Limited Monitoring Visibility

No central view of kiosk uptime or agent activity existed. Without unified logs or dashboards,
leaders could not catch issues early, track performance, or ensure compliance effectively.

#### Security Without Central Control

Unlocking kiosks meant using third-party tools and manual steps. The process added risk, slowed
responses, and left CPCG without an auditable, scalable way to control access.

A single secure system replaced scattered tools, centralizing kiosk access, scheduling, monitoring,

harder to deliver and nearly impossible to scale.

##### Solution

AppVerticals built OASIS as a unified platform with automated teacher onboarding, smart booking
workflows, secure payments, and real-time insights. This turned the fragmented operations into a
smooth, data-driven education marketplace.

### The Challenges We Face In The Project

Building OASIS was not just a development task. The client wanted a platform powerful enough to
unify education operations and simple enough to be used by anyone. To make that vision real, we had
to overcome several product, technical, and business challenges head-on.

#### Fragmented Systems

Schools relied on scattered tools for hiring, scheduling, and payments. Centralizing operations
without interrupting existing workflows was critical to ensure smooth adoption and data continuity.

[oasis][oasis]

#### Complex User Roles

The platform needed secure access for admins, school managers, teachers, and support staff.
Designing role-based permissions without data overlap or security risks required precise logic and
control.

[oasis][oasis]

#### Scalability & Performance

The platform had to perform flawlessly as users grew from hundreds to thousands. High booking
activity & real-time data sync required a resilient architecture with zero downtime and fast
response speed.

[oasis][oasis]

#### Secure Payments

Integrating payments between schools and teachers required automated invoices, payout rules, and
detailed history logs. Achieving full transparency and PCI-grade security added significant
complexity.

## About Balotech

Balotech Game is a modern reinvention of a traditional card experience. Built for Balotech card
players, the platform brings speed, accuracy, and transparency to every round. AppVerticals
partnered with the game owner to turn a classic offline activity into a fast, reliable, AR-powered

##### Problem

Manual loan processes, scattered client data, and slow approvals caused compliance risk,
inconsistent service, and revenue loss. Paper KYC, delayed verification, and no centralized
consultation tracking significantly worsened customer frustration.

##### Solution

AppVerticals delivered a secure, cloud-based lending platform with digital onboarding, automated
KYC, AI-driven risk scoring, configurable underwriting rules, integrated payments, and a
user-friendly portal, including cutting processing times and significantly boosting transparency.

### The Challenges We Face In The Project

Building a compliant, scalable lending platform required balancing security, usability, and complex
financial rules while minimizing disruption to GFS operations and client trust.

#### Compliance & Regulation

Designing KYC, AML, and data-retention flows that meet regulatory standards without adding approval
delays or user friction proved challenging.

[gts-logo][gts-logo]

#### Secure Document Handling

Implementing encrypted storage, OCR-driven document capture, and anti-fraud checks while ensuring
fast access and legal auditability required careful engineering.

[gts-logo][gts-logo]

#### Flexible Underwriting Logic

Supporting multiple loan products with configurable rules, collateral handling, and rate
calculations demanded a modular, robust rules engine.

[gts-logo][gts-logo]

#### User Adoption & Experience

Replacing paper workflows meant creating simple, reassuring interfaces for clients and consultants,
plus training and migration support to ensure adoption.

### Every Engagement Is Led by a Senior Architect

Every AppVerticals engagement is led by a US-based solution architect with 10+ years of production
experience. The person you speak with in the first call is the person who owns your project.

### We Scope Before We Propose

We do not send generic proposals. Every recommendation is based on a direct conversation about your
product, your constraints, and your market. You receive architecture guidance before you see a
price.
