# **AI/ML Solutions for Real Estate**

#### Jan–July 2022

The real-estate sector is one of the biggest industries in the business world. Yet it has been some
time before industrial enterprises utilize current technologies like AI/ML.

Traditionally the investors had to go through a troublesome process of looking through many
documents and finding people ready to buy or sell houses. But, the increased adoption of AI in real
estate has accelerated the whole process dramatically, which is crucial to these businesses in a
fast-moving and ultra-competitive market.

Our client, too, wanted to rebuild property management while focusing on delivering an amazing
service enhanced with intuitive, easy-to-use technology.

[Real Estate][Real Estate]

## **OBJECTIVE**

The client's main concern was to provide a solution where the heavy lifting that's associated with a
real estate transaction: the complex data, compliance, the paperwork, the finding of the home, the
negotiation, and the offers could all be outsourced using AI.

Thus, the client wanted to build a platform that targets the Australian market and provides
top-notch service to their valuable customers by redefining how properties are managed.

Also, where people could search for homes to rent or buy, learn about the neighborhood, and avail
themselves of the best settlement packages. Thus, guiding through the entire process from search to
settlement and even beyond.

## **APPROACH**

We addressed the client's needs by building a platform to be used by four users, i.e., Property
buyer, Seller, Real-estate Agent, and Barrister.

Here visitors can find the best property deals, sell their property at the best prices and connect
with real estate agents to subscribe to their services wherein they look into all aspects of your
property.

The AI algorithm allows Realtors to identify prospect leads and close profitable deals. Whereas, for
investors, AI helps determine the right time to buy, rent and sell a property. It also helps
anticipate the fluctuations in the rental price every year.

Using Machine Learning and Data training, the platform provides an automatic predictive value of the
property based on many factors like:
* Area, location, and type of property,
* standard industry data,
* characteristics of the property and key performance indicators
* prime amenities or hospitals or schools around the property, etc.

Also, we employed an AI/Ml-powered chatbot to provide on-demand information and answers to the
user's queries over the phone, via email, live chat, and through the owner portal. The features the
chatbot offers are:
* 24/7 access to the user portal.
* Quick and easy access to data regarding your leases, maintenance requests, statements, and more.
* Tenant app for prompt communication and streamlined requests.

## **IMPACT**

With the implementation of Artificial Intelligence, the client has experienced a massive boost,
solving many user experience issues.

With the help of AI, they have identified and retained 75% of potential leads depending on the data
collected from website visits and landing pages.

Furthermore, AI assistants and chatbots have boosted communication between investors, renters, and
property managers. For example, the chatbots respond appropriately to renters' common queries and
automatically send utility bills and notices, thus providing a seamless user experience.

All this has resulted in:
* 51% rise in interactions per visit on the website.
* Better anticipation of consumer needs.
* Converting 50% of potential prospects into availing the rental property.

# Audio Streaming App for a Multilingual Cultural Platform

A cross-platform mobile app built to celebrate cultural heritage through immersive storytelling,
multilingual content, and personalized audio experiences.

## About the *Project*

A groundbreaking audio streaming platform that celebrates the rich cultural heritage through
storytelling. Hosting over 15,000 hours of premium content, this audio streaming platform features
an extensive collection of audio dramas, narratives, and educational materials across multiple
segments. Offering both local language and English content, it serves as a dynamic hub for
culturally rich, immersive audio experiences, catering to a diverse audience with exclusive,
high-quality productions.

## Objective

The primary goal behind developing this audio platform was to build an innovative audio streaming
service that goes beyond traditional platforms. The client aimed to deliver a diverse library of
stories, podcasts, and educational content, tailored to individual preferences for a truly immersive
experience.

## Challenges

Developing a feature-rich, multilingual audio streaming platform came with its own set of
complexities. Our team’s expertise and problem-solving approach helped us address the following
challenges effectively:

Challenge 01

### Offline Library Syncing

Implementing offline functionality required seamless integration that allowed users to download and
access content without affecting the app’s overall performance or streaming quality.

Challenge 02

### Multilingual Content Management

With podcasts and episodes available in over 22 languages, building a system that could handle
diverse languages while maintaining a consistent, user-friendly experience was a key challenge.

## Solutions

To address the challenges and deliver a seamless user experience, we implemented a combination of
smart technologies and intuitive design:

[download icon][download icon]

A smart caching system was developed to allow users to download and access their favorite podcasts
and stories offline without delays or performance issues, ensuring uninterrupted listening.

[globe icon][globe icon]

A dynamic multilingual system was designed to support content in 22 languages. Users can seamlessly
switch between languages, while automatic detection based on location and preferences ensures a
personalized experience.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

thinks, adapts, and holds up when it matters.

# 3PL Logistics Provider Improves On-Time Delivery to 97% with AI Route Optimization

## About the Client

The client is a mid-tier third-party logistics (3PL) provider managing **over 25,000 shipments per
week** across regional and national transportation networks. The company serves a diverse portfolio
of retail and manufacturing customers that rely on predictable delivery timelines and cost-efficient
freight movement.As shipment volumes grew, the logistics provider struggled to maintain carrier
utilization efficiency and delivery consistency. Route planning relied heavily on manual processes
and fragmented systems, limiting the company’s ability to optimize fleet capacity and respond to
real-time disruptions.To improve operational efficiency and scale transportation planning, the
company partnered with **Zymr** to implement a **modern Transportation Management System (TMS) with
AI-driven route optimization and real-time shipment visibility**.

## Key Outcomes

On-Time Delivery Improved from 82% to 97%
19% Reduction in Transportation Spend

## Business Challenges

The logistics provider’s transportation operations relied on legacy planning tools and manual route
allocation. Dispatch teams had limited visibility into carrier availability, shipment routing
options, and delivery performance metrics.This often resulted in inefficient route planning,
underutilized carrier capacity, and delayed deliveries during peak shipping periods. Customers also
lacked real-time shipment visibility, leading to frequent service inquiries and operational
inefficiencies.As shipment volumes continued to grow, the company needed a more intelligent
logistics platform capable of optimizing routes dynamically, improving carrier utilization, and
providing customers with transparent shipment tracking.The organization required a scalable system
capable of managing increasing transportation complexity while maintaining cost efficiency and
delivery reliability.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr helped the logistics provider transform its transportation operations into a data-driven
logistics network. By introducing AI-powered route optimization and real-time shipment visibility,
the company significantly improved delivery performance and operational efficiency.
* **On-Time Delivery:** Improved from **82% to 97%**
* **Transportation Costs:** **19% reduction** achieved
* **Carrier Utilization:** Improved efficiency across routes
* **Shipment Visibility:** Enhanced tracking and transparency for customers
* **Business Growth:** **$200M in new contracts** won through improved service levels

## Strategy and Solutions
* **Transportation Management Platform Implementation**
Zymr implemented a scalable transportation management platform designed to optimize routing
decisions and improve shipment visibility across the logistics network.
* **AI-Based Route Optimization**
Machine learning algorithms analyzed route options, delivery windows, and carrier capacity to
generate optimized transportation plans.
* **Modern Transportation Management System (TMS)**
Implemented a centralized TMS to manage shipment scheduling, carrier allocation, and delivery
performance monitoring.
* **Real-Time Shipment Tracking**
Enabled end-to-end shipment visibility through live tracking and automated status updates.
* **Customer Self-Service Portal**
Provided customers with real-time delivery insights, shipment tracking, and reporting
capabilities.
* **Scalable Cloud Infrastructure**
Built the platform on cloud infrastructure to support increasing shipment volumes and peak
logistics demand.

# 3PL Multi-Client WMS Modernization, Achieves 97% Perfect Order Rate with 8x Peak Scalability

## About the Client

The client is a mid-tier third-party logistics (3PL) provider serving 45 fast-growing e-commerce
brands across multiple fulfillment centers. Their legacy warehouse systems struggled to handle
multi-client complexity, peak season demand, and real-time visibility requirements. Limited
scalability and fragmented workflows impacted operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. To
modernize operations and support rapid growth, the client partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

97% Perfect Order Rate Achieved
250 Picks Per Hour Productivity

## Business Challenges

The client operated on legacy WMS platforms that lacked multi-tenant capabilities, making it
difficult to efficiently manage multiple clients with varying fulfillment requirements. Inventory
visibility was limited, leading to inaccuracies, delayed shipments, and increased operational costs.

Manual processes and lack of automation reduced warehouse productivity and increased dependency on
labor. During peak seasons, the system failed to scale, resulting in order backlogs and missed SLAs.

Additionally, the absence of real-time tracking and integration with modern systems like IoT devices
and automated storage solutions limited operational transparency. The client needed a scalable,
cloud-native WMS platform capable of handling multi-client operations, improving accuracy, and
enabling high-performance fulfillment.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

high-performance fulfillment ecosystem through a cloud-native WMS platform. This significantly
improved accuracy, throughput, and scalability.

* ‍**Real-Time Inventory Visibility Across All Clients**

## Strategy and Solutions

efficiency.

accuracy.

Implemented intelligent wave planning and batch processing to maximize picking efficiency and
throughput.
* **Real-Time Analytics & Dashboards**
Delivered actionable insights into warehouse performance, order status, and operational KPIs.
* **Workflow Automation**
Replaced manual warehouse processes with automated workflows to improve speed, accuracy, and
scalability.

# Academic Health System Unifies Clinician Workflows with a Single Mobile Platform

## About the Client

The client was a 650-bed academic medical center supporting over 3,200 clinicians across inpatient,
outpatient, and specialty care settings. Over time, clinicians were forced to rely on more than a
dozen disconnected mobile and desktop tools for scheduling, messaging, documentation, alerts, and
clinical decision support. This fragmentation caused workflow disruption, alert fatigue, and rising
dissatisfaction among physicians and nursing staff.

Hospital leadership wanted to simplify clinician workflows by consolidating critical functions into
a single, secure mobile application tightly integrated with Epic. To achieve this at scale and
without compromising clinical safety, the organization partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

89% Clinician Adoption in the First Year
41% Reduction in Documentation Time

## Business Challenges

Clinicians were overwhelmed by fragmented tools that interrupted care delivery and increased
cognitive load. Alerts were inconsistent across systems, documentation was time-consuming, and
switching between applications reduced efficiency during patient interactions. Any unified solution
needed to integrate deeply with Epic using FHIR standards, support real-time clinical data, reduce
alert fatigue, and meet strict security and compliance requirements. Adoption risk was high, as
clinicians would reject any solution that added friction instead of removing it.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr helped the academic medical center transform clinician mobility from a productivity drain into
a clinical advantage. By unifying workflows into a single mobile platform, the organization improved
adoption, reduced documentation burden, and enhanced care delivery without disrupting Epic or
clinical safety.
* 89% Clinician Adoption in the First Year
* 41% Reduction in Documentation Time
* 97% Alert Compliance Across Care Teams
* Improved Workflow Efficiency Across 3,200 Providers
* Reduced Tool Switching and Cognitive Load

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr designed and delivered a native clinician mobile platform that consolidated workflows into a
single, intuitive experience.
* **Unified Native iOS and Android Clinician App
** Replaced 14 siloed tools with one secure mobile platform.
* **Deep Epic FHIR Integration
** Integrated scheduling, secure messaging, vitals, and clinical context directly from Epic.
* **Real-Time Vitals Trending and CDS
** Enabled continuous clinical insights with embedded decision support.
* **Ambient Documentation Enablement
** Reduced manual documentation effort during patient interactions.
* **Intelligent Alert Management
** Standardized alerts to reduce fatigue while maintaining compliance.**‍**
* **Enterprise-Grade Security and Access Controls
** Ensured HIPAA compliance and role-based access across care teams.

# Accelerating KYC Compliance with Python Automation

## About the Client

A leading digital payments platform serving customers across North America and Europe. The client
needed to streamline KYC compliance workflows for faster onboarding and real-time regulatory
reporting, as manual checks were causing significant delays and compliance risks.

## Key Outcomes

Reduced manual effort by 60% through end-to-end automation
Achieved KYC SLA compliance across 95% of new user registrations

## Business Challenges

The client relied on manually validating customer documents, sanction lists, and AML data sources,
which introduced human error and prolonged the onboarding cycle by days. Compliance audits were also
challenging due to the lack of real-time reporting and traceability. The existing system lacked
integration with modern AML/KYC databases.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

The client reduced KYC processing time by 70% and achieved near-instant audit readiness. Automated
alerting ensured zero compliance lapses, and audit traceability improved cross-functional
accountability.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr engineered a Python-based automation layer that interfaced with key AML/KYC APIs and
third-party identity verification systems. Using Python scripts, we automated document parsing,
sanctions screening, and trigger-based alerts. The scripts were deployed in Docker containers and
integrated into the client's microservices environment. We also built a real-time audit dashboard
using Flask and Plotly.

# AI-Driven Customer Experience Engine for a Retail eCommerce Platform About the Client

## About the Client

A rapidly growing online retailer in the fashion and lifestyle sector, serving a diverse customer
base across North America and Europe. The client wanted to use AI to personalize customer journeys
at scale, increase conversions, and improve retention across digital channels.

## Key Outcomes

Achieved 1:7 ROI on AI investment within the first quarter.
Enabled dynamic segmentation and churn risk targeting across the customer base.

## Business Challenges

The eCommerce platform delivered a generic shopping experience, resulting in low cart-to-checkout
conversions and a rising volume of abandoned carts. Customer data was fragmented across marketing,
CRM, and transaction systems, making personalization difficult. Promotions were manually configured,
lacking dynamic targeting and performance tracking.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Cart-to-checkout conversions increased by 38% within six weeks of launch. Repeat purchases rose by
31% due to personalized recommendations, and campaign setup time dropped by 50% through automated
optimization.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr developed a full-stack AI personalization engine to deliver targeted user experiences in real
time. We implemented collaborative filtering and deep-learning recommenders using TensorFlow to
generate dynamic product suggestions and pricing offers. Behavioral targeting models were trained on
session-level data to trigger cart recovery emails and nudges, which were orchestrated via Braze for
multi-channel delivery. A customer data platform (CDP) was built by integrating Segment to unify
behavioral, CRM, and purchase data into a 360° view. Smart promotion engines were developed using
demand elasticity modeling to optimize offers and A/B test campaigns by user segment.

# AI-Driven Revenue Analytics Platform Recovers $24M Through Predictive Claims Intelligence

## About the Client

The client is a mid-sized health plan managing millions of claims across multiple lines of business.
Limited visibility into revenue performance, fragmented reporting systems, and manual analysis
processes made it difficult to identify financial leakage and operational inefficiencies. To improve
revenue intelligence and enable proactive decision-making, the organization partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

91% Prediction Accuracy Across Claims Analytics Models
Approximately $24M Revenue Recovery Opportunities Identified

## Business Challenges

The health plan managed large volumes of claims data across disconnected systems, making it
difficult to gain timely visibility into financial performance and revenue trends. Existing
reporting processes relied heavily on manual analysis, resulting in delayed insights and missed
recovery opportunities.

Operational teams lacked the ability to proactively identify claim anomalies, detect patterns
contributing to revenue leakage, and prioritize corrective actions. As claims volumes increased,
traditional reporting methods could not scale efficiently.

The organization also faced challenges in converting operational data into meaningful business
intelligence that could support financial planning and improve overall performance.

The client required an AI-powered analytics platform capable of analyzing claims at scale,
generating predictive insights, and uncovering hidden revenue opportunities.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed and implemented an AI-driven revenue analytics platform designed to transform
large-scale claims data into actionable financial intelligence. The solution improved revenue
visibility, accelerated decision-making, and identified measurable recovery opportunities.
* 91% Prediction Accuracy Across Revenue Models
* Analyzed More Than 4.1 Million Claims Records
* Approximately $24M Revenue Recovery Opportunities Identified
* 35% Faster Revenue Performance Reporting
* Improved Operational Decision-Making Through Predictive Insights

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr engineered an intelligent analytics ecosystem to modernize claims analysis and enable
data-driven revenue optimization.
* **AI-Powered Revenue Prediction Models**
Built machine learning models to analyze claims behavior, forecast trends, and identify revenue
optimization opportunities.
* **Large-Scale Claims Data Processing**
Enabled high-volume claims ingestion and processing to support millions of records with faster
analytics execution.
* **Operational Performance Analytics**
Implemented dashboards and reporting capabilities to provide visibility into revenue drivers and
operational bottlenecks.
* **Predictive Opportunity Identification**
Developed analytics workflows to uncover financial recovery opportunities and prioritize action
areas.
* **Real-Time Revenue Intelligence**
Delivered near real-time insights to support faster business decisions and continuous performance
monitoring.
* **Scalable Analytics Architecture**
Designed a cloud-based analytics foundation to support future growth and expanding business
requirements.

delayed interventions and revenue leakage. Care management and operations teams also lacked

## About the Client

transformation, the client partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

$24M Revenue Opportunities Identified and Recovered

## Business Challenges

The organization relied heavily on historical reporting and manual analysis to forecast revenue
performance. This approach limited visibility into emerging revenue risks and made proactive
decision-making difficult across departments.

Disconnected financial, operational, and claims data created reporting inconsistencies and delayed
executive insights. Teams lacked a unified intelligence layer to identify trends, predict
performance shifts, and prioritize corrective actions.

Existing analytics tools were descriptive rather than predictive, making it difficult to model
scenarios, optimize revenue opportunities, and reduce leakage across the revenue cycle.

Leadership required a scalable AI platform capable of improving forecasting accuracy, enabling
intelligent recommendations, and supporting long-term operational planning.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

forecasting, operational visibility, and strategic decision-making across the organization.

consistent reporting and analysis.

# AI-Enabled Fraud Detection for a Digital Mortgage Broker

## About the Client

A digital-first mortgage brokerage offering instant pre-approvals and competitive rates via an
online platform. The client sought to detect fraudulent applications without slowing their
sub-60-second approval promise.

## Key Outcomes

Increased detection of synthetic identity fraud cases by 25%.
Enhanced LOS efficiency through seamless integration with fraud detection APIs.

## Business Challenges

Fraudulent applications ranging from falsified income documents to synthetic identities were
slipping through initial checks, leading to increased default risk. Manual fraud review processes
were too slow for their rapid approval of the SLA. The broker needed an AI-driven fraud detection
system that could integrate seamlessly with their existing LOS.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Fraudulent application volume dropped by 30%, while maintaining the broker’s sub-60-second
pre-approval speed. False positive rates fell by 20%, reducing unnecessary manual reviews.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr developed and deployed an AI-based fraud detection module that embedded advanced analytics
directly into the client’s loan origination workflows. The system used historical borrower behavior
analysis to identify risk-prone profiles, document pattern recognition to detect tampering or
inconsistencies in pay stubs, tax returns, and IDs, and credit file anomaly detection to flag
irregularities in applicant histories. The fraud detection model was continuously retrained on live
data, allowing it to adapt to evolving fraud tactics. This integration ensured high detection
accuracy without impacting the platform’s rapid pre-approval experience.

# AI, Machine Learning And Big Data Orchestration

## About the Client

Bluedata is a leading software company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It provides big
data analytics via self-service, through on-premise private clouds. Bluedata’s flagship product is a
software solution that gives Hadoop big data deployments, the benefits of virtualization and private
clouds, resulting in reduced deployment complexity with improved business agility.

## Key Outcomes

Developed HP Enterprise's analytics orchestration admin console, pipelines, and MLOps.
Developed enterprise-grade Admin console with SaaS multi-tenancy and RBAC.

## Business Challenges

Bluedata wanted to build a comprehensive, modern, and responsive Enterprise UI for
Hadoop-as-a-Service. They were previously following a milestone-based development process and wanted
to accelerate the launch of Big-Data-as-a-Service Epic CloudTech products.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Bluedata achieved an agile development process, which enabled rapid testing and continuous
improvement. They built a comprehensive, modern, and responsive Enterprise UI for
Hadoop-as-a-Service. The solution involved leveraging common datacenter infrastructure for big data,
support for the virtualization of big data infrastructure, provisions for physical clusters of
servers, and to orchestrate and meter big data jobs on tenancy boundaries.

## Strategy and Solutions

We created an agile development process, which facilitated rapid testing and continuous improvement.
Our team accelerated the launch of BlueData’s Big-Data-as-a-Service Epic CloudTech product by
co-developing their enterprise admin console. As the engagement continued with Bluedata, we built
custom data connectors and implemented reporting services with the executive dashboard using iOS
(iPad and iPhone). We used Django based python framework for UI services and delivered partial UX
design services for the Web UI. Earlier, we chose the Bootstrap.js template. However, we replaced it
later with a custom Javascript template for Web UI. We organized the Javascript project using
Backbone.js and added numerous JQuery and custom controls. Our team created a Jenkins and
Maven-based CI process and used Git for the software repository. We delivered limited QE and testing
services that mostly spanned the front-end tier.

comprehensive solution empowered our clients to make data-driven decisions and optimize their
business strategies effectively.

# AI-Native Analytics Platform Built on BigQuery Accelerates Data Processing and Real-Time
# Intelligence

## About the Client

The client is a rapidly growing cybersecurity company managing high volumes of event and telemetry
data across multiple environments. Existing analytics capabilities could not keep pace with data
growth, machine-learning requirements, and customer demand for real-time insights. The company
required a scalable analytics platform capable of supporting operational visibility, advanced
analytics, and intelligent decision-making. To achieve this transformation, the organization
partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

10x Faster Analytics Processing Across Large-Scale Data Workloads
Enabled Real-Time Intelligence and Machine Learning at Enterprise Scale

## Business Challenges

The client’s existing analytics environment struggled to process rapidly increasing volumes of
cybersecurity event data. Traditional architectures created delays in data ingestion, reporting, and
analytical processing, limiting operational responsiveness.

As machine-learning initiatives expanded, the organization faced challenges in preparing,
transforming, and analyzing data efficiently across multiple pipelines. Existing systems lacked the
flexibility required to support both internal operational analytics and customer-facing intelligence
services.

The company also required near real-time visibility into platform performance and threat
intelligence while maintaining scalability and cost efficiency.

To support future growth, the organization needed an AI-native analytics architecture capable of
unifying data processing, enabling advanced analytics workflows, and delivering real-time business
intelligence.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr engineered an AI-native analytics platform built on BigQuery to support real-time analytics,
machine-learning operations, and enterprise-scale intelligence delivery.
* **Cloud-Native BigQuery Architecture**
Designed a scalable analytics foundation using Google Cloud BigQuery to process large-scale event
and operational data efficiently.
* **Large-Scale Data Pipeline Engineering**
Built automated ingestion and transformation pipelines to support continuous processing across
multiple data sources.
* **Machine Learning Workflow Enablement**
Implemented infrastructure and data workflows optimized for model development, training, and
analytical processing.
* **Real-Time Analytics and Intelligence**
Enabled near real-time insights and operational visibility through accelerated analytics and event
processing.
* **Customer-Facing Analytics Layer**
Delivered intelligence capabilities supporting customer dashboards, reporting, and analytical
experiences.
* **Scalable Data Operations Framework**
Established an architecture capable of supporting future expansion while maintaining performance
and cost optimization.

This implementation created a scalable foundation for advanced analytics and AI-driven
decision-making. While developed for cybersecurity workloads, the same architectural approach
applies effectively across modern financial analytics and data-intensive environments.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr designed and implemented a cloud-native analytics platform on Google Cloud to modernize data
operations and enable scalable intelligence capabilities.
* **10x Faster Analytics Processing Across High-Volume Data Pipelines**
* **Real-Time Event Intelligence Across Operational Workloads**
* **Scalable Machine Learning Enablement for Advanced Analytics**
* **Improved Customer-Facing Reporting and Data Visibility**
* **Reduced Infrastructure Complexity Through Cloud-Native Architecture**
* **Enhanced Platform Scalability and Analytical Performance**

# AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform on GCP Accelerates Threat Detection and Model Deployment at Scale

## About the Client

The client is a cybersecurity technology company delivering AI-driven threat detection solutions for
enterprise environments. Processing massive volumes of security telemetry data across cloud and
hybrid infrastructures, the company needed a scalable platform to operationalize machine learning
models and accelerate threat detection. Existing workflows lacked automation, making model
deployment and retraining difficult to manage at scale. To address these challenges, the company
partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

70% Faster Model Deployment Cycles
85% Reduction in Manual ML Operations

## Business Challenges

The client's threat detection platform generated large volumes of telemetry data from endpoints,
networks, cloud environments, and security tools. While machine learning models were effective in
identifying threats, deploying, monitoring, and retraining those models required significant manual
effort.

Data pipelines lacked standardization, resulting in delays in data preparation and feature
engineering. Model retraining processes were inconsistent, impacting detection accuracy as threat
patterns evolved.

The organization also faced challenges scaling model serving infrastructure to support growing
customer demand while maintaining low-latency threat detection. Limited observability across ML
workflows made it difficult to monitor model performance, identify drift, and troubleshoot
production issues.

The client required a cloud-native MLOps platform that could automate ML lifecycle management,
improve scalability, and accelerate the delivery of AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr helped the client build a production-grade MLOps platform on Google Cloud Platform, enabling
scalable machine learning operations, automated retraining, and reliable model serving.
* **70% Faster Model Deployment Cycles**
* **85% Reduction in Manual ML Operations**
* **50% Improvement in Model Retraining Efficiency**
* **99.9% ML Platform Availability**
* **Improved Detection Accuracy Through Automated Model Updates**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr designed and implemented an AI-native cybersecurity platform leveraging Google Cloud services
and modern MLOps practices.
* **BigQuery-Based Security Data Lakehouse**
Built a scalable lakehouse architecture to centralize and process high-volume security telemetry
data for analytics and machine learning workloads.
* **Automated ML Retraining Pipelines**
Implemented automated retraining workflows to continuously update models using new threat
intelligence and operational data.
* **Production Model Serving Infrastructure**
Deployed scalable model serving environments capable of supporting low-latency inference across
large enterprise workloads.
* **ML Orchestration and Workflow Automation**
Established end-to-end orchestration for data preparation, model training, validation, deployment,
and monitoring.
* **Model Monitoring and Drift Detection**
Enabled continuous monitoring of model performance with automated drift detection and alerting
mechanisms.
* **Cloud-Native Security and Governance**
Implemented secure access controls, audit capabilities, and governance frameworks aligned with
enterprise cybersecurity requirements.

The client’s cybersecurity platform relied on fragmented ML workflows that required significant

# Strategy and Solutions

Zymr AI/ML services experts and healthcare IT services experts collaborated to develop an AI-native
application with complete lifecycle management to AI-ML and MLOps to deliver significant value for
our clients. The solution was deployed on Azure and built an AI solution with NLP, OCR, and related
ML capabilities to extract competitive analysis of benefits and coverage. Our data science team was
engaged with the client to understand the business objectives thoroughly and developed the ML model
in consultation with the business stakeholders of our client. Our MLOps team architected a data
ingestion pipeline, storing raw, feature-engineered, and golden data set in a SQL database. THE
NER ML model was developed iteratively using BERT and spaCy. Several tools and technologies were
used, such as Tessaract, AWS extract for OCR, neural nets, and fast text for data classification.
Kafka played a crucial role in the continuous ingestion and distribution of health insurance
documents from various sources. These documents are subsequently processed by the AI engine
developed by our AI/ML services experts. Initially, the ingested bronze documents undergo document
classification, followed by preprocessing stages involving OCR, by tesseract, and AWS extract. Text
classification techniques such as BERT are applied, along with named entity recognition (NER) using
Spacy or custom NER. Post-processing involves JSON conversion and storage. The user interface (UI)
is developed using Node and React, while MongoDB stores the Bronze, Silver, and Gold data sets.

## About the Client

Cigna Texas health insurance company is one of the major providers of health insurance to residents

## Key Outcomes

Developed AI Engine for analysis of U.S. health insurance policies for PPO and HMO.
Developed a well-architected AI solution with NLP, OCR, and ML capabilities with a data ingestion
pipeline and SQL database.

## Business Challenges

To stay competitive, the client wanted to develop healthcare IT services that would help them
compare their pricing and benefits with other competitors. However, they have many policy documents
in PDF format, and manually extracting the relevant information could have been time-consuming and
error-prone. The company needed a solution to automatically extract named entities and other
relevant information from the PDF documents to facilitate comparison with competitors.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Cigna successfully achieved its goals by implementing healthcare IT services that leveraged
AI-native analysis of U.S. health insurance policies, specifically for PPOs and HMOs. The client was
able to utilize an ML engine with over 80% accuracy in evaluating policy coverage and costs and
established a well-architected AI/ML services pipeline ensuring quality, security, operating-cost
efficiency, and monitoring. Additionally, they generated clear financial reports on the UI console
for management review.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr AI/ML services experts and healthcare IT services experts collaborated to develop an AI-native
application with complete lifecycle management to AI-ML and MLOps to deliver significant value for
our clients. The solution was deployed on Azure and built an AI solution with NLP, OCR, and related
ML capabilities to extract competitive analysis of benefits and coverage. Our data science team was
engaged with the client to understand the business objectives thoroughly and developed the ML model
in consultation with the business stakeholders of our client. Our MLOps team architected a data
ingestion pipeline, storing raw, feature-engineered, and golden data set in a SQL database.THE NER
ML model was developed iteratively using BERT and spaCy. Several tools and technologies were used,
such as Tessaract, AWS extract for OCR, neural nets, and fast text for data classification. Kafka
played a crucial role in the continuous ingestion and distribution of health insurance documents
from various sources. These documents are subsequently processed by the AI engine developed by our
AI/ML services experts. Initially, the ingested bronze documents undergo document classification,
followed by preprocessing stages involving OCR, by tesseract, and AWS extract. Text classification
techniques such as BERT are applied, along with named entity recognition (NER) using Spacy or custom
NER. Post-processing involves JSON conversion and storage. The user interface (UI) is developed
using Node and React, while MongoDB stores the Bronze, Silver, and Gold data sets.

# AI-Powered Alarm Management Platform Reduces Alert Fatigue by 70% and Improves Critical Response
# Times

## About the Client

The client is a multi-hospital healthcare network managing thousands of device-generated alarms
daily across intensive care units, emergency departments, and inpatient care settings. Excessive
non-actionable alerts contributed to alarm fatigue among clinicians, increasing the risk of delayed
responses to critical patient events. The organization needed an intelligent platform to prioritize
alarms, reduce noise, and improve clinical decision-making. To address these challenges, the network
partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

70% Reduction in Non-Actionable Alarm Noise
35% Improvement in Critical Alert Response Times

## Business Challenges

The hospital network's monitoring infrastructure generated thousands of alarms every day from
patient monitors, infusion pumps, ventilators, and other connected medical devices. A large
percentage of these alerts were low-priority or clinically insignificant, making it difficult for
care teams to identify truly critical events.

Frequent alarm interruptions contributed to clinician fatigue, workflow disruptions, and decreased
confidence in monitoring systems. Staff often had to manually assess alerts from multiple devices,
increasing response times and operational burden.

The lack of centralized alarm management also limited visibility into alarm patterns, device
performance, and patient risk trends. Existing systems could not intelligently correlate alerts
across devices or automate escalation workflows.

The organization required an AI-powered alarm management solution capable of prioritizing critical
events, reducing unnecessary notifications, and improving patient safety outcomes.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed and implemented an intelligent alarm management platform that leveraged machine
learning, device interoperability, and workflow automation to improve clinical responsiveness and
reduce alert fatigue across the healthcare network.
* **70% Reduction in Non-Actionable Alarm Noise**
* **35% Improvement in Critical Alert Response Times**
* **50% Reduction in Manual Alert Review Effort**
* **90% Accuracy in Alarm Prioritization**
* **25% Improvement in Clinician Productivity**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr designed and deployed an AI-powered alarm management platform that integrated with existing
monitoring infrastructure and clinical workflows.
* **ML-Powered Alarm Prioritization**
Implemented machine learning models to classify and prioritize alerts based on patient condition,
device data, and clinical context.
* **Multi-Device Alert Correlation**
Correlated alarms from multiple connected devices to identify meaningful clinical events and
reduce redundant notifications.
* **Automated Escalation Workflows**
Enabled intelligent routing and escalation of critical alerts to the appropriate care teams based
on severity and response requirements.
* **Real-Time Monitoring Dashboard**
Delivered centralized visibility into alarm activity, response performance, and operational
metrics across facilities.
* **Clinical Workflow Integration**
Integrated alarm management processes directly into existing care workflows to minimize disruption
and improve adoption.
* **Analytics and Reporting**
Provided detailed reporting and trend analysis to support continuous optimization of alarm
strategies and patient safety initiatives.

## About the Client

services for patients with diabetes, hypertension, heart failure, and other chronic conditions.

billing requirements created administrative challenges and limited reimbursement visibility. The
organization needed a scalable platform that could automate CMS billing workflows while improving
patient engagement and clinical oversight. To support this transformation, the organization
partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

35% Increase in RPM Reimbursement Capture
50% Reduction in Clinician Administrative Time

## Business Challenges

The organization relied on multiple disconnected systems to manage RPM operations, patient
monitoring activities, clinician time tracking, and reimbursement workflows. Care teams spent
significant time manually documenting patient interactions and verifying compliance with CMS RPM
billing requirements.

Tracking CPT codes 99453, 99454, 99457, and 99458 required extensive administrative effort,
increasing the risk of missed reimbursement opportunities. Clinicians had limited visibility into
patient deterioration trends and often had to review large volumes of patient-generated data
manually.

Patient engagement reporting was fragmented, making it difficult to identify patients at risk of
non-compliance with RPM program requirements. The organization also lacked centralized reporting
capabilities to measure operational performance and reimbursement outcomes.

The organization needed an intelligent RPM platform capable of automating billing workflows,
improving patient monitoring, and reducing clinician workload while maximizing reimbursement
performance.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed an AI-powered RPM platform that automated CMS billing workflows, enhanced patient
monitoring capabilities, and improved reimbursement visibility across chronic care programs.
* **35% Increase in RPM Reimbursement Capture**

* **90% Accuracy in CPT Billing Qualification Tracking**

* **40% Faster Identification of High-Risk Patients**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr engineered a condition-specific RPM platform designed to streamline patient monitoring
operations and automate reimbursement management.
* **Automated CPT 99453–99458 Tracking**

reimbursement capture.
* **Clinician Time Capture Automation**

reimbursement compliance.
* **AI-Driven Deterioration Scoring**

deterioration risks early.

metrics.

Delivered comprehensive dashboards for billing performance, reimbursement forecasting, and
operational insights.
* **Integrated RPM Workflow Automation**
Unified monitoring, documentation, billing, and reporting workflows within a single platform to
reduce administrative burden and improve care team efficiency.

## About the Client

A U.S.-based SaaS startup founded by an ex-sales operations leader. The client aimed to disrupt the

communications across multiple channels.

## Key Outcomes

Reduced average lead response time by 50%.
Achieved 90% feature usage retention during the pilot phase.

## Business Challenges

The founder needed to validate market demand quickly to secure seed funding. Building a fully
featured CRM was time-intensive and costly, so the MVP needed to demonstrate AI capabilities, core
sales workflow automation, and user-friendly design within a tight 8-week delivery window.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

The MVP launched on schedule and helped the startup secure a seed funding round within 6 weeks of
release. Early adopters praised the AI-assisted outreach feature, boosting demo-to-signup
conversions by 35%.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr developed an AI-powered CRM MVP using React and Node.js, designed to showcase advanced
automation and intuitive user workflows. We implemented GPT-powered auto-replies to help sales teams
send personalized, context-aware responses instantly. A pipeline tracking dashboard with
drag-and-drop deal stages streamlined deal management, while email synchronization with Gmail and
Outlook APIs ensured smooth communication tracking. Lightweight user management functionality
supported small-to-mid-sized sales teams, keeping the MVP lean but impactful.

# AI-Powered Financial Document Parsing Accelerates Underwriting and Reduces Manual Processing by
# 70%

## About the Client

The client is a fast-growing fintech company focused on digital lending and customer onboarding
services. The organization processed large volumes of financial documents, including bank
statements, pay stubs, tax forms, and identity records submitted in multiple formats and layouts.
Manual document verification and data extraction slowed onboarding workflows, increased operational
costs, and introduced inconsistencies in underwriting data. To modernize these processes and improve
scalability, the company partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

70% Reduction in Manual Document Processing Time
90% Improvement in Financial Data Extraction Accuracy

## Business Challenges

The company relied heavily on manual review processes to extract and validate financial information
required for customer onboarding and credit underwriting. Documents were received in multiple
formats, including PDFs, scanned images, mobile uploads, and email attachments, making
standardization difficult.

Underwriting teams spent significant time manually entering and verifying customer income details,
transaction histories, tax information, and identity records. This slowed loan approval cycles and
increased operational overhead.

Inconsistent document formats and poor-quality scans also resulted in extraction errors and missing
financial data, impacting underwriting accuracy and compliance workflows.

The organization needed an intelligent document parsing solution capable of extracting structured
financial data from unstructured documents while supporting automation, scalability, and regulatory
compliance.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed an AI-powered financial document parsing platform that automated extraction,
classification, and validation of financial records used in onboarding and underwriting workflows.
* **70% Reduction in Manual Processing Time**
* **90% Improvement in Data Extraction Accuracy**
* **60% Faster Customer Onboarding Cycles**
* **50% Reduction in Underwriting Review Effort**
* **Improved KYC and Compliance Automation**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr implemented an AI-powered document intelligence solution designed to automate financial
document processing and improve underwriting efficiency.
* **AI-Based Financial Document Parsing**
Developed intelligent parsing models to extract structured financial data from bank statements,
pay stubs, tax records, and identity documents.
* **Multi-Format Document Support**
Enabled processing of PDFs, scanned files, images, and mobile-uploaded documents across varying
layouts and quality levels.
* **OCR and Data Validation Engine**
Implemented OCR and validation workflows to improve extraction accuracy and reduce missing or
inconsistent data.
* **Automated KYC Workflows**
Streamlined customer verification and compliance checks through automated identity and financial
data processing.
* **Credit Underwriting Integration**
Integrated extracted financial data into underwriting systems to accelerate credit decisioning and
risk assessment.
* **Compliance Document Management**
Enabled secure storage, classification, and retrieval of financial and identity documents for
audit and compliance requirements.
* **Workflow Automation and Reporting**
Automated document routing, review workflows, and operational reporting to improve visibility and
scalability.

# AI-Powered Financial Document Parsing Pipeline

## About the Client

The client is a financial services technology company focused on building a secure asset aggregation
platform. They needed to extract and standardize data from highly unstructured financial documents
such as fund statements, brokerage reports, and tax filings. Variability in document formats and
manual processing limitations impacted scalability, accuracy, and turnaround time. To address these
challenges, the organization partnered with Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

99.3% Data Extraction Accuracy Achieved
91% Reduction in Manual Data Entry Effort

## Business Challenges

The client relied on manual and semi-automated processes to extract data from diverse financial
documents, resulting in inconsistent outputs and increased operational overhead. Each document type
followed a different structure, making it difficult to standardize data for downstream processing.

The lack of a scalable parsing system led to delays in report generation, often taking multiple days
to process and validate data. This impacted customer experience and slowed decision-making
processes.

Ensuring data security and compliance was another critical concern. Sensitive financial data
required strict handling and tokenization to meet PCI-DSS standards, which added complexity to the
processing pipeline.

The client needed an intelligent, automated solution capable of handling document variability,
improving accuracy, and accelerating data processing while maintaining compliance.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed an AI-powered ETL pipeline that automated the extraction, transformation, and
standardization of financial data across hundreds of document formats. This significantly improved
efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
* **99.3% Data Extraction Accuracy Achieved**
* **91% Reduction in Manual Data Entry**
* **Report Generation Time Reduced from 3 Days to Under 4 Hours**
* **Standardized Data Across Hundreds of Document Formats**
* **PCI-DSS Compliant Tokenization of Sensitive Data**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr designed and implemented a scalable, AI-driven data processing pipeline tailored to financial
document parsing and secure data handling.
* **OCR-Based Data Extraction**
Leveraged advanced OCR techniques to accurately extract text from scanned and digital financial
documents.
* **NLP-Driven Entity Recognition**
Applied natural language processing models to identify and classify key financial entities across
varied document structures.
* **ML-Based Data Transformation**
Built machine learning models to normalize and map extracted data into a unified schema for
consistent downstream usage.
* **Unified Data Schema Design**
Standardized data across multiple document types to enable seamless integration with the asset
aggregation platform.
* **Secure Data Tokenization**
Implemented PCI-DSS compliant tokenization mechanisms to protect sensitive financial information.
* **Scalable ETL Pipeline Architecture**
Designed a high-performance pipeline capable of processing large volumes of documents efficiently
and reliably.

# Strategy and Solutions

Zymr partnered with the client to implement a robust AI-based fraud detection engine. Our data
science team developed real-time machine learning models using Python and AWS SageMaker, capable of
scoring transactions with high precision. We introduced anomaly detection techniques through
unsupervised learning models to flag irregular behavior across payment streams. To ensure
transparency, we integrated a SHAP-based explainable AI (XAI) layer that provided clear
justifications for each flagged transaction, satisfying both internal analysts and external
auditors. All transaction data was centralized into a Snowflake data lake, with Kafka pipelines
enabling real-time ingestion and scoring. We also enhanced the risk analysis process with a custom
React dashboard, offering visualizations of fraud patterns and risk profiles. APIs were integrated
directly into the client’s transaction processing system to ensure minimal disruption to live
operations.

# AI-Powered Fraud Detection Platform for a FinTech Payment Processor

## About the Client

A leading FinTech company delivering digital payment and real-time money transfer solutions across
North America. With millions of transactions processed daily, the client aimed to enhance its fraud
detection capabilities using AI while maintaining full PCI-DSS compliance.

## Key Outcomes

Real-time risk scoring was enabled across 1M+ daily transactions
The client achieved PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance with comprehensive logging and encryption.

## Business Challenges

The client’s existing rule-based fraud detection system was limited in scope, generating a high
volume of false positives and failing to adapt to new fraud patterns. Critical transaction data was
siloed across disparate systems, making real-time analytics and unified oversight nearly impossible.
Additionally, the client faced growing pressure from regulators and internal teams to explain fraud
decisions with greater clarity. The latency in alert generation further delayed incident response
and investigation, putting customer trust and compliance at risk.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

The client saw a 48% reduction in fraud-related financial losses within the first quarter of
deployment. Fraud detection accuracy rose to 92%, while false positives dropped by 60%. The
intuitive AI explanations reduced analyst workload and shortened investigation cycles significantly.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr partnered with the client to implement a robust AI-based fraud detection engine. Our data
science team developed real-time machine learning models using Python and AWS SageMaker, capable of
scoring transactions with high precision. We introduced anomaly detection techniques through
unsupervised learning models to flag irregular behavior across payment streams. To ensure
transparency, we integrated a SHAP-based explainable AI (XAI) layer that provided clear
justifications for each flagged transaction, satisfying both internal analysts and external
auditors. All transaction data was centralized into a Snowflake data lake, with Kafka pipelines
enabling real-time ingestion and scoring. We also enhanced the risk analysis process with a custom
React dashboard, offering visualizations of fraud patterns and risk profiles. APIs were integrated
directly into the client’s transaction processing system to ensure minimal disruption to live
operations.

# AI-Powered Knowledge Platform for a Global Professional Services Firm

## About the Client

A top-tier global professional services firm with over 100,000 consultants worldwide. The client
sought to revolutionize internal knowledge sharing and reuse by eliminating silos, reducing content
curation effort, and introducing intelligent access.

## Key Outcomes

Reduced new consultant onboarding time by 50%.
Flagged 20K+ outdated documents in the first quarter.

## Business Challenges

Knowledge assets were scattered across multiple portals, and search tools based on keywords
delivered low relevance. Content curation was manual, inconsistent, and time-consuming. Access
controls varied by region, increasing data leakage risk. The absence of intelligence led to repeated
work and hindered onboarding.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Document retrieval became 4x faster, improving consultant productivity. Knowledge reuse rose by 30%,
and GPT agents saw adoption in 80% of active teams. Data governance was strengthened with secure,
context-aware access controls.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr built a semantic AI-driven knowledge platform with RAG-based retrieval using Pinecone and
OpenAI embeddings. GPT-powered assistants were deployed for document Q&A, use case discovery, and
project support, integrated into Teams and Slack. LLMs tagged content upon upload and flagged
outdated files, while summarization pipelines extracted insights from documents. Azure AD was
integrated for RBAC and automated DLP checks ensured policy compliance. The platform adhered to GDPR
and ISO 27001 standards.

# AI-Powered Remote Cardiac Monitoring Platform Improves Early Cardiac Event Detection Across
# Distributed Patient Populations

## About the Client

The client is a digital health company focused on remote patient monitoring (RPM) solutions for
cardiovascular care. As demand for continuous cardiac monitoring increased, the organization needed
a scalable platform capable of monitoring patients outside traditional clinical settings while
minimizing alert fatigue for care teams. To support this initiative, the company partnered with
Zymr.

## Key Outcomes

90% Reduction in Non-Actionable Alerts
35% Faster Clinical Response to Critical Cardiac Events

## Business Challenges

The client needed a remote monitoring platform capable of continuously collecting and analyzing
cardiac telemetry data from wearable ECG devices across large patient populations. Existing
monitoring workflows generated excessive alert volumes, making it difficult for clinicians to
identify truly critical cardiac events.

Limited integration with provider systems created fragmented workflows and delayed clinical
interventions. Care teams lacked real-time visibility into patient status, while manual escalation
processes increased operational burden and response times.

The organization also required a scalable infrastructure capable of supporting thousands of
concurrent monitoring sessions while maintaining regulatory compliance and secure data exchange with
healthcare systems.

The client needed an intelligent RPM solution that could improve cardiac event detection, streamline
clinician workflows, and enable proactive intervention before acute episodes occurred.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr developed an AI-powered remote cardiac monitoring platform that combined continuous telemetry
streaming, automated arrhythmia detection, clinician escalation workflows, and seamless EHR
connectivity. The solution improved care team efficiency while enhancing visibility into patient
cardiac health.
* **90% Reduction in Non-Actionable Alerts**
* **35% Faster Clinical Response to Critical Cardiac Events**
* **24/7 Continuous Monitoring Across Distributed Patient Populations**
* **50% Improvement in Clinician Workflow Efficiency**
* **FHIR-Based Integration with Leading EHR Platforms**

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr engineered a scalable remote patient monitoring ecosystem designed to support continuous
cardiac surveillance and proactive care management.
* **Wearable ECG Monitoring Platform**
Developed a cloud-native platform for continuous collection and management of real-time ECG
telemetry data.
* **AI-Powered Arrhythmia Detection**
Implemented intelligent analytics workflows to identify potential arrhythmias and prioritize
clinically relevant events.
* **Real-Time Telemetry Streaming**
Enabled continuous cardiac data transmission with low-latency processing and monitoring
capabilities.
* **Clinician Escalation Workflows**
Automated alert routing and escalation pathways to ensure timely review of high-priority cardiac
events.
* **FHIR-Native EHR Integration**
Integrated monitoring data directly into provider EHR systems using FHIR standards for seamless
clinical workflows.
* **Scalable Patient Monitoring Infrastructure**
Built a secure and scalable architecture capable of supporting large-scale remote monitoring
programs while maintaining compliance and performance requirements.

# Strategy and Solutions

Our team developed a multi-tier Application Performance Management (APN) CloudTech product for
datacenter deployed enterprise application management. Resolve defined a multi-tiered implementation
architecture comprising four tiers. Tier-1 focused on UI and ecosystem connectivity, Tier-2 for
analytics, Tier-3 for data-collection and Tier-4 was for the underlying enterprise data centers,
wherein we delivered FCAPS monitoring services. The first phase focused on FM using SNMP, while the
second phase focused on log management and performance monitoring. We developed analysis using
Apache-Storm infrastructure, adding various metadata and rules-based smart correlation of faults,
events, alerts, etc. Our team created a comprehensive fault, system, and audit logging. We developed
the Jenkins and GitFlow based CI process with nightly builds, automated unit-testing, and system
testing, code-reviews, and regression testing, and Git was used as a repository. By creating a
comprehensive test plan for portions of the system, we were responsible for FCAPS, Analytics, and
Correlations of faults. We developed parts of the automated testing, primarily using Python, and
enabled integration with Resolve’s automation framework that was build using TestNG and Selenium.
Zymr continues to support customer trials and deployment in complex datacenter settings, with
hundreds of devices and applications.

# Strategy and Solutions

Zymr partnered with Alliander to deliver the first version of the client’s Smart Grid Energy Share
SaaS platform. We worked diligently to integrate the live Smart Grid management system with the
first few collective and member registrations. The second phase of this project was also assigned to
us, which included analytics using big data infrastructure, such as Amazon Elastic MapReduce.We
developed a UX-driven HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, and JS UI for dashboards and role-based access
control for Tenant Admin, Member, and System Admin. We implemented the core services using a
clustered MySQL database and integrated Joomla based web portal and CMS to enable the integration of
additional content to encourage social sharing among members and the client. Our team generated
comprehensive reports in PDF format for each of the participating members and collectives. The
subscriber service registered new energy collectives and members in the platform tier. Solar Grid
protocol connector gathered data from smart meters using proprietary REST APIs. We offered SMS based
notification service that pushed alerts on specific events during power generation and consumption
by each of the members in the energy collective.Our team extracted ETL tenant-specific and
member-specific data from the client’s Smart Solar Grid management system and parsed the data into
specific real-time and historical records. We generated carbon credits as a means to encourage
alternative carbon-free energy generation. We used Agile development processes, i.e., Jira.
Continuous Integration developed using Jenkins and SVN for software repository. We also developed a
comprehensive test plan using Rally and executed most tests manually with some automated scripts in
Python.

# Alliander Smart Grid Energy Share App

## About the Client

Alliander is a utility and energy network company, which distributes electricity and natural gas to
a large part of the Netherlands. As ‘Energy is everywhere’, Alliander has initiated a program called
Energy Share, which allows alternative energy generation through solar panels to be rewarded through
its smart grid.

## Key Outcomes

Developed Alliander's Smart Grid Energy Share SaaS platform for solar energy credit disbursement.
Created analytics reports of client’s Smart Solar credits and rebates.

## Business Challenges

Alliander was facing tracking issues. They wanted a real-time portal to track energy share credits
generated by the solar energy cooperatives that power Liander’s SmartGrid. They intended to create a
rich UX-driven SaaS web portal to present energy use and generation data in real-time to its solar
energy cooperatives and their members.,

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Alliander wanted to build a comprehensive real-time portal to easily track the energy share credits
generated by the solar energy cooperatives that power Liander’s SmartGrid. As data related to energy
share played a crucial role in their business, they needed a rich UX driven SaaS web portal to
present energy use and generation data in real-time to its solar energy cooperatives and their
members. Alliander had specific requirements in the SaaS platform viz. ability to register a new
energy collective (i.e., tenant), data ETL and analysis of tenant and sub-tenant data, member Energy
Share dashboard and reports, and a marketplace for trading energy credits.

## Strategy and Solutions

Zymr partnered with Alliander to deliver the first version of the client’s Smart Grid Energy Share
SaaS platform. We worked diligently to integrate the live Smart Grid management system with the
first few collective and member registrations. The second phase of this project was also assigned to
us, which included analytics using big data infrastructure, such as Amazon Elastic MapReduce.We
developed a UX-driven HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, and JS UI for dashboards and role-based access
control for Tenant Admin, Member, and System Admin. We implemented the core services using a
clustered MySQL database and integrated Joomla based web portal and CMS to enable the integration of
additional content to encourage social sharing among members and the client. Our team generated
comprehensive reports in PDF format for each of the participating members and collectives. The
subscriber service registered new energy collectives and members in the platform tier. Solar Grid
protocol connector gathered data from smart meters using proprietary REST APIs. We offered SMS based
notification service that pushed alerts on specific events during power generation and consumption
by each of the members in the energy collective.Our team extracted ETL tenant-specific and
member-specific data from the client’s Smart Solar Grid management system and parsed the data into
specific real-time and historical records. We generated carbon credits as a means to encourage
alternative carbon-free energy generation. We used Agile development processes, i.e., Jira.
Continuous Integration developed using Jenkins and SVN for software repository. We also developed a
comprehensive test plan using Rally and executed most tests manually with some automated scripts in
Python.

## Benefits of Choosing Vue.js Development

Vue.js delivers a combination of performance, flexibility, and developer efficiency that makes it a
strong choice for both startup MVPs and enterprise-scale platforms. Each benefit below connects
directly to measurable development and business outcomes.

[Solutions for Doctors]

### Seamless Integration with Existing Systems

Vue.js is designed for incremental adoption, meaning it can be introduced into specific sections of
an existing application without requiring a full rebuild. This makes it ideal for modernizing legacy
frontends in stages, reducing both migration risk and upfront cost.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### Faster Time to Market

Vue.js’s single-file component structure, intuitive reactivity model, and comprehensive CLI tooling
reduce setup and feature delivery time compared to more opinionated JavaScript frameworks. Teams can
prototype, test, and ship production features faster without sacrificing maintainability.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Scalable Component-Based Architecture

Vue 3’s Composition API enables developers to organize logic by feature rather than lifecycle hook,
making large codebases easier to navigate, test, and scale. Components are reusable across views,
reducing duplication and accelerating development as your product grows.

[Solutions for Doctors]

### High-Performance Reactive UI

Vue 3’s overhauled rendering engine and Proxy-based reactivity system deliver faster virtual DOM
diffing and smaller bundle sizes than Vue 2. The result is a noticeably more responsive interface,
particularly in applications with complex, data-heavy UI layers.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### AI-Ready and Future-Proof Framework

Vue.js integrates cleanly with OpenAI APIs, streaming data feeds, and WebSocket-driven real-time
interfaces, making it a natural fit for AI-augmented applications. Our ChatGPT developers and Vue.js
engineers combine these capabilities within a single reactive frontend architecture.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Reduced Development and Maintenance Cost

Vue.js’s shallow learning curve, comprehensive documentation, and reusable component model lower
both initial build cost and long-term maintenance overhead. Its first-class TypeScript support in
Vue 3 further reduces production bugs and accelerates developer onboarding.

generic mold. Here is what businesses gain when they invest in software built specifically for their
workflows, data, and customers.

Custom software grows with your team, customer base, and product roadmap without licensing tier
limits. You add modules, users, and integrations on your timeline, not a vendor’s release schedule.

[Medical Firm]

### Full Ownership of Code and IP

You own 100% of the source code, architecture, and intellectual property from the first commit.
There is no vendor lock-in, no per-seat licensing, and no risk of features disappearing in a future
update.

[Yoga & Gyms]

### Integration With Your Existing Systems

Custom solutions plug into your existing CRM, ERP, accounting tools, and data warehouses through
purpose-built APIs. No more juggling disconnected platforms or paying for middleware to bridge data
gaps.

[Physiotherapy Center]

### Stronger Security and Compliance Control

Custom software lets you define exact security protocols, audit trails, and data residency rules for
your environment. Regulated industries gain compliance certainty that off-the-shelf tools cannot
guarantee out of the box.

[Medical Firm]

### Long-Term ROI Over SaaS Subscriptions

Custom software has a higher upfront cost but eliminates recurring per-user fees that compound over
the years. For teams above 50 users, ROI typically arrives within 18 to 24 months and accelerates
after that.

[Yoga & Gyms]

### Adaptable to Process and Technology Changes

Your software evolves as your business model, regulations, and customer expectations change.
Engineers add features, refine workflows, and [modernize legacy systems][105] without waiting for
vendor permission or roadmap alignment.

## Types of POS Software We Develop

We build every common POS form factor used in retail, restaurants, and hospitality. The choice

[Solutions for Doctors]

### Cloud-Based POS Software

Cloud POS runs on remote servers and works in both online and offline modes. Stores stay operational
during outages and sync transactions once connected. Owners can access analytics, reports, and
inventory from any device. The model fits multi-store retailers, restaurant chains, and franchises.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### Mobile POS Software

Mobile POS turns smartphones and tablets into full point-of-sale stations. Staff can take orders,
accept payments, and update inventory from the floor. Our [Odoo development][83] team also builds
Odoo-based mobile POS for distributed teams. The build supports both iOS and Android.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Terminal POS Software

Terminal POS combines a fixed register, receipt printer, cash drawer, and customer display. The
setup suits supermarkets, full-service restaurants, and pharmacies. We build terminal POS that runs
offline and syncs when the network returns. Hardware integration covers most major terminal
manufacturers.

[Physiotherapy Center]

### Self-Service Kiosk POS Software

Self-service kiosk POS lets customers order and pay without staff assistance. The format works for
QSRs, cinemas, parking lots, and retail self-checkout. We build kiosk software with accessibility
features and multi-language support. Each kiosk syncs orders to the kitchen or fulfillment system in
real time.

[Medical Firm]

### Tablet POS Software

Tablet POS suits cafes, juice bars, salons, and small retail stores with limited counter space. The
hardware investment is lower than a full terminal setup. Our team builds tablet POS for iPad and
Android tablets. Offline mode keeps the service running through internet drops.

[Yoga & Gyms]

### Online and Web POS Software

Web POS runs in a browser and centralizes data across all retail channels. The model suits
eCommerce-first brands adding physical retail. The setup requires no installation on store devices
and supports any operating system. Pop-up stores and seasonal events benefit from rapid
browser-based deployment.
