Is HealthArc platform secure and compliant with privacy regulations?

Our digital health platform prioritizes patient privacy and complies with relevant healthcare data
protection regulations. Robust security measures are in place to safeguard patient information,
ensuring confidentiality and adherence to privacy standards. In addition, we are also HIPAA and SOC2
compliant.

Does your digital health platform seamlessly integrate with an existing EHR?

We know that the electronic health record is the heart of your health IT infrastructure. Our
platform fosters seamless communication with the EHR and is essential for making information
accessible to patients and providers alike.

What are common patient data types collected via HealthArc platform?

Providers can use our platform to collect a range of patient health data, including blood pressure,
vital signs, weight, heart rate, blood sugar levels, and physical activity.

Does your platform offer 24/7 access to patients and providers?

HealthArc simplifies your workflow with our integrated unified platform, seamlessly incorporating
remote patient data for effortless monitoring in conjunction with other remote care programs like
Chronic Care Management (CCM), Principal Care Management (PCM), Transitional Care Management (TCM),
and more.

Does your health platform offer privacy and data security?

You can rely on HealthArc's commitment to maintaining the highest standards of privacy and data
security including FDA-approved devices, HIPAA compliance and SOC2 certification among others,
ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of patient information. It's part of our dedication to
your peace of mind.

      * [Certification of Health IT][5]
        
        Ensures health IT meets standards for functionality, security, and interoperability.
      * [Information Blocking][6]
        
        Regulations ensuring health data is shared appropriately without improper barriers.
      * [Interoperability][7]
        
        Enables secure and seamless exchange of electronic health information among authorized

        Advises on policies, standards, and implementation specifications for health data and
        technology.
      * [United States Core Data for Interoperability (USCDI)][9]
        
        Offers a standardized set of health data classes and constituent data elements for
        nationwide, interoperable health information exchange.
      * [Trusted Exchange Framework & Common Agreement (TEFCA)][10]
        
        Operates as a nationwide framework for the interoperability of electronic health
        information.

        internal governance, and much more.

        Explore the roles of health information and technology in broad healthcare settings,
        supporting seamless, coordinated patient care from prevention through recovery.

      * [Behavioral Health][14]
        
        Health information, policies, and technology supporting integrated care for mental health
        and substance use disorders.
      * [Emergency Medical Services][15]
        
        Rapid response and communication during health emergencies through health information and
        technology.
      * [Long-Term & Post-Acute Care][16]
        
        Health information and technology facilitating coordinated care beyond acute settings.
      * [Maternal & Pediatric Care][17]
        
        Technology addressing unique health needs of mothers and children.
      * [Pharmacy & PDMP][18]
        
        Electronic tools tracking controlled substance prescriptions to improve patient safety.
      * [Public Health][19]
        
        Using health information and technology to prevent disease, diagnose health conditions, and
        promote population health.
      * ### Clinical Topics

Helping the world’s leading healthcare and biopharma companies with digital health strategy, deep
research and inspirational content.  We believe digital delight is the crux to move to a world where

[ Schedule a call today ][34]

## Services

Get your digital health strategy on the right track, fast.

Uniquely qualified in digital, biology and medicine, we help clients see the digital health
landscape with greater clarity, to sharpen strategy and bring delightful products and services to
market faster. 

How we work with you

databases of certified digital health solutions.

align strategy, make decisions and launch projects.

innovations that work for life sciences and providers.

### Delight Thinking

Our Delight Thinking method helps you discover - and execute on - opportunities for reducing
frictions in healthcare and delighting patients, providers and payers.

### 720 ° perspective

We use lateral thinking and creative processes to generate strategic insights and surprising
non-obvious solutions.

### Connected

With strong academic and industry backgrounds, we’re well connected in the ecosystem - essential to
turn ideas into reality.

### Igniters

Our keynote presentations inspire professional audiences, both large and small, and our creative
workshops deliver novel solutions.

# Who we are

Helpware is built to help the world’s most innovative brands scale faster, smarter, and more
sustainably. We combine the precision of AI-enabled BPM with the dedication of world-class teams to
deliver measurable results across customer experience, technology, and growth marketing. Our
approach is simple: the right people, the right process, powered by the right technology, working
seamlessly to transform your business.

[AI is the ]
AI is the **telemetry.**
[Our people are the ]
Our people are the **core mechanics.**
[background decoration]
Strategy is the **track. **

## What sets us apart

We do what we say, focus on what we know best, and always make sure we do it well.

### Scalability

We’re built to scale, with 19 locations worldwide and the flexibility to expand wherever our clients
need.

### People first

People are the heart of our story. We believe in them, invest in their growth, and build teams that
deliver.

### Holistic growth

We created a BPM model where all divisions work together to design and deliver end-to-end
transformation.

### Lasting trust

Clients stay because we’re dedicated, transparent, and agile—adapting, evolving, and building trust
that lasts for years.

Mission Vision

## Our Mission

To transform how businesses operate by seamlessly blending human expertise with AI innovation,
delivering measurable results that elevate customer experience, drive efficiency, and power
sustainable growth.

## Our Vision

To be the most trusted global partner for businesses seeking to grow smarter through the perfect
harmony of human talent and intelligent automation.

#### Create impact

Every moment is a chance to contribute where it counts.

#### Never stop innovating

We’re wired for growth—in mindset, processes, and technology.

#### Share contagious positivity

We spread positivity in everything we touch. Joy is part of our process.

#### Leverage amazing people

We protect our culture and lead from our core.

#### Proud of the “Why”

We’re driven by integrity. Behind every interaction is a reason we’re proud of.

#### Always find a path

We do what we say we’ll do for our partners.

#### Be attuned and sensitive

We stay focused on the needs of our stakeholders.

## Our Story

Behind every milestone is a team, an idea, and the drive that made it real.

2015
**Starting Line** — October

#### Helpware gets the green light

Fueled by a startup spirit and a bold vision to empower customer interactions across the globe,
founders Andy Steuer, Alex Tereshchenko, and Thomas Cornelius fire the engines for the first time.
Mission clear. Let’s race.

[Group of Helpware employees wearing branded t-shirts with the slogan 'We've got your back']
2016
**Lap 1** — January

#### First client project rolled out in Kyiv, Ukraine

The first corner is smooth—We land our first client and open the Kyiv delivery center. It’s the
beginning of long-term, strategic partnerships powered by exceptional performance.

**Lap 2** — January

#### Expansion to Manila, Philippines

Punching the accelerator, we enter the Philippines circuit—a global BPO powerhouse. Manila becomes a
key locale on the track to global delivery, bringing in world-class talent.

2018
**Lap 3** — December

#### Taskware digital experience platform adopted

Fueled by a startup spirit and a bold vision to empower customer interactions across the globe,
founders Andy Steuer, Alex Tereshchenko, and Thomas Cornelius fire the engines for the first time.
Mission clear. Let’s race.

[Man in a blue shirt speaking at a conference]
2019
**Lap 4** — May

#### Nearshoring accelerated in Guadalajara, Mexico

We add a nearshore delivery center in Guadalajara, enabling us to spread support across three
continents and over 25 languages.

2020
**Pit stop** — February

#### Leadership shifted into overdrive

Mid-race strategy shift. Robert Nash jumps into the cockpit as CEO, and Nick Mannella joins as CRO.
The team fine-tunes our US service delivery from a Kentucky hub, bringing domestic muscle to the
international race.

**Lap 5** — September

#### Entered EU market

With our Berlin hub fired up, we hit the European BPO track at full throttle. The race heats up with
fast expansions into Poland, Albania, and Georgia.

2021
**Lap 6** — May

#### Launched Cebu, Philippine hub

We double down in the Philippines, firing up our second engine in Cebu to expand our APAC bandwidth
and elevate delivery excellence.

[Modern, open-concept office space with employees working on laptops]
2022
**Lap 7** — January

#### Launched Puerto Rico hub & spoke and Virginia site

From the Caribbean curve to the East Coast straightaway, we boost our North American reach with a
hybrid model that connects agility and proximity.

**Pit stop** — January

#### Recapitalized with Eir Partners

Time to refuel with a majority recapitalization by Eir Partners. With fresh capital, a shared
vision, and global reach, the team gears up to scale faster and serve the Fortune 5000.

2023
**Lap 8** — January

#### Entered African market in Kampala, Uganda

A new continent, a new chapter. Our Uganda launch ignites our presence in Africa and unlocks talent
across emerging global markets.

[Engaged audience listening to a speaker]
2024
**Lap 9** — October

#### Helpware.Tech slipstreamed into the race

We rev up with eTeam and Unicsoft acquisitions, bringing high-performance software and digital
innovation under the hood. The launch of Helpware.Tech grows the team—built for speed, geared for
impact, and ready to lead the tech race.

**Lap 10** — October 16

#### Guam hub launched

On the edge of the Pacific track, we launch our Guam site—a global gateway and a new gear in the
Helpware high-speed expansion machine.

# Accelerating Lending Operations with AWS Cloud Intelligence and Automation

Mid-sized Non-QM lender modernizes with AWS cloud, streamlining lending, reducing risks, and
improving customer service and compliance.

[ Let's Connect ][16]
[case-study-default]

## Table of Contents
* [Background][17]
* [Target Customer Profiles][18]
* [Challenge][19]
* [Solution][20]
* [Why AWS & HyScaler][21]
* [Customer Engagement Process][22]
* [Results][23]
* [Conclusion][24]

## Background

A mid-sized Non-QM (Non-Qualified Mortgage) lender processing 150+ loans monthly operates within the
$12T+ mortgage industry. Competing with 100+ Non-QM lenders offering complex loan programs, the
company faced inefficiencies in loan origination, compliance risks, and slow customer response
times. Loan officers relied on outdated PDFs for program guidelines, hindering accurate borrower
matching and creating operational bottlenecks.

The lender sought a scalable AWS digital lending platform to modernize operations through
cloud-based loan management software that centralizes loan program intelligence, automates
qualification extraction, and enhances customer experience.

## Target Customer Profiles

### Non-QM Lenders:
* Example: Mid-sized mortgage firms managing diverse loan programs
* Needs:Automated loan qualification, faster loan processing, CFPB compliance
* Persona: Operations Manager at a regional lender adopting AWS

### Fintech Startups:
* Example: Digital lending platforms offering alternative financing
* Needs: Scalable lending management system, real-time analytics, SOC 2 compliance
* Persona: CTO at a fintech with AWS accounts

### Credit Unions:
* Example: Community-based organizations expanding loan portfolios
* Needs: Cost-efficient loan processing automation, legacy system integration, enhanced borrower
experience
* Persona: IT Director at a credit union seeking AWS lending [software development][25]

## Challenge

The lender faced critical obstacles in its legacy loan origination system:
* **Knowledge Fragmentation**: Over 50 loan qualifiers (DTI, LTV, credit scores) across 200+
programs were scattered in PDFs, relying on tribal knowledge.
* **Manual Inefficiencies**: Loan officers spent 65% of their time extracting guidelines, delaying
approvals, and increasing errors in the lending management system.
* **Scalability Constraints**: On-premises systems couldn’t handle growing loan volumes or frequent
program updates, limiting market expansion.
* **Compliance Risks**: Manual processes lacked audit trails, risking non-compliance with CFPB and
data privacy regulations.
* **Poor Collaboration**: Siloed communication between loan officers, underwriters, and borrowers
slowed decision-making and degraded customer experience.
* **Data Accessibility**: Inefficient search across program documents hampered real-time borrower
matching.

The company needed an automated lending platform to streamline workflows, ensure compliance, and
scale operations effectively.

## Solution

Partnering with HyScaler, the lender deployed an AWS digital lending platform powered by advanced
AWS services:
* **AI-Driven Knowledge Base**: Using [AWS Bedrock][26] and multiple LLMs (Claude, Llama), the
platform extracted 50+ qualifiers from lender documents with 95% accuracy, validated through
human-in-the-loop workflows.
* **Scalable Infrastructure**: Built on Amazon EC2 instances for 99.9% uptime, Amazon RDS
(PostgreSQL) with AES-256 encryption for secure data, and Amazon S3 for document storage.
* **Message Queuing**: Amazon SQS enabled asynchronous processing of program updates and borrower
data, integrating seamlessly with legacy CRM systems.
* **Search Optimization**: Amazon OpenSearch Service delivered sub-second searches across loan
programs, enhancing borrower matching.
* **Caching Strategy**: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) reduced database load by 60%, improving
application performance.
* **Analytics Dashboard**: Amazon RedShift and QuickSight provided real-time insights into loan
processing, compliance, and performance metrics.
* **Collaboration Hub**: LendConnect, a Slack-like tool, fostered communication among loan officers
and included a lender rating system for community-driven insights.
* **CI/CD Pipeline**: [GitLab][27] CI and Amazon ECR automated code testing and deployment to EC2,
ensuring rapid updates.
* **Borrower Portal**: A web and mobile app with US-specific formatting (MM-DD-YYYY) and e-payment
support improved borrower engagement.

This digital lending automation AWS solution created a scalable, secure, and intelligent loan
management software.

[AWS Powered Lending Management System Diagram]

## Why AWS & HyScaler

AWS was selected for its robust AWS financial services cloud solutions, offering scalability, SOC 2
compliance, and AI/ML capabilities via Bedrock. Services like EC2, SQS, OpenSearch, and ElastiCache
ensured high availability and performance.

HyScaler’s expertise in AWS lending software development and Non-QM lending delivered a tailored
automated lending platform. With 5+ years of AWS deployments and 10+ fintech projects, HyScaler
ensured rapid implementation.

The cloud architecture and pay-as-you-go model reduced costs by 40% compared to on-premises
solutions. HyScaler’s [CI/CD pipelines][28], legacy integration via SQS, and regional optimizations
(US-specific compliance) drove operational excellence and borrower satisfaction.

## Customer Engagement Process

Structured 12-week engagement (Scope-Define-Implement-Deliver-Conclude).
* **Scope (Weeks 1-2):** Defined workflows, compliance needs, and AWS infrastructure via stakeholder
workshops.
* **Define (Weeks 3-4):** Designed EC2 architecture, RDS schema, and CFPB compliance plan; secured
approval.
* **Implement (Weeks 5-8):** Deployed Dockerized Angular app on EC2, configured RDS/SQS, tested for
99.9% uptime.
* **Deliver (Weeks 9-10):** Conducted UAT, trained staff on the platform, and provided compliance
documentation.
* **Conclude (Weeks 11-12):** Handed over to IT with 30-day support; collected feedback via closure
meeting.
* **Post-Handover:** Quarterly reviews to assess impacts (50% cost reduction, 95% accuracy
improvement).

### Delivery Mechanisms:

* **Technical Consultants:** Deep expertise in EC2, RDS, Bedrock AI services, and SOC 2 compliance
frameworks.
* **Full Stack Developers:** Fintech-certified specialists skilled in Angular, AI/ML integration,
and Non-QM lending domain knowledge.
* **Project Managers:** Coordinated engagement phases, stakeholder feedback, and risk mitigation

### Technical Capabilities and Experience:
* **AWS Expertise:** 5+ years deploying AWS financial services solutions; 10+ lending platform
projects using EC2, RDS, Bedrock, and SQS.
* **Application Proficiency:** 3+ years developing Angular-based lending management systems, with
demonstrated efficiency improvements.
* **Compliance Track Record:** Successful delivery of SOC 2 and CFPB compliance audits for lending

* **Customer Success:** Successfully deployed lending platforms for 12+ financial industries and
Non-QM lenders, maintaining high customer satisfaction
* **Certifications:** Team holds 15+ AWS certifications, including Solutions Architect, [AI/ML][29]

## Results

The AWS digital lending platform delivered transformative outcomes:
* **Efficiency Gains**: Reduced program onboarding time drastically, freeing loan officers to focus
more on client engagement.
* **Accuracy**: Achieved highly reliable qualifier extraction, lowering compliance risks
significantly.
* **Search Performance**: Sub-second program searches via OpenSearch improved borrower matching and
decision speed.
* **Application Speed**: ElastiCache accelerated system responsiveness, enhancing the borrower and
officer experience.
* **Cost Savings**: Shift to AWS cloud infrastructure lowered operational costs substantially.
* **Scalability**:Seamlessly supported growing loan volumes and frequent program updates without
extra infrastructure investment.
* **Customer Satisfaction**: Borrower portal adoption grew considerably, reducing inquiries and
improving overall satisfaction.
* **Collaboration**: LendConnect enhanced team productivity through streamlined real-time
communication.
* **Compliance**: Achieved full SOC 2 compliance with CloudTrail audit logs.
* **System Reliability**: Optimized caching reduced database loads, strengthening performance
stability.

## Conclusion

The AWS-powered lending platform, deployed by HyScaler, revolutionized the lender’s operations,

market leader.

The AI-driven intelligence, optimized search, and LendConnect hub set a new standard for lending

The lender plans to expand the platform to support new loan types, reinforcing its competitive edge.
Other organizations can adopt AWS lending software development to drive innovation and customer
value.

# Specialty Clinic EMR Development Service: AWS-Powered Modern Healthcare Solutions

Specialty clinic EMR enhances compliance, billing, and performance with legacy device integration,
eClaims automation, and patient engagement.

[ Let's Connect ][16]
[IVF]

## Table of Contents
* [Background][17]
* [Challenge][18]
* [Solution][19]
* [Why AWS & HyScaler][20]
* [Results][21]
* [Conclusion][22]

## Background

Specialty clinic EMR managing 200+ patients monthly faced challenges with inefficient workflows,
non-compliant patient records, legacy device integration, delayed eClaims, and inaccurate billing.
The clinic sought an AWS-based solution to enhance scalability, security, and compliance, leveraging
its existing AWS infrastructure.

### Target Customer Profiles
* **Healthcare Providers**:
* Example: Specialty clinics or hospitals needing secure patient record management.
* Needs: HIPAA-compliant PHI handling, 30% faster workflows, NetSuite integration.
* Example Persona: IT Director at a 500-bed hospital adopting AWS.
* **Telehealth Platforms**:
* Example: Telemedicine providers integrating EMR with billing.
* Needs: PDPA-compliant records, eClaims automation, and scalability.
* Example Persona: Clinical Director at a regional telehealth service.
* **Research Organizations**:
* Example: Fertility research institutes managing patient data.
* Needs: Advanced reporting, legacy device support, and cost efficiency.
* Example Persona: CTO at a research institute with AWS accounts.

## Challenge
* Ensure PDPA-compliant patient record management with deep audit logs.
* Integrate legacy medical devices using AWS services.
* Automate eClaims processing and deliver advanced billing analytics.
* Adapt to local standards (e.g., DD-MM-YYYY, SGD/MYR/PHP).
* Enable fast, efficient search across patient records and medical data.
* Optimize application performance through intelligent caching strategies.

## Solution

HyScaler deployed an AWS-powered Specialty EMR solution using the following services:
* **AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)**: Hosted a scalable, Dockerized Angular SPA, ensuring
99.9% uptime with managed node groups and multi-AZ resilience.
* **Amazon RDS (MySQL)**: Designed a scalable database with real-time audit trails, encrypted with
AES-256 for PDPA compliance.
* **Amazon ECR (Elastic Container Registry)**: Stored and managed [Docker][23] container images
securely, enabling seamless container deployment and version management.
* **Amazon SQS (Simple Queue Service)**: Facilitated reliable message queuing for asynchronous
processing of medical device data integration via DICOM/HL7 protocols and inter-service
communication.
* **Amazon S3**: Stored secure Consent and Printout forms, integrated with local print label formats
for sample tracking.
* **Amazon OpenSearch Service**: Implemented AWS-managed Elasticsearch for efficient, real-time
search capabilities across patient records, medical histories, and treatment data, enabling
healthcare professionals to quickly locate critical information.
* **Amazon ElastiCache Redis OSS**: Deployed AWS-managed Redis for intelligent caching,
significantly reducing database load and improving application response times for frequently
accessed patient data and session management.
* **AWS CloudWatch**: Monitored application health, providing alerts for performance and compliance,
aligned with CIS v1.4 controls.
* **Amazon RedShift and QuickSight**: Built a powerful analytics dashboard with customizable
reporting, supporting SGD/MYR/PHP currencies.
* **AWS IAM and Security Hub**: Enforced least-privilege access and generated CIS v1.4 compliance
reports, ensuring robust security.
* **GitLab CI**: Implemented continuous integration and deployment pipeline for automated code
testing, building, and deployment to [EKS][24] clusters.
* **Prescription Automation**: Integrated Mdtoolbox/NetSuite API for automated prescription
management, streamlining medication ordering and inventory synchronization.
* **Statements Automation**: Implemented Postgrid API integration for automated patient statement
generation and delivery, reducing manual administrative overhead.
* **Patient Portal**: Developed comprehensive patient engagement solutions including web-based
portal and native Android/iOS mobile applications, enabling seamless patient-clinic communication,
appointment scheduling, and access to medical records. The solution incorporated local features
like DD-MM-YYYY formatting, e-wallet payment support, and enhanced patient engagement through
multi-platform accessibility.

# RAG Development: Building Intelligent Retrieval-Augmented Systems

Explore RAG development to build intelligent retrieval-augmented systems for efficient AI-driven
information processing.

[ Let's Connect ][16]
[RAG Development]

## Table of Contents
* [Background][17]
* [Challenges][18]
* [Solution: Empowering On-Premise RAG Development for Secure Document Management][19]
* [RAG Development: A Game-Changing Approach.][20]

## Background

In today’s data-overloaded world, decision-making frequently comes to a halt as firms drown in
sensitive, unstructured information—HR laws, legal contracts, financial reports, and operational
instructions dispersed over PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, and scanned photos.

A significant organization, irritated with delayed information retrieval, variable search accuracy,
and security flaws, collaborated with HyScaler to deploy a cutting-edge RAG development platform.

A significant corporation, dissatisfied by delayed retrieval and security risks, collaborated with
HyScaler to design cutting-edge [RAG][25].

The on-premise Retrieval-Augmented Generation system was intended to:
* Integrate multiple data forms (PDFs, Word Docs, spreadsheets, and scanned photos).
* Enable AI-powered, natural language search for rapid and exact results.
* Maintain data security by performing all processing within the organization’s network.

By transforming static data into dynamic, searchable knowledge assets, the RAG solution enabled
employees to get correct, context-rich information in seconds, increasing productivity, compliance,
and decision-making speed.

This RAG development project not only reduced data silos, but it also transformed disparate
organizational knowledge into a secure, intelligent resource for all departments.

[RAG Structure and RAG Development]

## Challenges

### **1. Inefficient Document Retrieval**
* Employees had to manually sift through large files, leading to delays and productivity loss.
* Lack of semantic search meant keyword-based queries often returned irrelevant results.

### **2. Security & Compliance Risks**
* Handling confidential data required strict access controls and encryption.
* The organization needed to comply with GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001.

### **3. On-Premise Operation Without Internet Dependency**
* The AI system had to function entirely within the company’s private network.
* No reliance on external APIs or cloud-based AI models was allowed.

### **4. Performance Bottlenecks & Scalability**
* The existing infrastructure struggled with slow data retrieval due to bottlenecks.
* The system needed to be scalable, handling increasing volumes of documents efficiently.

## Solution: Empowering On-Premise RAG Development for Secure Document Management

To address the organization’s difficulties, HyScaler created a sophisticated on-premise [RAG
development][26] solution that provides lightning-fast, safe, and compliant document access.

This transformational solution focused on data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance while
remaining wholly within the organization’s private network. The approach aims to speed up document
retrieval by using natural language search to provide precise results, improving employee access to
essential information.
* **Accelerate Document Retrieval:** Harness natural language search to deliver instant,
pinpoint-accurate results, transforming how employees access critical information.
* **Strengthen Access Control:** To protect sensitive data, implement role-based access control
(RBAC), which ensures that only authorized users can access confidential information.
* **Ensure zero cloud dependency: **Operate seamlessly on an entirely intranet-based infrastructure,
removing reliance on external systems for unrivaled security.
* **Master Diverse Data Types:** Process structured and unstructured data using powerful [OCR][27],
[NLP][28], and AI-driven search to extract insights from PDFs, Word files, and scanned images.

## RAG Development: A Game-Changing Approach.

HyScaler’s RAG development transformed document management by combining retrieval and generation for
exact, dependable outcomes, overcoming the constraints of pre-trained AI models:
* **Decode User Intent:** The technology intelligently interprets natural language inquiries,
extracting context and returning highly relevant responses.
* **Pinpoint Critical Content:** Using vector search engines such as Weaviate, it quickly returns
the most relevant document portions, sifting through data clutter.
* **Deliver Fact-Based Answers:** Retrieved content powers the AI model, ensuring that responses are
accurate, grounded, and devoid of errors.
* **Build trust through transparency:** Every AI-generated response contains unambiguous document
citations, empowering users to verify information with confidence.

### **Outcome of RAG **Development
* **More Accurate AI Responses: **Ensured fact-based and contextually relevant answers.
* **Faster Document Retrieval:** Employees no longer had to manually search through documents.

### **Security & Compliance Measures**
* **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):** Integrated with LDAP/Active Directory to restrict document
access.
* **Encryption Standards:**
* Used AES-256 encryption for data at rest.
* Used TLS encryption for secure internal communications.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensured adherence to GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 policies.

### **Deployment Strategy (Fully On-Premise, No Cloud Services)**
* Containerization with Kubernetes/OpenShift for secure and scalable deployment.
* Backend optimization with FastAPI to handle high-speed document queries.

### **User Interface & Experience**
* I**ntuitive Web Interface**
* Designed a React.js/Vue.js frontend with a chat-based AI assistant.
* **Advanced Search Features**
* Natural language search (e.g., “What is our company’s leave policy?”).
* Auto-complete, filtering, and saved searches for efficiency.
* **Document Preview & Citation Features**
* Users could preview retrieved documents before using AI-generated responses.
* AI-generated answers included citations for validation.

### **Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement**
* **Real-time dashboards with Grafana/Kibana to monitor:**
* Query performance
* System latency
* User engagement trends
* **User Feedback Loop:**
* Employees provided feedback to continuously refine AI responses.
* **Security Audits:**
* Periodic audits maintained compliance and data security.

## Competitive Landscape

Competitors in the RAG development field have sophisticated enterprise solutions, but HyScaler
stands out for its wholly on-premise, personalized approach.

Some offer RAG-enabled document management with local embeddings, prioritizing privacy in domains
such as finance and law, and delivering semantic inquiries without revealing data.

Others focus on conversational access to improve traceability, but they frequently prefer
ecosystem-based solutions over tight intranet isolation.

Solutions that use Knowledge Graph RAG excel at processing multimodal data, such as complex images
in manuals, with great accuracy.

Other options include open-source frameworks for flexible RAG deployment in document-heavy systems,
conversational AI pipelines, and contextual search for knowledge chatbots built on .NET. Vector
databases are used by some to handle data in a modular, multi-modal manner.

Although these offer robust security and retrieval, HyScaler’s RAG development stands out for its
smooth integration of role-based controls, OCR, and NLP.

It is designed for zero-cloud situations and has a straightforward UI that completely transforms the
user experience.

## Results & Impact

[Before and After RAG Deployment Table ]
* **Enhanced Productivity:** Search times dropped significantly, enabling employees to find accurate
information in seconds, streamlining workflows and decision-making.
* **Robust Security: **RBAC and encryption ensured zero unauthorized access, maintaining full
compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001.
* **Scalable Performance:** The system handled growing document volumes effortlessly, with minimal
latency and near-perfect uptime.
* **AI-Driven Efficiency:** Semantic search improved result accuracy, while AI chatbots resolved
most queries instantly, freeing up staff time. Predictive analytics optimized document indexing,
reducing retrieval delays.
[Results & Impact]

## Conclusion

HyScaler’s on-premise RAG AI solution revolutionized the organization’s document management,
empowering employees with instant, accurate access to critical information.

By combining GraphQL, FastAPI, React, and advanced AI/ML within a secure, intranet-based system, we
eliminated inefficiencies, ensured compliance, and future-proofed operations.

This project showcases HyScaler’s ability to deliver impactful, secure, and scalable solutions,
helping organizations thrive in a data-driven world.

Their platform offers a range of services, including revenue cycle management, medical coding, and clinical documentation, aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, maximizing revenue, and improving patient care experiences for health systems and medical groups. With a focus on reducing administrative burdens and fostering financial sustainability, IKS Health empowers care teams to deliver exceptional healthcare outcomes.

# Leadership Team

Intelegain’s leadership spans countless years of experience in Management, Entrepreneurship,
Operations, Consulting, Technology Innovation, Software Implementation, and Business Strategy.
[Let's Talk][85]
Kapil Chopra
CEO

Kapil is a digital entreprenur having 25 years of experience in various roles such as CEO, founder,
investor and mentor. He has helped businesses grow and succeed in the digital space by providing
them with strategic guidance, marketing expertise, technology solutions and proactive leadership.

As CEO of Intelegain Technologies, he leads the vision and direction of the company across five
entities and locations: Mumbai, Dallas, Singapore, Sydney and London.

He also is an active mentor and investor in early stage start-ups through accelerators and
incubators. He has backed two online platforms that connect equity researchers and educators:
Researchbytes.com and Moneypot.in.

Over the years, he has been at the forefront in devising Go-To-Market strategies, Sales, innovation,
alliances, Entrepreneurship.

[more ][86]

Neeraj Gargi
Co-Founder & CTO

Neeraj is responsible for the overall IT operations at Intelegain with over 23 years of experience
in the IT industry. He has orchestrated Intelegain’s growth trajectory in Microsoft’s Dynamics 365
ecosystem across 5 World geographies.

As CTO, he has been overseeing business process driven technology improvements within the
organisation.

He has been mentoring and providing leadership to project managers, team leaders and grooming young
talent.

His acute business and technical acumen serves as the bridge and helps customers make disciplined
and proactive IT investment decisions.

[more ][87]

Shalini Chopra
Director, Human

# Leadership Team

Intelegain’s leadership spans countless years of experience in Management, Entrepreneurship,
Operations, Consulting, Technology Innovation, Software Implementation, and Business Strategy.
[Let's Talk][85]
Kapil Chopra
CEO

Kapil is a digital entreprenur having 25 years of experience in various roles such as CEO, founder,
investor and mentor. He has helped businesses grow and succeed in the digital space by providing
them with strategic guidance, marketing expertise, technology solutions and proactive leadership.

As CEO of Intelegain Technologies, he leads the vision and direction of the company across five
entities and locations: Mumbai, Dallas, Singapore, Sydney and London.

He also is an active mentor and investor in early stage start-ups through accelerators and
incubators. He has backed two online platforms that connect equity researchers and educators:
Researchbytes.com and Moneypot.in.

Over the years, he has been at the forefront in devising Go-To-Market strategies, Sales, innovation,
alliances, Entrepreneurship.

Co-Founder & CTO

Neeraj is responsible for the overall IT operations at Intelegain with over 23 years of experience
in the IT industry. He has orchestrated Intelegain’s growth trajectory in Microsoft’s Dynamics 365
ecosystem across 5 World geographies.

As CTO, he has been overseeing business process driven technology improvements within the
organisation.

He has been mentoring and providing leadership to project managers, team leaders and grooming young
talent.

His acute business and technical acumen serves as the bridge and helps customers make disciplined
and proactive IT investment decisions.

progressive HR practices in the areas of HR processes, staffing, resource deployment, compensation &
benefit, performance management, employee relations, learning & development, culture building,
employee retention at Intelegain.

In the past, she head the Human Resource division of a reputed Hospital managing HR processes,
staffing and performance management of over 500 employees.

# About

Medhealth Outlook serves as the backdoor to the latest technologies and trends in the healthcare,
pharma, and medical industries. The publication follows an inside/outside approach that allows
viewers to witness varied and balanced perspectives.

In presenting what we find through interviews, features, and stunning artwork, we endeavor to be
your inspiring source for print and online in-depth journalism covering the tech community powering
the medical industries. Medhealth Outlook

# About

Medhealth Outlook serves as the backdoor to the latest technologies and trends in the healthcare,
pharma, and medical industries. The publication follows an inside/outside approach that allows
viewers to witness varied and balanced perspectives.

In presenting what we find through interviews, features, and stunning artwork, we endeavor to be
your inspiring source for print and online in-depth journalism covering the tech community powering
the medical industries. Medhealth Outlook encourages readers to think extensively, lead with a
mission, embrace change, and shape the fate of the business.

Today, Medhealth Outlook’s releases enjoy a longer shelf life due to a plethora of articles, which
are not restricted by time or trends. Dismantling the old practices of the industries, the
publication is all set out to record how transforming organizations build and fight to highlight new
trade practices. The magazine also leads in showcasing how companies and individuals are
revolutionizing the future and rediscovering the business.

Medhealth Outlook is a leading independent media house, focused on fostering an engaged community,
and we want you to be a part of it. Let’s explore the possibilities!

# About

Medhealth Outlook serves as the backdoor to the latest technologies and trends in the healthcare,
pharma, and medical industries. The publication follows an inside/outside approach that allows
viewers to witness varied and balanced perspectives.

In presenting what we find through interviews, features, and stunning artwork, we endeavor to be
your inspiring source for print and online in-depth journalism covering the tech community powering
the medical industries. Medhealth Outlook encourages readers to think extensively, lead with a
mission, embrace change, and shape the fate of the business.

Today, Medhealth Outlook’s releases enjoy a longer shelf life due to a plethora of articles, which
are not restricted by time or trends. Dismantling the old practices of the industries, the
publication is all set out to record how transforming organizations build and fight to highlight new
trade practices. The magazine also leads in showcasing how companies and individuals are
revolutionizing the future and rediscovering the business.

Medhealth Outlook is a leading independent media house, focused on fostering an engaged community,
and we want you to be a part of it. Let’s explore the possibilities!

# TeamHealth: Elevating Post-Acute Care with Physician-Led Innovation

The healthcare landscape is undergoing a profound shift as post-acute care emerges as one of the
most vital components of the care continuum. With an aging population, the prevalence of chronic
conditions, and the increasing focus on reducing hospital readmissions, the demand for effective
care beyond the hospital walls has grown rapidly. Skilled nursing facilities, long-term acute care
centers, rehabilitation hospitals, and assisted living communities are now central to ensuring
patients transition safely and successfully from hospital to recovery. Yet, this sector faces
persistent challenges, from staffing shortages and fragmented care delivery to complex regulatory
demands. It is here that TeamHealth, one of the nation’s largest physician-led healthcare
organizations, is making a lasting impact.

Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee, TeamHealth has built a strong reputation
across a broad spectrum of services, including emergency medicine, hospital medicine,
anesthesiology, and behavioral health. However, its work in post-acute care is what underscores the
company’s vision of delivering seamless, patient-centered solutions across the entire care journey.
At a time when patients are most vulnerable—transitioning from hospital care into post-acute
settings—TeamHealth provides stability, consistency, and compassionate support through its
physician-led model.

At the heart of the company’s approach is the deployment of care teams directly into post-acute
environments such as skilled nursing and assisted living facilities. These teams—comprising
physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants—are embedded within the facilities,
ensuring that patients receive timely, on-site care. This not only improves outcomes but also
minimizes the need for disruptive and costly hospital transfers. With a focus on proactive
management, chronic disease control, and early intervention, TeamHealth is addressing the very
issues that often compromise patient recovery. The impact of this approach is seen most clearly in
reduced hospital readmissions. Preventable readmissions are not only a strain on healthcare costs
but also a significant source of distress for patients and families. By closely monitoring high-risk
patients, improving medication management, and collaborating with facility staff, TeamHealth’s
clinicians provide a safety net that helps patients recover more fully in the right setting.
Facilities that partner with TeamHealth report stronger performance across quality metrics, better
compliance with regulatory requirements, and higher satisfaction among residents and their families.

Beyond medical oversight, TeamHealth positions itself as a true partner to the facilities it serves.
The company provides guidance on navigating regulatory requirements, meeting CMS quality measures,
and preparing for the growing shift to value-based care. It offers operational support in
documentation, compliance, and quality reporting, empowering facilities to not only deliver care but
also to succeed in a changing financial landscape. By mentoring and educating nursing staff,
TeamHealth also strengthens internal teams, leaving facilities better equipped to sustain long-term
improvements in care delivery.

A distinguishing factor in TeamHealth’s model is its recognition of the critical role behavioral
health plays in post-acute care. Many patients in skilled nursing and long-term care facilities face
mental health challenges, including depression, anxiety, and dementia, which can complicate their
recovery. TeamHealth integrates behavioral health providers into its programs, delivering
psychiatric assessments, medication management, and therapeutic support. By treating both physical
and mental health needs, the company ensures that care is holistic, ultimately leading to better
quality of life and outcomes for patients. Technology also plays a role in extending the reach and
efficiency of TeamHealth’s services. The integration of electronic health records ensures that
patient data is accurate, accessible, and useful for informed decision-making across the continuum
of care. Telemedicine solutions further enhance access, particularly for facilities in rural or
underserved communities where physician availability is limited. Through virtual visits, patients
can connect to medical expertise quickly, avoiding unnecessary hospital trips and receiving timely
interventions.

What sets TeamHealth apart is the scale of its national network combined with a local focus. With
thousands of clinicians working across the country, the company brings unmatched expertise and
resources to post-acute care. At the same time, regional clinical leaders and medical directors
ensure that the solutions are tailored to the unique needs of local communities. This balance
between national strength and local customization is a hallmark of TeamHealth’s approach, ensuring
consistency without losing the personal touch that patients and facilities value.

The importance of effective post-acute care will only grow in the years ahead. Hospitals are under
continued pressure to manage capacity, and payers are tying reimbursements more closely to quality
outcomes. Patients, too, are increasingly demanding care that is seamless, compassionate, and
coordinated. Against this backdrop, TeamHealth’s physician-led, partnership-driven model positions
it as a leader in shaping the future of post-acute care. Its work extends far beyond simply
providing clinicians; it is building a system where collaboration, innovation, and accountability
are the foundations of better recovery.

From lowering readmissions and managing complex conditions to integrating behavioral health and
embracing telemedicine, TeamHealth is redefining what it means to deliver post-acute care. More than
filling a gap in the continuum, it is setting a new standard for how patients should be cared for
once they leave the hospital. As the post-acute care industry continues to evolve, TeamHealth’s
vision and leadership ensure it will remain at the forefront—advancing a model of care that is not
only clinically effective but also deeply human.

A Decade of Smart Wearable Innovation

Our state-of-the-art production facility in Shenzhen is equipped with advanced production lines and precision equipment, ensuring high-quality manufacturing standards. As an ISO9001-certified company, we maintain stringent quality control throughout the entire production process — from component sourcing to final shipment.

Over the past decade, Met Health has grown from a passionate R&D team into a globally recognized smart wearable manufacturer trusted by healthcare providers, distributors, and OEM partners across more than 50 countries. Our mission is simple: to harness technology in service of human health and dignity.

Production Capacity

We produce over 100,000 units per month, enabling us to reliably meet the demands of global markets at scale without compromising quality.

Supply Chain Advantage

Our strong partnerships with premium material suppliers ensure cost efficiency, stable inventory, and timely delivery for all client orders worldwide.

Customization Services

We offer comprehensive OEM/ODM services, providing fully tailored solutions — from hardware design to firmware — to meet each customer's unique needs.

Technology & Craftsmanship

We combine cutting-edge sensor technology with expert craftsmanship to deliver world-class wearable products that are reliable, accurate, and user-friendly.

Factory Showcase

State-of-the-Art Manufacturing in Shenzhen

Our Shenzhen facility represents the pinnacle of smart wearable manufacturing — combining precision automation, rigorous quality assurance, and a skilled engineering workforce to deliver products that exceed global standards.

Advanced R&D Laboratory

Our in-house R&D lab houses over 60 engineers dedicated to sensor innovation, firmware development, and next-generation health monitoring algorithms. New product cycles average just 90 days from concept to prototype.

Automated SMT Production Lines

Fully automated Surface Mount Technology (SMT) lines with high-speed pick-and-place machines ensure consistent component placement accuracy at sub-millimeter tolerances across every batch.

Multi-Stage Quality Control

Every product undergoes a 12-point quality inspection process including AOI optical inspection, functional testing, drop testing, waterproof validation, and final packaging verification before shipment.

Scalable Warehousing & Logistics

Our 8,000 m² warehouse facility supports rapid order fulfillment with integrated ERP and WMS systems, enabling real-time inventory tracking and on-time delivery rates exceeding 98.5%.

Eco-Conscious Manufacturing

Met Health is committed to sustainable production. Our facility uses energy-efficient equipment, lead-free soldering processes, and recyclable packaging materials aligned with RoHS and REACH directives.

Skilled Workforce

Our 500+ person workforce includes certified engineers, quality inspectors, and production specialists — many with 8+ years of experience in consumer electronics and medical-grade device manufacturing.

Why Choose Us

Three Pillars of the Met Health Advantage

From deep technical expertise to unmatched manufacturing flexibility, here's why global partners consistently choose Met Health as their trusted smart wearable manufacturer.

Expertise and Innovation

With over a decade of experience in R&D and manufacturing, we specialize in providing innovative wearable solutions, particularly in senior health management, disease monitoring, and personal safety. Our engineering team continuously pushes the boundaries of what's possible in miniaturized health sensing technology.

High-Quality Manufacturing

Our ISO9001-certified facility in Shenzhen is equipped with state-of-the-art production lines and precision equipment, ensuring consistent quality and reliability across all products. Every unit that leaves our facility has passed rigorous multi-stage testing protocols designed to meet international medical and consumer electronics standards.

Customization and Flexibility

We offer tailored OEM/ODM services, allowing us to deliver personalized solutions that meet the specific needs of our clients, supported by a strong supply chain for efficient delivery. Product Overview

Inositol (specifically myo-inositol) is a carbocyclic polyol that serves as the structural basis for
multiple secondary messengers in eukaryotic cells, including inositol phosphates and
phosphatidylinositol (PI) lipids. It is naturally present in various foods such as bran-rich
cereals, nuts, beans, and certain fruits like cantaloupe and oranges.

While often grouped with the B-vitamin complex (referred to as Vitamin B8), it is not technically a
vitamin as the human body is capable of synthesizing it.

**Key Biological Functions:**
* Signal transduction and Cytoskeleton assembly
* Nerve guidance (Epsin)
* Intracellular calcium (Ca2+) concentration control
* Cell membrane potential maintenance
* Serotonin activity modulation and Gene expression
* Breakdown of fats and reducing blood cholesterol
Clinical & Therapeutic Applications

**Psychiatric Conditions:** Research indicates that individuals with clinical depression often
exhibit lower inositol levels in cerebrospinal fluid. High-dose supplementation (e.g., 12 grams
daily) has shown significant improvement in symptoms for depression, panic disorder, and OCD with
minimal side effects.

**Metabolic Support:** D-chiro-inositol (DCI) is recognized for treating Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
(PCOS), helping address insulin resistance and hyperandrogenism.

**Hair Care:** Inositol is reported to strengthen hair cells and improve moisture retention, making
it a popular ingredient in oral supplements and shampoo formulations.

Product Description

Trans-zeatin is an endogenous plant growth regulator belonging to the purine plant cytokinin. It was
originally discovered and isolated from young corn cobs and has multiple biological functions.
Trans-zeatin has a chemical formula of C10H13N5O. It is a white to yellow powder (crystal) that is
insoluble in water but soluble in solvents such as 1M acetic acid, 1M NaOH, alcohol and DMF.
Trans-zeatin has two isomers, cis and trans. The trans isomer (trans-zeatin) has stronger biological
activity than the cis isomer.

[Trans-Zeatin 0.1%Sp]
**Key Applications:**
* Promotes callus germination (Concentration: 0.5-2.0 mg/L).
* Increases fruit setting rate (e.g., Jujubes) when used with GA3 and NAA.
* Delays leaf yellowing and promotes overall growth (20 mg/L spray).
* Promotes seed germination in various crops.

[AI & Intelligent Automation]
75% Reduction in Claims Denial
60–80% Reduction in Manual Processing Time

### AI & Intelligent Automation

OSP builds custom AI solutions that help healthcare organizations reduce claim denials, cut
administrative overhead, and accelerate reimbursements — turning complex financial and clinical
workflows into intelligent, automated operations.

[

#### AI-Driven Healthcare Software

We build custom AI systems that automate healthcare workflows and decisions.

][96] [

#### Generative
#### AI Consulting

We help you identify the right AI use cases and strategy.

][97] [

#### Custom Generative AI Development

Custom GenAI systems built for your healthcare environment from day one.

][98] [

#### Generative
#### AI Integration

We connect AI capabilities directly into your existing healthcare systems.

][99]
[Interoperability & Integration]
85% Reduction in Data Exchange Errors
3x Faster Cross-System Data Access

### Connected Healthcare Systems

OSP engineers secure, scalable interoperability solutions that connect disparate healthcare systems
— eliminating data silos, enabling real-time health information exchange, and giving your teams a
unified view of the patient across every platform they use.

[

#### HL7 FHIR API Development

Secure, compliant APIs that enable real-time data exchange between systems.

][100] [

#### EHR & Multi-System Integration

We connect Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, and more without disrupting workflows.

][101] [

#### Interoperability Strategy & Architecture

We design future-proof data exchange frameworks for healthcare enterprises.

][102] [

#### Legacy System Connectivity

We modernize legacy systems so they communicate with current platforms.

][103]
[Revenue Cycle & Healthcare Operations]
50% Reduction in Claims Denials
40% Faster Reimbursement Cycles

### Revenue Cycle & Healthcare Operations

OSP builds intelligent RCM solutions that reduce denials, automate billing operations, and give
healthcare finance teams real-time visibility from patient registration to final reimbursement —
engineered to improve cash flow and lower cost-to-collect.

[

#### AI-Powered Denial Management

We build systems that prevent denials and automate appeal workflows.

][104] [

#### Claims Automation & Processing

Automated claims solutions that reduce errors and accelerate clean submissions.

][105] [

#### Prior Authorization & Eligibility Automation

We eliminate manual follow-up with end-to-end authorization automation.

][106] [

#### RCM Analytics & Performance Reporting

Real-time dashboards that give finance teams full revenue cycle visibility.

][107]
[Digital Transformation]
60% Reduction in Operational Inefficiencies
200+ Healthcare Digital Transformations Delivered

### Digital Transformation

OSP partners with healthcare enterprises to modernize legacy systems, redesign clinical and
operational workflows, and build the digital infrastructure that makes long-term growth, compliance,
and innovation possible at scale.

[

#### Healthcare IT Modernization

We move healthcare organizations off legacy systems onto scalable infrastructure.

][108] [

#### Workflow Digitization & Redesign

We replace manual processes with connected, efficient digital workflows.

][109] [

#### Agile Healthcare Product Development

Custom healthcare software built fast, iterated often, delivered with precision.

][110] [

#### HIPAA-Compliant System Architecture

Every solution we build has compliance engineered in from the start.

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

[ See It In Action ][115]

# Our mission is to make *health* a daily practice.

Our journey began in Finland, and today, Oura is a part of the health journey for millions of users
in the US and around the world. Optimism is in our DNA - we see the opportunity for everyone to live
a balanced life. Oura is a product of meticulous craftsmanship, combining thoughtful design and
advanced technology to fit seamlessly into your life.

[Image of a woman looking out a car window]

10 years ago, we created a tool that seamlessly fits into your lifestyle, allowing you to
conveniently make your health your priority. Oura gives you unlimited access to accurate data and
information about your body, so that you can make more informed decisions, and lead a better,
healthier life. Our promise is that we will always meet you where you are– as you are– to help guide
you on your journey to discovering what’s within.

## The Oura *Difference*
* [Picture of a person holding a piece of fabric over their head]
* [Picture of a smiling person]
* [Picture of a person reading]

**5.5M+ Rings**sold worldwide.
**900+ Employees**across countries and continents.
**12+ Years**of research and product development.
**30+ PhDs**working across an in-house interdisciplinary science team.
[Picture of a person in a medical coat smiling]

#### Strict Data Protection

We are GDPR compliant and adhere to Europe's strictest data privacy laws. Data is de-identified and
protected.

[Picture of a person in a medical coat smiling]

#### Medical Advisory Board

Partnered with experts across the field to conduct research and advise in development of features.

[Learn More][6]

## Our Values

Not Me, We: Ubuntu

At Oura, we are one team. We each have a significant role to play–but we don’t win in silos. We know
in order to succeed, we must do it together. We embrace the diversity of our locations,
perspectives, and experiences to succeed as one company.

We Are Human First

Humanity is present in all that we do. We are passionate about building products that celebrate and
support uniqueness, inclusivity, and diversity. We meet people where they are, as they are, and
prioritize accessibility, by connecting with kindness and empathy.

Trust Matters

If we say we’ll do something, we do it. We always show up with integrity, and we prioritize privacy–
because it doesn’t just matter to us, but to you, as well. We do the right thing, even when no one
is looking. It is vital to us that our community and teammates know that they can rely on our
products, information, and perspective.

We Aim Higher

Good enough isn’t good enough—we want to be the best. We are bravely curious and optimistic about
our ideas for the future, and exploration is in our DNA. We act with courage, challenge the status
quo, take risks, and discover new. We execute with excellence.

We Find Solutions

We confront obstacles head-on. Even if we disagree, we share one common goal: solving the problem,
together.

#### Strict Data Protection

We are GDPR compliant and adhere to Europe's strictest data privacy laws. Data is de-identified and
protected.

[Picture of a person in a medical coat smiling]

#### Medical Advisory Board

Partnered with experts across the field to conduct research and advise in development of features.

[Learn More][6]

## Our Values

Not Me, We: Ubuntu

At Oura, we are one team. We each have a significant role to play–but we don’t win in silos. We know
in order to succeed, we must do it together. We embrace the diversity of our locations,
perspectives, and experiences to succeed as one company.

We Are Human First

Humanity is present in all that we do. We are passionate about building products that celebrate and
support uniqueness, inclusivity, and diversity. We meet people where they are, as they are, and
prioritize accessibility, by connecting with kindness and empathy.

Trust Matters

If we say we’ll do something, we do it. We always show up with integrity, and we prioritize privacy–
because it doesn’t just matter to us, but to you, as well. We do the right thing, even when no one
is looking. It is vital to us that our community and teammates know that they can rely on our
products, information, and perspective.

We Aim Higher

Good enough isn’t good enough—we want to be the best. We are bravely curious and optimistic about
our ideas for the future, and exploration is in our DNA. We act with courage, challenge the status
quo, take risks, and discover new. We execute with excellence.

We Find Solutions

We confront obstacles head-on. Even if we disagree, we share one common goal: solving the problem,
together.

We’re Personify Health. We’re the first and only personalized health platform company to bring
health, wellbeing, and navigation solutions together. Helping businesses like yours optimize
investments in their members while empowering people to meaningfully engage with their health.

Personify’s comprehensive platform equips all kinds of businesses (and people) with personalized,
connected, and powerfully simple health solutions.

[ Learn more ][81]

### We connect the disconnected

Our seamlessly integrated solutions mean a more delightfully simple experience for you and your
people. We give you everything from health care administration to care navigation to healthy
living—all in one place.

### We reject one-size-fits-all

We get to know your unique needs and goals so we can tailor solutions, services, and experiences
that meet them.

### We design to engage

We use science-backed methods to create engaging experiences that actually motivate people to manage
and sustain their health.

### We provide more ways to save

We empower our clients and their people to reduce or reverse high-costs while achieving better
financial and health outcomes.

What we do

## A new level of personalized health

Can you imagine a painless health management experience? We can. So, we’ve designed it. We offer
solutions for everything you need to support your people’s health—personalized health plan
administration, holistic wellbeing, and comprehensive navigation solutions. We help you boost health
and engagement while reducing stress and costs, building a new health reality for your people and
your business.

Whether you’re an employer, a health plan or system, or a broker or consultant working with a

Personify Health, we’ll take you from “this will do” to “this is it.”

Who we are

## Changing how healthy happens

Personify’s comprehensive platform equips all kinds of businesses (and people) with personalized,
connected, and powerfully simple health solutions.

[ Learn more ][81]

### We connect the disconnected

Our seamlessly integrated solutions mean a more delightfully simple experience for you and your
people. We give you everything from health care administration to care navigation to healthy
living—all in one place.

### We reject one-size-fits-all

We get to know your unique needs and goals so we can tailor solutions, services, and experiences
that meet them.

### We design to engage

We use science-backed methods to create engaging experiences that actually motivate people to manage
and sustain their health.

### We provide more ways to save

We empower our clients and their people to reduce or reverse high-costs while achieving better
financial and health outcomes.

What we do

## A new level of personalized health

Can you imagine a painless health management experience? We can. So, we’ve designed it. We offer
solutions for everything you need to support your people’s health—personalized health plan
administration, holistic wellbeing, and comprehensive navigation solutions. We help you boost health
and engagement while reducing stress and costs, building a new health reality for your people and
your business.

## We’re here—for all of you

Whether you’re an employer, a health plan or system, or a broker or consultant working with a
client, you deserve solutions that truly fit your needs—and the needs of the people you serve. With
Personify Health, we’ll take you from “this will do” to “this is it.”

We help you give your employees more (with less effort). This means you can make cost-effective
decisions based on real analytics and deliver on your health and wellbeing strategies.

## Our Pragmatic Approach to Software

We prioritize lean solutions to deliver value fast while optimizing costs. From the initial line of
code to final deployment, every decision we make is guided by empirical data and aligned with your
business objectives.

By leveraging proven standards and modern, repeatable processes (such as Scrum, Clean Code, and
Continuous Delivery) augmented by AI, we operate faster, more precisely, and efficiently. This
translates directly into lower effective development costs for your product.

## What We Do

[AI development]

#### AI

We automate the repetitive operational and decision-making processes currently blocking your
company’s growth.


We implement AI exactly where it reduces team workload, minimizes errors, and offloads your key
people.

[Cloud solutions]

#### Cloud

We simplify and stabilize your infrastructure so that scaling your product doesn’t mean scaling your
costs and risks.


We help companies escape legacy systems and operational chaos with zero business disruption.

[web development]

#### Web

We build web applications that are easy to scale and maintain without burning through your budget.


Our focus is on creating a stable architecture, not just a single, short-sighted release.

[UX design]

#### UX

We design user experiences to make your product intuitive and ensure it actually gets adopted.


We treat UX as a strategic tool to drive down your sales and customer support costs.

[Mobile development]

#### Mobile

We help companies launch and scale mobile apps without creating isolated tech silos.


We view mobile as a part of your product ecosystem, not an outlying piece of software.

[Product Management]

#### Product Management ⭐

We help companies decide what to build (and what not to) so that product development translates into
real business outcomes.


We merge strategy, technology, and execution into a single, unified decision process.

Catering to industries such as financial services, retail, insurance, healthcare, and gaming, Sauce Labs empowers teams to ensure robust application performance across various environments.

## Explore Sauce AI Agents: Ship with Confidence, Not Chaos.

Software engineers spend 20–30% of their time writing, maintaining, and fixing tests—slowing
releases, reducing productivity, and leaving less time to innovate and ensure quality at scale. Meet
Sauce AI Agents built on the Sauce Labs continuous quality platform. They automate test creation up
to 10x faster, run tests across any real or virtual devices in the cloud, pinpoint issues instantly,
and free developers to focus on innovation, not maintenance.

### Pricing Details

### ### Invoicing Information
###
### [chevron]

All credit card plans are charged at purchase and a corresponding invoice is available within an
hour in the primary account holder’s profile. Monthly credit card plans are automatically billed
monthly and can be canceled at any time without penalty. Annual credit card plans are offered at a
discount and charged up front the annual amount. Enterprise plans are invoiced annually in advance
net 30 days.

For other forms of accepted payments, please reach out to [sales@saucelabs.com][95].

### ### Virtual Device Cloud Plans
###
### [chevron]

All virtual platform plans include our complete desktop OS / browser combinations as well as access
to our mobile emulators and simulators. All VMs are spun up instantaneously and used only once for
your tests, offering the highest level of security. All accounts also include debugging tools, video
test playback and screenshots. Sauce Labs integrates with any language, framework and CI system. For
information on Enterprise Plans, please contact sales.

### ### Real Device Cloud Plans
###
### [chevron]

All Real Device Cloud plans include access to thousands of real Android and iOS devices as well as
usage of the open source automation tools Appium, Espresso and XCUITest. The issue report will help
you keep track of any issues identified including screenshots, logs, and video capabilities. For
information on Enterprise Plans, please contact sales.

### ### Upgrading/Downgrading Subscriptions
###
### [chevron]

You may change your subscription plan at any time. If you decide to upgrade your plan, it will take
effect immediately, and you will be refunded the remaining prorated amount of the old plan and
charged the prorated amount of the new plan. If you downgrade your plan, it will take effect on the
next billing cycle.

# TEST AUTOMATION ANALYTICS

## Sauce AI for Insights

**Cut through data noise and make confident decisions, faster. **

Remove bottlenecks, accelerate decision-making, and free your teams from data overload with your
dedicated AI agent for test analysis and continuous quality.

[ Request a demo][88]
[Data Sheet][89]
[SauceLabs dashboard showing test metrics with a popup comparing build durations through a bar chart
visualization.]

Software teams are under pressure to release quickly, but testing often creates more questions than
answers. Every build generates mountains of results, more logs, more failures. Leaders and
practitioners alike struggle to find the signal in the noise, and this delay slows releases.

## Challenges

[red customer experience icon]

### Engineering Distraction

Engineers are pulled away from high-value task to write and maintain repetitive test scripts.

[red results and data icon]

### Time-Consuming Analysis

Teams spend hours investigating flaky tests, device failures, and repetitive errors

[Red integration icon]

### Decision Bottlenecks

Without clarity into trends, releasing with confidence plummets

[Workflow icon red]

### Difficulty Shifting Left

Testing earlier in the cycle is tough without quick, reliable insights to guide the process

[Software interface showing job error rate analysis with graph trending upward to 9.50%, with
suggestions for improvement.]

## The Solution

Sauce AI for Insights is an AI agent designed to streamline software testing. It allows users to
identify the root causes of application issues using natural language, which eliminates the need for
tedious and time-consuming manual debugging. This ultimately enhances engineering efficiency, speeds
up release cycles, and ensures the delivery of high-quality applications.

Instead of grappling with your complex data, imagine asking simple questions to a dedicated AI
Agent: “Which devices are failing the most?” “Which tests are flakiest this week?” “Are failure
rates trending up or down?” Sauce AI for Insights makes this possible.

Sauce AI for Insights is like adding a test data analyst to your team - without needing to increase
headcount! Analyze test results in real-time to surface what matters most. Instead of cutting
through raw data, your team can simply ask questions in natural language about builds, devices, or
test stability and receive immediate, actionable answers.

Sauce AI for Insights FAQs

## Sauce AI for Insights FAQs

### ### What data do you use to train the model?
###
### [chevron]

The model is “off the shelf” with specialized customization using MCP tools and system prompts. No
additional data is required for training, as the system is designed to function effectively with the
built-in tools and processes available within the Sauce platform.

### ### How does the agent ensure regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)?
###
### [chevron]

All data privacy and access protocols are aligned with the same stringent policies and permissions
that govern the entire Sauce platform. This ensures compliance with applicable regulations.

### ### What are average time savings for teams using this agent?
###
### [chevron]

The AI agent can significantly reduce the time spent on manual investigation and analysis of issues.
Instead of sifting through complex logs or dashboards, teams can simply ask in plain language to
identify and surface issues, potentially saving hours or even days of manual effort.

### ### Which of our biggest business bottlenecks will this agent solve?
###
### [chevron]

Manually investigating web and application testing issues is a time-consuming process that can take
hours or even days. Sauce AI for Insights is designed to rapidly identify and surface these issues
by simply asking in plain language without sifting through logs or dashboards.

### ### How will it fundamentally change the day-to-day workflow of our employees?
###
### [chevron]

Shifting the focus from manual data analysis and reporting to strategic action and decision-making.
Sauce AI for Insights is an intelligent, conversational AI agent that transforms raw data into
immediate, tailored, and actionable intelligence.

### ### What level of data quality does the agent require to function effectively? If our data is
### ### messy or siloed, how much pre-work is necessary?
###
### [chevron]

Since the AI agent operates within the Sauce platform, it requires no additional pre-work beyond the
standard best practices for writing and executing tests. If your data is messy or siloed, following
these best practices will maximize the AI agent’s effectiveness.

### ### Can this agent handle our peak load? If we scale this solution across the entire enterprise
### ### or to thousands of customers, will the performance remain consistent?
###
### [chevron]

Yes, the AI agent is designed to scale seamlessly with the Sauce platform. Whether you're managing a
small team or scaling to thousands of users, performance and efficiency will remain consistent due
to the robust infrastructure behind the solution.

### ### What kind of training is required for our internal teams (business users)?
###
### [chevron]

Minimal training is required for business users. The AI agent is designed to be user-friendly and
intuitive, leveraging conversational language to simplify the process of generating insights.

# ERROR AND CRASH REPORTING WITH SAUCE ERROR REPORTING

## Mitigate crash rates. Fix errors fast.

Keep your apps stable and reliable. Easily mitigate crash rates by cutting issue resolution time in
half with automated data collection, error prioritization, and root cause analysis across multiple
platforms. Sauce Error Reporting does it all, so you can focus on shipping high-quality code.

[Learn more][89]
[Error-Reporting Hero Illustration]

### Features

## Capture, Prioritize, Resolve

Sauce Error Reporting lets you monitor, capture, prioritize and resolve application crashes across
all platforms, including mobile, clients, servers and game engines. Mitigate crash rates and deliver
a reliable user experience to your customers.

[Green finding and monitoring icon]

#### Crash monitoring and capturing

Process crash and errors from panics, core dumps, minidumps, and during runtime across your stack
with a single system. Aggregates events and generates structured, searchable error reports from your
data.

[Green analysis detection icon]

#### Querying and prioritization

Easily sort, dedupe and group error data with a rich query engine to find the issues causing the
most impact. View a high-level overview of error frequency while customizing prioritizations and
trends across all your projects.

[Green speed symbol icon]

#### Root cause analysis

Automated error analysis cuts down on time to resolution by surfacing important insights that lead
engineers to the root cause faster. Secure source code integration points you to the line of code
triggering the error and needs attention.
