# SAUCE AI

## Sauce AI for Test Authoring

Eliminate Test Bottlenecks and Accelerate Development

Stop wasting engineering time on brittle tests. Generate resilient, AI-driven tests in minutes so
you can ship faster.

[ Request a Demo][88]

### Manual Test Scripting Is Slowing You Down

Engineering teams are pressured to innovate quickly while maintaining high-quality standards, yet
manual test scripting and maintenance are a major roadblock to speed. Reliance on traditional
methods requires deep expertise, which slows product delivery and prevents a wider range of talent
from contributing to testing.

## Challenges

[Engineering Distraction]

### Engineering Distraction

Engineers are pulled away from high-value tasks to write and maintain repetitive test scripts.

[Rework Loop]

### Rework Loop

Minor UI changes break tests, triggering continuous cycles of repair and rework.

[Technical Skills Builder]

### Technical Skills Barrier

Deep coding expertise limits who can contribute to automation and slows test coverage growth.

[Slowed Feature Delivery]

### Slowed Feature Delivery

Unstable tests create unpredictable delays, reducing release velocity and team agility.

[Test Authoring with AI]

## The Solution

Sauce AI for Test Authoring eliminates the repetitive inefficiencies of manual test creation by
prioritizing user workflows over brittle code. Manual test scripts break with UI or platform
changes, constantly pulling engineers away from core development. By interacting with your
application the way a real user would, Sauce AI for Test Authoring generates stable, executable
tests in minutes, not days.

Because these tests are based on stated intent rather than a specific series of steps, they are
resilient to changes in the user interface and platform updates. Consequently, updates are only
necessary when the core application behavior itself changes.

Define a test once and run it across web, Android, and iOS using the same real devices, emulators,
and simulators you already use within the Sauce Labs platform, delivering unified, cross-platform
coverage without duplicated effort. For sensitive applications, secure tunnel support integrates
with your existing workflow, providing compliant testing in gated environments without added
complexity.

As your organization scales, Sauce AI for Test Authoring scales with you, ensuring maintenance never
becomes a bottleneck. When paired with AI-driven self-healing (coming soon), your tests
automatically adapt to UI changes, dramatically reducing manual intervention. The result is broader
coverage, higher quality, and sustainable velocity as teams grow.

## Sauce AI for Test Authoring FAQ

### ### What is Sauce AI for Test Authoring?
###
### [chevron]

Sauce AI for Test Authoring is an AI-driven test solution that converts user intent into stable,
executable test scripts in minutes without requiring deep coding expertise. It eliminates the manual
effort of traditional test scripting and reduces maintenance caused by UI changes.

### ### How does Sauce AI for Test Authoring reduce maintenance?
###
### [chevron]

Unlike traditional scripts that break when UI changes, Sauce AI for Test Authoring generates tests
based on user intent rather than rigid step-by-step code. This makes tests inherently resilient to
interface updates, maintenance is only needed when core application behavior changes, not every time
a button moves.

### ### Does Sauce AI for Test Authoring require coding skills?
###
### [chevron]

No. Sauce AI for Test Authoring is designed to eliminate the technical skills barrier in test
automation. QA teams, citizen developers, and non-engineers can all contribute to test coverage
without deep programming expertise, unlocking the full capacity of your team.

### ### What platforms does Sauce AI for Test Authoring support?
###
### [chevron]

Sauce AI for Test Authoring supports cross-platform test execution across, web, Android, and iOS.
Tests are authored once and run across real devices, emulators and simulators already available
within the Sauce Labs platform, eliminating duplicated effort across environments.

### ### How does Sauce AI for Test Authoring help engineering teams ship faster?
###
### [chevron]

By automating the test creation and maintenance process, Sauce AI for Test Authoring frees engineers
from repetitive scripting tasks and rework cycles caused by flaky tests. Teams regain capacity to
focus on building features, reducing time to market and increasing release confidence.

### ### Is Sauce AI for Test Authoring suitable for enterprise security requirements?
###
### [chevron]

Yes. Sauce AI for Test Authoring offers secure tunnel support that integrates with existing
enterprise workflows, enabling compliant testing in gated and restricted environments without adding
complexity.

### ### How is Sauce AI for Test Authoring different from traditional automation tools?
###
### [chevron]

Traditional test automation tools require engineers to manually script and maintain tests that
frequently break with UI updates. Sauce AI for Test Authoring interacts with applications the way
real users would, generating stable, intent-based tests in minutes rather than days, with resilience
built in from the start.

### ### Can Sauce AI for Test Authoring scale with my organization as it grows?
###
### [chevron]

Yes, Sauce AI for Test Authoring is designed to scale test coverage across platforms and
environments without a linear in cost or headcount. The AI handles complexity as your application
and team grow, ensuring test maintenance never becomes a bottleneck.

### ### What outcomes can enterprises expect from Sauce AI for Test Authoring?
###
### [chevron]

Enterprises using Sauce AI for Test Authoring can expect broader test coverage, reduced engineering
toil, faster releases cycle, fewer flaky tests, and higher release confidence, all without requiring
additional headcount or deep coding expertise across the testing team.

# REAL DEVICE CLOUD

## Secure mobile testing. Any device, anywhere, at scale.

Built for enterprise mobile quality at the pace of AI. Sauce Labs Real Device Cloud provides instant
access to thousands of real iOS and Android devices and a programmable, AI-ready infrastructure for
real device cloud testing at scale. With Sauce Real Device Cloud, development teams can test on the
widest range of iOS and Android devices that your users actually own — real iPhones, iPads, Samsung
Galaxy, Google Pixel, Xiaomi, and more, including the latest devices and OS betas — to ship the
mobile experiences customers love, with confidence.

## Why teams choose Sauce Real Device Cloud

### Ship quality apps, faster

Validate AI-generated code at scale sprint after sprint. Run automated testing across thousands of
real devices simultaneously, cut test execution time, and get meaningful feedback in minutes, not
hours.

### Eliminate the infrastructure burden

Reclaim engineering time for building, not maintaining. Device procurement, OS updates, and hardware
refreshes are all handled for you with fully managed testing infrastructure that grows as new
devices and OS versions become available

### Debug smarter with AI-powered insights

When tests fail, you need answers fast. Leverage deep mobile app diagnostics to surface root causes,
catch flaky tests, and resolve issues in minutes. Access detailed device logs, test results, and
crash reports so teams ship with confidence.

### Improved cost-efficiency

Using a real device cloud can help QA teams save on the costs associated with maintaining in-house
device infrastructure — physical device procurement, maintenance, and updates — which can be
capital-intensive and resource-heavy.

### REAL DEVICE ACCESS API

## Stop Choosing Between Control and Scale.

The Real Device Access API delivers the raw power of a local device lab without the hardware
maintenance.

Real Device Access API, **the industry’s first modern programmable mobile cloud**, provides
developers with deep, device-level control to accelerate AI-driven workflows. This
framework-agnostic approach unlocks custom use cases restricted by UI automation frameworks while
eliminating the drain of in-house device testing.

With low-latency device access at cloud-scale security, deep observability, and persistent session
models, teams can reclaim innovation time and build the future-proof foundation that modern mobile
engineering needs.
* **Remove Session Limitations:** Use session persistence to "own" the device state for up to 24
hours. Install your app once and run complex soak tests or security audits without wasting time on
cleaning cycles or reinstalls.
* **Debug Live, Fix Faster:** Tunnel directly into a failing device in real time. Step through code,
inspect the file system, and check logs without guessing from video replays.
* **Run Custom Frameworks:** Break free from rigid framework constraints. Whether it’s a specialized
gaming driver, a proprietary test engine, or a custom AI agent, the Access API supports it. If it
runs on a local phone, it runs on your private cloud.
* **Built for agentic AI workflows:** Explicit control of the device through the API allows
integration with AI-based, low-code, custom tool sets. Model Context Protocol (MCP)-ready
architecture and high-speed visual control surfaces let autonomous AI agents interact with real
devices as native tools.

Turn your private cloud into a programmable device lab and graduate from limited automation to
limitless infrastructure.

Available as an add-on with Real Device Cloud Private Devices.

Test failures that lack context just waste time. Sauce Real Device Cloud comes with the deepest

complete visibility into test failures, app performance, UI issues, errors, crashes, API and HTTP/S
capture, and more. Teams spend less time guessing at root causes and more time resolving them.

# INTELLIGENT SOFTWARE DEBUGGING

## Quickly find and fix bugs so you can focus on coding

Say goodbye to inefficient and costly application debugging. Sauce Labs Intelligent debugging tools
leverages data-driven analytics that empowers developers to efficiently find and fix software bugs.
Spending less time on fixing bugs means your developers can focus on coding, and even accelerate
their pace of releasing high quality software to customers.

[ Request a demo][88]
[Debugging tier 1 illustration]
[Error reporting concept illustration]

### THE CHALLENGE

## Debugging is critical, but it can be slow and frustrating.

The longer developers spend diagnosing and resolving software bugs and production errors, the less
time they have to code and deliver innovative digital experiences. Without the right debugging and
error reporting tools, your organization risks delayed release cycles, escaped bugs, increased
application risk, and longer resolution time - all of which impact both the user experience and your
bottom-line revenue. Sauce Labs can help.

[Media Image]

### THE SOLUTION

## Intelligent software debugging with Sauce Labs

Sauce Labs Platform for Test accelerates innovation by streamlining test automation, running
thousands of parallel tests and catching bugs before they reach production, all on a scalable
infrastructure with consolidated analytics that can reduce testing time by up to 90%. As a platform
component, our intelligent debugging tools let development teams prioritize critical bugs, and
quickly get to the root cause; remediating issues and reducing potential delays in releasing
software.

### WHY SAUCE LABS?

## Ship reliable web and mobile applications with minimal disruptions

[Green easy symbol icon]

### Debug across the SDLC

Sauce Labs is the only solution that provides tools like live testing, functional testing, and error
reporting to debug application software, from development to post-release.

[Green speed symbol icon]

### Spend less time finding and fixing issues.

Cut resolution time by up to 50% by quickly getting to the root cause of errors in your code and
test failures in the pipeline. You'll spend less time debugging and more time coding.

[Green customer experience icon]

### Leverage real-world user feedback

Get user-generated, real-time video sessions and in-app bug reports to solve issues, shorten release
cycles and release your app to market faster.

[Green growth icon]

### Remove bottlenecks and drive productivity

Accelerate root cause analysis with machine learning power failure analysis and proactively
eliminate the most costly patterns.

[Green control-confidence icon]

### Release quality applications with confidence–at speed

Catch bugs prior to release and surface errors across pipelines. Leverage context across
devices/OSes with actionable data to fix bugs and build better, more reliable applications faster.

[Green finding and monitoring icon]

### Identify bugs before your customers experience them

Reduce time to detect and resolve errors in production. Easily capture, prioritize and resolve
errors across all platforms. Have the data to filter the noise and get to the root cause faster.

# ACCESSIBILITY TESTING

## Accessibility Testing with Sauce Labs

The European Accessibility Act (EAA) mandates accessibility across several digital products and
services for businesses serving EU customers. How does accessibility testing improve how
organizations across the globe create accessible digital experiences to comply with the EAA, which
went into effect on June 28, 2025?

[ Contact us about accessibility testing][88]
[General image for accessibility on transparent background]
[Media Image]

### WHAT IS ACCESSIBILITY TESTING?

## Every Experience Counts in Accessibility

Accessibility testing helps you determine how well your websites and applications are suited for
people with disabilities. It is a subset of usability testing that considers users with and without
disabilities. In particular, it focuses on testing software, mobile apps, and websites.

[ Learn more ][89]
[4 tips to prep for the EAA]

### THE EUROPEAN ACCESSIBILITY ACT

## Get Ready for The European Accessibility Act

The European Accessibility Act (EAA) is a landmark law that defines the accessibility requirements
for everyday digital products and services that directly impact the lives of roughly 87 million
people living with disabilities–almost one in five Europeans.¹

These are just a few essential tips to help your business prepare better. For more information,
check our ebook Guide to the European Accessibility Act.

^{1 }[^{European Commission}][90]^{, European Accessibility Act: Q&A }

[ Check out our guide][91]
[Media Image]

## How Sauce Labs + Deque helps you achieve EAA compliance

Sauce Labs has teamed up with Deque Systems to enhance digital accessibility for web and mobile
applications, aiming to minimize compliance risks for organizations. This partnership allows
customers to seamlessly integrate accessibility testing into their quality assurance processes,
providing greater visibility throughout software development. The collaboration features an
enterprise-ready integration between Sauce Labs' Real Device Cloud and Deque's axe DevTools® Mobile
for Appium, enabling automated testing and delivering actionable accessibility insights through a
comprehensive test results dashboard.

[ More on this partnership][92]

### Benefits of Accessibility Testing

## Create an Equitable Experience

16% of the world’s population – that’s 1.3 billion people – experience significant disability. This
makes it even more imperative to design equitable digital experiences that serve everyone.

[Green team symbol icon]

#### Innovate with Inclusivity

By empathizing with the challenges faced by people with disabilities, designers and developers
create products that are not only accessible but also more intuitive and user-friendly for everyone.

[red easy symbol icon]

#### Improve Quality of Life

Inclusive designs allow people with disabilities to engage in everyday activities, access essential
services, enhancing their overall well-being.

### Benefits of Accessibility Testing

## Broaden Reach, Boost Revenue

The global disability community is expected to increase from ~1.5 to 3.5 billion people by 2050.
That’s a 130% increase.

[red health and wellness icon]

#### Enhance Customer Satisfaction

Accessible websites and apps provide a better user experience for everyone. When customers find your
services easy to use and navigate, they are more likely to return and recommend your brand to
others.

[Green analysis detection icon]

#### Stay Ahead of Your Competition

Companies that proactively adopt accessibility standards can differentiate themselves from
competitors, and foresight can enhance brand reputation and attract more customers.

### Benefits of Accessibility Testing

## Ensure Compliance, Reduce Risks

The EEA mandates that products and services within the EU must be accessible to all citizens,
regardless of disability.

[Red control-confidence icon]

#### Avoid Legal and Financial Costs

Non-compliance can lead to substantial legal and financial repercussions. Instead of fighting legal
problems, invest resources into building accessibility compliance for long-term benefits.

[Green security icon]

#### Future-proof your Business

As global awareness and regulations around accessibility continue to grow, companies that have
already integrated accessibility into their operations will be better positioned to adapt to future
changes.

## A complete solution for cross-platform game applicants

### Crash and Error Reporting

Sauce Labs Error Reporting (known as Backtrace) is a post-release insurance policy that captures
crashes, ANRs, and production errors after launch from any platform, including PC (Windows, macOS),
consoles (PlayStation, Xbox), and mobile (iOS, Android).

### Real Device Testing

Test on real devices, chips, and GPUs across diverse configurations with the Sauce Labs Real Device
Cloud (RDC) to proactively detect bugs and non-crash issues such as an input lag and UI occlusion.

### Mobile App Distribution for Version Control

Distribute app builds easily to ensure that everyone tests the correct version and eliminate build
version mismatches. Mobile App Distribution works seamlessly with Backtrace and RDC for complete
traceability from build to production.

### Smart Debugging and Insights

Sauce Insights with AI-powered root cause analysis helps developers debug test failures at scale.
Use the command-line execution, timestamp-synced video, and intelligent analysis to crack quality
thresholds above 90% and debug faster than competitors who offer only the testing infrastructure.

### AI-Powered Continuous Testing

Production data automatically informs new test case creation in development within Sauce Labs.
Integrate with synthetic AI players for 24/7 automated play testing with AI bots that "learn and
explore game environments. Eliminate developer crunch and discover edge cases human testers miss.

# ABOUT US

## Where DevOps teams come together to test smarter and faster

DevOps teams need to develop and release faster than ever before to meet the demands of today's
consumers. But they can't do it with yesterday's way of testing. The Sauce Labs Platform for Test
helps DevOps teams evolve their testing and error monitoring processes so they can develop, update,
and release market-leading web and mobile apps, faster.

[ Contact us][88]
[Media Image]

### AUTOMATED TESTING & ERROR MONITORING

## What is Sauce Labs?

Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind
Selenium and other major test frameworks. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial
institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only end-to-end AI platform
capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and ship assurance. Drawing from a
proprietary and growing dataset of 8.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to
bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality.

[ Learn more][89]
[Media Image]

### TEST. INTEGRATE. ACCELERATE.

## Why use Sauce Labs?

Today, every brand experience starts online. Ensuring that experience is as seamless as possible
comes down to working code. Which ultimately comes down to efficient product testing. But testing
hasn't evolved to keep up with the speed of product release. Product development teams often use
multiple tools for different aspects of the development lifecycle, which creates silos, bottlenecks
and slower development. Sauce Labs streamlines the product testing process with one do-it-all
service. It boosts development speed without sacrificing product quality - to improve user
experience and grow your business.

[ Contact us][90]

## Becoming a Sauce Labs partner

Sauce Labs offers partnership opportunities with organizations in the continuous testing, CI/CD,
DevOps, and QA ecosystem. Our goal is to provide development and QA teams with the test automation
tooling, knowledge, and expertise they need to succeed in their continuous testing journey.

### WHY BECOME A PARTNER

## Why partner with Sauce Labs

Sauce Labs has created the world’s largest cloud-based continuous testing platform for web and
mobile apps. We leverage open source frameworks to kick off automated tests on desktop operating
systems and browsers, mobile emulators, simulators and devices.

Support from a dedicated Alliance Manager to ensure a successful partnership

[red API icon]

Access to Sauce Labs APIs, development environment, and technical experts to optimize integrations

and other special programs

[red team management icon]

Access to a broad range of enterprise customers, with opportunities for joint selling

[red Sauce Labs logo icon]

Integration and association with the Sauce Labs brand and market-leading Sauce DevOps Test Toolchain

[red connect and collaborate icon]

Access to two types of engagements: the Sauce Labs Technology Alliance Partners (TAP) program and
Test Automation Consulting Partners

partners to create actionable integrations with the Sauce Labs Continuous Testing Cloud.

# ABOUT US

## Where DevOps teams come together to test smarter and faster

DevOps teams need to develop and release faster than ever before to meet the demands of today's
consumers. But they can't do it with yesterday's way of testing. The Sauce Labs Platform for Test
helps DevOps teams evolve their testing and error monitoring processes so they can develop, update,
and release market-leading web and mobile apps, faster.

[ Contact us][88]
[Media Image]

### AUTOMATED TESTING & ERROR MONITORING

## What is Sauce Labs?

Sauce Labs is the world’s largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind
Selenium and other major test frameworks. Trusted by 80% of the world’s top ten largest financial
institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only end-to-end AI platform
capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and ship assurance. Drawing from a
proprietary and growing dataset of 8.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to
bridge the gap between AI-driven code generation and enterprise-grade software quality.

[ Learn more][89]
[Media Image]

### TEST. INTEGRATE. ACCELERATE.

## Why use Sauce Labs?

Today, every brand experience starts online. Ensuring that experience is as seamless as possible
comes down to working code. Which ultimately comes down to efficient product testing. But testing
hasn't evolved to keep up with the speed of product release. Product development teams often use
multiple tools for different aspects of the development lifecycle, which creates silos, bottlenecks
and slower development. Sauce Labs streamlines the product testing process with one do-it-all
service. It boosts development speed without sacrificing product quality - to improve user
experience and grow your business.

[ Contact us][90]

# CAREERS

## Join the movement

We apply our passion for innovation to solve day-to-day software testing challenges. For us, leading
solutions doesn’t mean following the same old blueprint. We encourage our team to think differently,
test their potential, and change the future.

[ See openings][88]
[Careers page hero]

[quote]

I started at Sauce as a Product Intern and now I am a Principal Data Analyst! Sauce helped me

the ample opportunities to grow.

## Our values put people first

[Icon name=Easy, Color=white]

### Transparency

We collaborate in a trusting, safe environment. We share knowledge openly as a team to increase our
collective understanding and adapt our plans when needed.

[Icon name=Control-confidence, Color=white]

### Respect individuality

We celebrate inclusion of different perspectives and experiences. Together, we grow and learn as we
treat each other professionally while preserving our individuality (no strict dress codes here).

[Icon name=Growth, Color=white]

### Constant improvement

We’re committed to continual improvement, even if that requires radical changes. We’re not afraid to
try new things and support our employees in their professional and personal growth.

[ownership]

### Ownership mentality

We’re truly invested in our vision and our impact. We consistently act with our customers’ and
company’s best interests in mind. We take pride in our jobs and work hard but take time to recharge.

[Ideas innovation]

### Ideas over hierarchy

When confronted with challenging decisions, we brainstorm a wide range of possible solutions. We
test everyone’s proposals objectively, without regard to one’s title, so the best idea emerges.

## Benefits and perks

[red Sauce Labs logo icon]

### Workplace benefits

We have a number of interchangeable workplace benefits to defray costs associated with working where
you’re most comfortable, whether at home or in one of our global offices.

[red customer experience icon]

### Equity

We’re all owners at Sauce Labs. It’s why ownership mentality is a core value! Full-time employees
receive equity in the form of stock options.

[red health and wellness icon]

### Health and wellness

It’s important to take time to re-center and recharge. We offer virtual yoga and meditation classes,
and reimburse wellness-related expenses.

[red team management icon]

### Parental leave benefits

In addition to observing local leave of absence benefits, we provide new parents with additional
time off and a salary top-up so you can be present to support the needs of your growing family.

[red results and data icon]

### Workplace time-off policy

Our U.S. Saucers enjoy flexible time off, while full time international employees accrue a generous
amount of vacation time to use each year.

[red international icon]

### For our Canadian Saucers

We provide full employer paid extended medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents with
no grace period - you and yours are covered from day 1! We also have a generous RRSP matching
program.

[red international icon]

### For our U.S. Saucers

Health coverage includes medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents starting
on Day 1! Saucers also have 100% employer paid disability and life insurance. In addition, Sauce
contributes a 25% match of your 401(k) deferral.

[red international icon]

### For EMEA & APAC Saucers

Language learning offering: For our EMEA team members we offer 4 language classes per month through
an easy and flexible online platform.

## Interested in integrating with Sauce Labs?

Sauce Labs' open API makes it possible for teams to integrate their own tools with the Sauce DevOps
Test Toolchain. This is an option for both our virtual and real device clouds. To get started, take
a look at our documentation.

#### Virtual Cloud API

Easily access the Sauce Labs REST API over HTTPS, with standard HTTP methods and authentication, and
using JSON encoding for request and response data.

using JSON encoding for request and response data.

and maintenance, and the complexity of surfacing critical issues with millions of crash events in

data-driven quality delivery.

## Sauce AI for Insights

Sauce AI for Insights is your AI Agent for real-time quality intelligence and decision-making that
provides instant, context-aware answers complete with visualizations and direct links to relevant
test data. Anyone—from executives, developers, or QA—can ask questions in natural language to
uncover insights that traditional manual analysis can’t surface. It eliminates hours of manual data
sifting and turns overwhelming test and runtime data into clear, actionable insights that drive
better decisions at every stage of the development lifecycle.
* **Boost Engineering Efficiency: **Eliminate data overload and manual analysis. No set-up or
configuration required, users get instant access to AI-driven insights that cut through the noise
and surface what matters most.
* **Accelerate velocity of Innovation: **Real-time identification of issues like flaky tests, newly
failing builds, and cross-device patterns instantly, accelerating release cycles and
time-to-market.
* **Strengthened Risk and Compliance Management: **Comprehensive quality metrics, proactive defect
prevention, and consistent monitoring across the entire SDLC reduce escaped defects and rework
costs while ensuring regulatory compliance and application stability.

suite in minutes. It empowers engineering teams of all skill levels to leverage framework-agnostic

flaky tests, maintenance work, and quality gaps as your product evolves.

## A complete solution for cross-platform game applicants

### Crash and Error Reporting

Sauce Labs Error Reporting (known as Backtrace) is a post-release insurance policy that captures
crashes, ANRs, and production errors after launch from any platform, including PC (Windows, macOS),
consoles (PlayStation, Xbox), and mobile (iOS, Android).

### Real Device Testing

Test on real devices, chips, and GPUs across diverse configurations with the Sauce Labs Real Device
Cloud (RDC) to proactively detect bugs and non-crash issues such as an input lag and UI occlusion.

### Mobile App Distribution for Version Control

Distribute app builds easily to ensure that everyone tests the correct version and eliminate build
version mismatches. Mobile App Distribution works seamlessly with Backtrace and RDC for complete
traceability from build to production.

### Smart Debugging and Insights

Sauce Insights with AI-powered root cause analysis helps developers debug test failures at scale.
Use the command-line execution, timestamp-synced video, and intelligent analysis to crack quality
thresholds above 90% and debug faster than competitors who offer only the testing infrastructure.

### AI-Powered Continuous Testing

Production data automatically informs new test case creation in development within Sauce Labs.
Integrate with synthetic AI players for 24/7 automated play testing with AI bots that "learn and
explore game environments. Eliminate developer crunch and discover edge cases human testers miss.

Private devices in the Sauce Labs Real Device Cloud offer dedicated, reliable testing environments,
enabling organizations to achieve faster, secure, and scalable software delivery.

## The flexibility to combine public or private devices for web, hybrid, and native app testing.

While our private devices are ideal for customers who need 24x7 access to dedicated devices and
prioritized security, our public devices are ideal to increase test coverage cost-effectively, with
support for a wide range of thoroughly cleaned devices.

**Here are some good use cases for choosing available public devices:**
* Optimize test coverage cost-effectively
* Reproduce bugs on a selection of hundreds of iOS and Android devices
* Upload and spot check apps on devices you don’t have access to
* Share manual test sessions and devices across teams worldwide

****

**Benefits across Sauce Labs private and public devices:**
* A unified platform for testing across Android and iOS devices
* Support for both automated and manual mobile tests
* Support for popular test automation frameworks (Appium, Espresso, and XCUITest)
* Access to a team of experts to help you achieve your testing objectives
* Enterprise-level support and customer success

### REAL DEVICE ACCESS API

## Stop Choosing Between Control and Scale.

The Real Device Access API delivers the raw power of a local device lab without the hardware
maintenance.

Real Device Access API, **the industry’s first modern programmable mobile cloud**, provides
developers with deep, device-level control to accelerate AI-driven workflows. This
framework-agnostic approach unlocks custom use cases restricted by UI automation frameworks while
eliminating the drain of in-house device testing.

With low-latency device access at cloud-scale security, deep observability, and persistent session
models, teams can reclaim innovation time and build the future-proof foundation that modern mobile
engineering needs.
* **Remove Session Limitations:** Use session persistence to "own" the device state for up to 24
hours. Install your app once and run complex soak tests or security audits without wasting time on
cleaning cycles or reinstalls.
* **Debug Live, Fix Faster:** Tunnel directly into a failing device in real time. Step through code,
inspect the file system, and check logs without guessing from video replays.
* **Run Custom Frameworks:** Break free from rigid framework constraints. Whether it’s a specialized
gaming driver, a proprietary test engine, or a custom AI agent, the Access API supports it. If it
runs on a local phone, it runs on your private cloud.

company.name: Sauce Labs
company.description: Sauce Labs provides a cloud-based platform for automated testing of web and mobile applications, enabling developers to test their applications across various browsers and devices.

products.name: Sauce Web Testing
products.description: A platform for automated testing of web applications across multiple browsers and devices.

products.name: Sauce Mobile
products.description: A platform for testing mobile applications on real devices.

products.name: Sauce Performance
products.description: A tool for capturing and analyzing front-end performance metrics of web applications.

products.name: Sauce AI for Insights
products.description: Provides actionable insights about failure patterns and test trends to improve testing efficiency.

products.name: Sauce Error Reporting
products.description: Monitors and reports errors in applications to help developers quickly identify and fix issues.

all_classified.key_products: Sauce Web Testing; Sauce Mobile; Sauce Performance; Sauce AI for Insights; Sauce Error Reporting
all_classified.polished_summary: Sauce Labs is a leading provider of a cloud-based platform for automated testing of web and mobile applications, designed to help developers and QA teams deliver quality software continuously. Their core products include Sauce Web Testing for cross-browser testing, Sauce Mobile for real device mobile testing, Sauce Performance for analyzing front-end performance metrics, Sauce AI for Insights to enhance testing efficiency, and Sauce Error Reporting for real-time error monitoring. Catering to industries such as financial services, retail, insurance, healthcare, and gaming, Sauce Labs empowers teams to ensure robust application performance across various environments.

all_classified.company_summary: Scip AG is a leading provider of cybersecurity solutions and next-generation technologies, specializing in both offensive and defensive security services. With a strong focus on research and development, the company caters to a diverse range of clients seeking to enhance their cybersecurity posture through innovative strategies and comprehensive support. Based in Zurich, Scip AG is committed to delivering cutting-edge services that address the evolving challenges in the digital landscape.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do you offer custom software development solutions?

Of course! Custom software solutions are what we live and breathe. Our team is dedicated to crafting
solutions that perfectly fit each of our clients' specific needs, ensuring optimal functionality and
alignment with business goals.

### How do you ensure the security of the software you develop?

Ensuring software security is a top priority for us. We employ stringent best practices and
up-to-date protocols in our development process. Each piece of software undergoes rigorous testing
to safeguard against vulnerabilities.

### Can you help with both front-end and back-end development?

Indeed, we can. We have experts in both back-end and front-end development, allowing us to deliver a
holistic approach that ensures a smooth, efficient, and integrated software solution.

adept at seamlessly incorporating various services to enhance the functionality and efficiency of
your software.

you with post-launch marketing and promotion. Our specialists can help strategize and implement
effective marketing campaigns to boost your product's visibility and reach to your target audience.

### What AI software development services do you offer?

We offer a range of custom AI development services, including AI strategic consulting, generative
AI, machine learning, ChatGPT integration, and more.

unique challenges, and fuel growth. Our team's not afraid to push boundaries, delivering smarter,
future-ready solutions that set you apart.

all_classified.polished_summary: SensorTower is a leading digital market insights platform that provides comprehensive visibility into the mobile app ecosystem, digital advertising, and consumer behavior. By leveraging a global panel of consumers and advanced data processing techniques, the company delivers actionable insights on app performance, user acquisition, and advertising strategies, catering to a diverse range of clients including major brands like Activision Blizzard, P&G, and Spotify.

all_classified.company_summary: Sermo is a global medical community that connects over 1 million verified physicians and healthcare professionals, enabling them to share insights, seek second opinions, and engage in discussions about clinical practices. The platform offers opportunities for members to earn money through participation in paid medical surveys and research studies, while also providing access to a vast database of drug ratings and trusted educational content. By fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing, Sermo aims to enhance patient outcomes and support healthcare professionals in their practice.

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

There’s a reason that Sermo is the number one social network for doctors, and rapidly growing. The
community is designed to help you be the best physician you can be, by providing access to thousands
of patient cases and the largest [drug ratings][47] database in the world—featuring over 1.2+
million ratings! With Sermo, you can give your patients a superior standard of care, while growing
your professional network and taking your practice to the next level.

In addition to its physician-only network, Sermo now offers exclusive, separate communities for APPs
(nurse practitioners and physician associates) and for Pharmacists. These dedicated spaces provide
tailored experiences where members can collaborate, learn, and connect with peers who understand
their unique roles in healthcare—while still enjoying access to earning opportunities through paid
medical surveys.

**How can doctors use social networking sites like Sermo?**

Social media has become an essential tool for doctors to connect with patients, colleagues, and the
wider healthcare community. By leveraging social media effectively, doctors can enhance their
practice, improve patient care, and stay informed about advancements in the medical field. So it is
important for doctors to not only maintain a professional presence on social media but also use it
as a valuable resource for their profession. With proper use of privacy settings and adhering to
ethical guidelines, doctors can leverage social media to benefit both themselves and their patients.

Some of the key benefits of using social media for doctors include building a strong online
presence, sharing valuable health information, connecting with colleagues and peers, promoting their
practice, and staying updated on industry news and developments.

**– Sharing valuable health information:** social media can also be a powerful tool for doctors to
share valuable health information and educate their patients. Through blog posts, infographics,
videos, and other visual content, doctors can inform their followers about various health topics,
offer tips for maintaining good health, and dispel any myths or misconceptions.
– **Connecting with colleagues and peers:** social media provides a professional networking
opportunity for doctors to connect with colleagues and peers from all over the world. By joining
online communities or participating in discussions on social networking sites like Sermo and
LinkedIn, doctors can exchange knowledge and insights with fellow healthcare professionals. This not
only helps them stay updated on current medical practices but also allows them to collaborate on
research projects or refer patients to specialists.
**– Promoting their practice:** social media can be an effective marketing tool for doctors to
promote their practice and attract new patients. By sharing positive patient reviews,
before-and-after photos, or success stories on professional networking platforms, doctors can build
trust and credibility among their followers. This can ultimately lead to more referrals and
appointments.
**– Staying updated on industry news and development:** finally, social media allows doctors to stay
updated on industry news and developments in real-time. Many healthcare organizations, medical
journals, and professional networking associations have a presence on social media where they share
the latest research findings, updates on medical technology, policy changes, and other important
information that may impact a doctor’s practice.

Social media has revolutionized the way we communicate and connect with others, and doctors are no
exception. With the right approach and understanding, social media can be a powerful tool for
doctors to build their online presence, educate patients, connect with colleagues, promote their
practice, and stay updated on industry news and developments. By incorporating social media into
their professional lives, doctors can improve patient care and contribute to the advancement of
healthcare as a whole. [HCPs can try Sermo out today for free][48] – you might be surprised at what
you learn!

**How can doctors maintain patient confidentiality while using social media?**

Social media has become an integral part of our daily lives, including in the medical field. Doctors
can use social media to enhance their practice, connect with colleagues and patients, and stay
informed about the latest developments in healthcare. However, it is crucial for doctors to approach
social media with a clear understanding of its benefits and risks. By leveraging social media
responsibly, physicians can foster meaningful connections, educate their audience, and promote a
more informed and engaged patient community.

Doctors should always remember that while using social media, they are still bound by the same
ethical standards as in face-to-face interactions with patients. This means maintaining patient
confidentiality and respecting boundaries at all times. Additionally, doctors should be cautious
about sharing personal opinions

## Frequently Asked Questions

Can SmartClinix migrate existing patient data from our current DPC EMR?
Yes, SmartClinix supports secure and structured data migration from most DPC and traditional EMR
systems. Patient records, charts, memberships, appointments, and billing history can be transferred
accurately with minimal disruption. The onboarding team manages the entire migration process to
ensure a smooth transition.
Is SmartClinix HIPAA compliant for Direct Primary Care clinics?
Yes, SmartClinix is fully HIPAA compliant and built with enterprise-grade security protocols,
including encrypted data storage, secure user access, audit logs, and protected communication
systems to ensure patient privacy and regulatory compliance for DPC practices.
How detailed is charting in SmartClinix for DPC clinics?
SmartClinix provides comprehensive and flexible charting designed specifically for Direct Primary
Care workflows. Physicians can document SOAP notes, maintain long-term patient histories, manage
chronic conditions, track preventive care, create care plans, and record lab results and
prescriptions in a structured and efficient environment.
Does SmartClinix support image and document storage in patient records?
Yes, SmartClinix allows secure storage of clinical images, lab reports, prescriptions, radiology
reports, consent forms, and treatment-related documents directly within patient charts, ensuring
complete and easily accessible patient records.
What payment integrations are available for DPC membership billing?
SmartClinix supports seamless payment integrations for Direct Primary Care clinics by enabling
recurring membership billing, automated subscription payments, online payment processing, invoicing,
and secure transaction management to simplify cash-based revenue collection.
Does SmartClinix provide telehealth capabilities for DPC practices?
Yes, SmartClinix includes built-in telehealth functionality that allows DPC clinics to conduct
virtual consultations, schedule online appointments, perform remote follow-ups, and manage digital
prescriptions and documentation within a secure and integrated platform.
How long does onboarding take for a DPC clinic on SmartClinix?
Most Direct Primary Care clinics can go live within a few days to two to three weeks depending on
customization and data migration requirements. The SmartClinix onboarding team provides complete
setup, training, and workflow configuration to ensure a smooth and efficient launch.
Is SmartClinix suitable for single-physician and multi-location DPC clinics?
Yes, SmartClinix is designed to support both single-provider DPC practices and large multi-location
clinics by offering centralized patient management, operational visibility, scalable infrastructure,
and flexible workflow customization to match different practice sizes.
What records does the SmartClinix DPC EMR store?
The SmartClinix EMR stores comprehensive patient information including demographics, medical
history, clinical visits, treatment notes, memberships, lab reports, prescriptions, follow-up
records, and communication history, creating a complete longitudinal patient profile.
How does documentation work in SmartClinix for Direct Primary Care workflows?
Documentation in SmartClinix is designed to be simple and efficient, allowing physicians to create
structured clinical notes, use customized templates, document treatments quickly, generate
prescriptions, and manage care plans without administrative complexity.
Which treatments and services are supported in SmartClinix DPC?
SmartClinix supports preventive care, chronic disease management, routine primary care
consultations, lab coordination, remote monitoring, follow-ups, and wellness-based care services,
making it suitable for the full scope of Direct Primary Care delivery.
Is SmartClinix suitable for cash-pay Direct Primary Care clinics?
Yes, SmartClinix is specifically designed for cash-based and membership-driven Direct Primary Care
clinics by supporting subscription models, direct patient payments, transparent pricing structures,
and simplified operational workflows without reliance on insurance billing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What programs can I build with SmartClinix?

SmartClinix supports a wide range of programs including virtual hospitals, specialty clinics,
chronic care management, brain health initiatives, and national telehealth networks. Our platform is
highly configurable to meet the specific needs of different healthcare delivery models and
regulatory environments.

Does SmartClinix integrate with EPIC or Health-Worx?

Yes, SmartClinix offers robust integration capabilities with major EHR systems including EPIC,
Health-Worx, and other healthcare information systems through HL7, FHIR, and custom API connections.
This enables seamless data exchange while maintaining your existing infrastructure investments.

Is the platform compliant with NHI and CMS?

SmartClinix is designed to meet compliance requirements for both National Health Insurance (NHI)
systems and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) in the United States. The platform
includes comprehensive security controls, audit trails, and reporting mechanisms to support
regulatory compliance.

Can we localize for multilingual use?

Absolutely. SmartClinix supports full localization including interface translation, culturally
appropriate content, and language-specific resources. We currently support over 15 languages with
the ability to add more based on project requirements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about the SmartClinix platform

What makes SmartClinix different from other healthcare platforms?

SmartClinix is a comprehensive, AI-powered healthcare platform that integrates [EMR][50],
[telehealth][51], billing, and practice management into a single solution. Unlike other platforms
that offer piecemeal tools, we provide a complete ecosystem tailored to various medical specialties,
with specialty-specific clinical workflows and fast implementation.

How quickly can I set up a new virtual practice with SmartClinix?

Most virtual practices can be launched within 4 weeks, compared to the industry standard of 3-6
months. Our turnkey implementation process includes practice website development, EMR and telehealth
setup, billing configuration, and staff training—all coordinated by a dedicated implementation team.

Can SmartClinix accommodate both virtual-only and hybrid practice models?

Yes, SmartClinix is designed to support both virtual-only practices and hybrid models that combine
in-person and virtual care. Our platform’s flexibility allows providers to seamlessly transition
between care delivery methods while maintaining a consistent patient experience.

Does SmartClinix support specialty-specific clinical workflows?

Absolutely. SmartClinix offers customized clinical workflows for numerous specialties including
mental health, cardiology, nephrology, neurology, and more. Each specialty environment includes
specialty-specific templates, assessments, care pathways, and patient engagement tools.

How does SmartClinix help with billing and revenue cycle management?

SmartClinix offers comprehensive billing solutions including insurance verification, claim
submission and tracking, denial management, patient statements, and financial reporting. We support
both insurance-based billing and direct patient billing models with integrated payment processing.

## Benefits of Choosing Vue.js Development

Vue.js delivers a combination of performance, flexibility, and developer efficiency that makes it a
strong choice for both startup MVPs and enterprise-scale platforms. Each benefit below connects
directly to measurable development and business outcomes.

[Solutions for Doctors]

### Seamless Integration with Existing Systems

Vue.js is designed for incremental adoption, meaning it can be introduced into specific sections of
an existing application without requiring a full rebuild. This makes it ideal for modernizing legacy
frontends in stages, reducing both migration risk and upfront cost.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### Faster Time to Market

Vue.js’s single-file component structure, intuitive reactivity model, and comprehensive CLI tooling
reduce setup and feature delivery time compared to more opinionated JavaScript frameworks. Teams can
prototype, test, and ship production features faster without sacrificing maintainability.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Scalable Component-Based Architecture

Vue 3’s Composition API enables developers to organize logic by feature rather than lifecycle hook,
making large codebases easier to navigate, test, and scale. Components are reusable across views,
reducing duplication and accelerating development as your product grows.

[Solutions for Doctors]

### High-Performance Reactive UI

Vue 3’s overhauled rendering engine and Proxy-based reactivity system deliver faster virtual DOM
diffing and smaller bundle sizes than Vue 2. The result is a noticeably more responsive interface,
particularly in applications with complex, data-heavy UI layers.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### AI-Ready and Future-Proof Framework

Vue.js integrates cleanly with OpenAI APIs, streaming data feeds, and WebSocket-driven real-time
interfaces, making it a natural fit for AI-augmented applications. Our ChatGPT developers and Vue.js
engineers combine these capabilities within a single reactive frontend architecture.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Reduced Development and Maintenance Cost

Vue.js’s shallow learning curve, comprehensive documentation, and reusable component model lower
both initial build cost and long-term maintenance overhead. Its first-class TypeScript support in
Vue 3 further reduces production bugs and accelerates developer onboarding.

## Types of POS Software We Develop

We build every common POS form factor used in retail, restaurants, and hospitality. The choice
depends on your store layout, transaction volume, and connectivity environment.

[Solutions for Doctors]

### Cloud-Based POS Software

Cloud POS runs on remote servers and works in both online and offline modes. Stores stay operational
during outages and sync transactions once connected. Owners can access analytics, reports, and
inventory from any device. The model fits multi-store retailers, restaurant chains, and franchises.

[Solutions for Hospitals]

### Mobile POS Software

Mobile POS turns smartphones and tablets into full point-of-sale stations. Staff can take orders,
accept payments, and update inventory from the floor. Our [Odoo development][83] team also builds
Odoo-based mobile POS for distributed teams. The build supports both iOS and Android.

[Solutions for Nutritionists]

### Terminal POS Software

Terminal POS combines a fixed register, receipt printer, cash drawer, and customer display. The
setup suits supermarkets, full-service restaurants, and pharmacies. We build terminal POS that runs
offline and syncs when the network returns. Hardware integration covers most major terminal
manufacturers.

[Physiotherapy Center]

### Self-Service Kiosk POS Software

Self-service kiosk POS lets customers order and pay without staff assistance. The format works for
QSRs, cinemas, parking lots, and retail self-checkout. We build kiosk software with accessibility
features and multi-language support. Each kiosk syncs orders to the kitchen or fulfillment system in
real time.

[Medical Firm]

### Tablet POS Software

Tablet POS suits cafes, juice bars, salons, and small retail stores with limited counter space. The
hardware investment is lower than a full terminal setup. Our team builds tablet POS for iPad and
Android tablets. Offline mode keeps the service running through internet drops.

[Yoga & Gyms]

### Online and Web POS Software

Web POS runs in a browser and centralizes data across all retail channels. The model suits
eCommerce-first brands adding physical retail. The setup requires no installation on store devices
and supports any operating system. Pop-up stores and seasonal events benefit from rapid
browser-based deployment.

## Software Methodologies We Use to Develop Enterprise Software

[Scrum]

Scrum

We utilize Scrum because of its core characteristic of adaptability. Our software team breaks your
project into “sprints,” focusing on high-priority tasks first. By having your regular feedback, we
refine the software to match your evolving needs. Basically, Scrum lets us adapt swiftly, improving
productivity and keeping you involved throughout the enterprise software development process.

[Agile]

Agile

With Agile, we place you at the core of the development process. Agile facilitates us to deliver
early and frequently working software. We adapt to changes even in the late stages. This approach
yields enterprise software that meets current requirements and market trends. During development, we
ensure to have frequent communication which is key to our Agile practice for mutual understanding
and driving your business success.

Waterfall

For software projects with stable and well-defined requirements, we choose the Waterfall method.
With the Waterfall structured approach, we outline a clear sequence of steps from initial
requirement gathering to final delivery. Each phase is fully completed before the next begins,
providing a clear roadmap and predictability. Despite being traditional, Waterfall offers a
well-defined structure, making it a trusted choice for projects with stable parameters.

# Our Story & Mission

Our journey with Sprout began with a simple idea: to help parents through life's biggest milestones.
Experiencing the joys and challenges of parenthood ourselves, we knew parents could benefit from
easy-to-use, reliable apps and tools. Today, our award-winning apps support millions of families
worldwide.

wellness tracking. With no accounts required and a commitment to data security, our apps provide the
support you need, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your family.

### Privacy First

We believe in giving users full control over their data. Our apps do not require an account, and we
never sell your personal information.

### Ease of Use

Our apps are designed to be intuitive and simple, so you can focus on your family without the
frustration of complicated tools.

### Support at Every Stage

Whether you're tracking pregnancy, baby's milestones, or your health, we offer tools for every stage
of your family's journey.

### Family-Centered

As parents ourselves, we understand the importance of having reliable tools to help manage health
and caregiving with ease.

### Want to work with us? Let’s talk.

From app sponsorship, co-branding partnerships to new app development and strategic advice, there
are plenty of opportunities!
We'd love to talk to you and see what's possible.

## Our Approach to AI Learning

story-building and adaptive assessments, ensuring that each story is not only enjoyable but also
educational

Children input their preferences and prompts, which ChatGPT uses to create the story's plot and
language level. MidJourney simultaneously works to create illustrations based on the story's themes,

story, reading or listening as they prefer, with illustrations and narration enhancing the
immersion. After the story concludes, an adaptive assessment tests comprehension, with instant
feedback fostering a loop of reading and learning.

In this way, we provide a comprehensive educational tool that adapts to the needs of young learners.

## Solving the Puzzle

Our solution, a gamified tournament app specifically designed for the EdTech industry and targeted
towards teens, creatively addresses the challenge of engaging students in educational content
through gaming.

The app allows students aged 13 to 18 to enter a world where their gaming skills help them learn and
succeed academically. Utilizing mobile technology, cloud-based backends, and interactive learning
modules, the platform transforms traditional educational content into exciting gaming tournaments.
Students earn points by participating in quizzes that are styled as mini-games, covering a range of
subjects aligned with their school curriculum. These points can be used to unlock advanced levels in
the game or enter more prestigious tournaments, offering both knowledge and entertainment

## The Roadmap

Our VR-based educational solution, Voyage Lens, reinvents the way students learn about history and
culture. By leveraging VR technology, along with interactive maps and AI-driven narratives, we offer
a learning environment where history becomes an engaging story to explore, rather than just facts to
memorize.

Students begin by entering their interests and what they hope to learn, setting the stage for a
personalized exploration. They are then taken on virtual reality tours of historical sites, where
every corner turned is a lesson waiting to be discovered. Alongside the VR experience, interactive
maps provide a broader context, enabling students to visualize geographical connections. After each
tour, students engage in quizzes and activities designed to test their comprehension, with real-time
feedback to help reinforce their learning

Thus, through personalized, immersive experiences, students not only learn but also connect with
history on a deeper level, fostering a lifelong curiosity and appreciation for the past.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

# Get to know WebMD Ignite

We're revolutionizing the healthcare ecosystem by driving action, championing education, and
connecting at every touchpoint along the health journey.

## Empowering decisions.
## Igniting action.

WebMD Ignite is the only full-service, healthcare-specific growth partner for health organizations,
healthcare professionals, providers, and payers. We help guide people to better health at all stages
of their journey.

Our comprehensive expertise and breadth of capabilities create seamless, personalized health
experiences that anticipate individual needs, empower action, and optimize outcomes. The result is
enhanced brand reputation, deeper loyalty from consumers and healthcare providers, and increased
lifetime value and demonstrable ROI for our clients.

## Formed from a family of leading brands

WebMD, the most trusted online healthcare information provider, lets us reach more than 90% of the
U.S. population and 2.2 million healthcare providers.

Medscape is the leading online global destination for physicians and healthcare professionals
worldwide, offering the latest medical news and expert perspectives.

Vitals is a trusted healthcare resource that provides tools and information to consumers, enabling
them to find the right doctor and schedule an appointment.

[pulsepoint logo]

Pulsepoint is our programmatic advertising exchange. It provides real-time analytics, giving our
clients greater flexibility to reach qualified audiences.

Its core services include personal banking for individual consumers, investment management for individuals and institutions, and tailored financial services for small to large businesses, including commercial and corporate banking. By focusing on the unique needs of its diverse clientele, Wells Fargo aims to foster financial growth and stability within communities.

# **Universal Fiber Splitter**

**NEW 3-in-1 Configurable Fiber Splitter!**

The Westell Universal Splitter, available in 1x32 and 1x64, brings added flexibility to your fiber
deployment needs. The Universal Splitter can be configured in 3 different configurations to allow
easy installation into existing fiber deployments.

• Module capable of configuration in 3 different mechanical variations

• Flexible design  

• Low insertion loss

• Wide operating wavelength  

• Outside plant rated

[Universal Splitter Series: 3-in-1 Configurable Fiber Splitter][105]

# **NEW! 96 Channel, Compact 2.5W BDA**

**Westell introduces the CS45 Series 2.5W ProtectLink BDA**

This Class A/B BDA includes 700/800 MHz dual-band support and 2.5W output power with a built-in
annunciator featuring additional auxiliary alarms. 

ProtectLink includes a full-featured, easy to use web GUI, adjustable bandwidth filters, intelligent
oscillation management, built-in isolation test, and NFPA / UL2524 alarm capabilities. The CS45
Series 2.5W BDA supports 96 total enabled channels. 

Westell’s ProtectLink public safety BDAs are an integral part of any NFPA complaint ERCES (Emergency
Responder Communication Enhancement System). 

[Lightweight UL2524 CS45 Series 2.5W BDA][106]

# **UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz ****Public Safety ****Fiber DAS**

**Westell^{®} ProtectLinkV2^{™} Fiber DAS HE and RE Fiber DAS**

Westell’s ProtectLinkV2 (PLV2) Fiber DAS Headend (HE) and Remote End (RE) allow for fiber
connectivity for UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz with public safety BDAs and ORUs, and they provide fiber
to RF conversion and communication between the headend and remote units.

PLV2 Fiber HE can support fiber connectivity for up to four remotes with single mode fiber
connecting an existing BDA to the PLV2 HE.

[UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz Fiber DAS][107]

# **Get TPA Protection with 5G Network Ampacity!**

Introduced earlier this year into a market straining to meet the needs of 5G network buildouts, the
NPTPA400D8-ST had quickly become a standard by providing a telecom fused disconnect of DC power to
active equipment from the central office to remote shelters.

[[NPDCB400VK, TPA High Density Panel Vertical Input Kit]][108]Now, the enhanced NPTPA400D8-ST-V
option includes vertical adaptors for input terminals for top-down input cable installation. This
new option eliminates the need to plan for the input cable bend radius while allowing maximum cable
size (maximum power) to connect to the panel.

[NPTPA400D8-ST High Density TPA Protection Panel][109]

# **Universal Fiber Splitter**

**NEW 3-in-1 Configurable Fiber Splitter!**

The Westell Universal Splitter, available in 1x32 and 1x64, brings added flexibility to your fiber
deployment needs. The Universal Splitter can be configured in 3 different configurations to allow
easy installation into existing fiber deployments.

• Module capable of configuration in 3 different mechanical variations

• Flexible design  

• Low insertion loss

• Wide operating wavelength  

• Outside plant rated

[Universal Splitter Series: 3-in-1 Configurable Fiber Splitter][105]

# **NEW! 96 Channel, Compact 2.5W BDA**

**Westell introduces the CS45 Series 2.5W ProtectLink BDA**

This Class A/B BDA includes 700/800 MHz dual-band support and 2.5W output power with a built-in
annunciator featuring additional auxiliary alarms. 

ProtectLink includes a full-featured, easy to use web GUI, adjustable bandwidth filters, intelligent
oscillation management, built-in isolation test, and NFPA / UL2524 alarm capabilities. The CS45
Series 2.5W BDA supports 96 total enabled channels. 

Westell’s ProtectLink public safety BDAs are an integral part of any NFPA complaint ERCES (Emergency
Responder Communication Enhancement System). 

[Lightweight UL2524 CS45 Series 2.5W BDA][106]

# **UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz ****Public Safety ****Fiber DAS**

**Westell^{®} ProtectLinkV2^{™} Fiber DAS HE and RE Fiber DAS**

Westell’s ProtectLinkV2 (PLV2) Fiber DAS Headend (HE) and Remote End (RE) allow for fiber
connectivity for UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz with public safety BDAs and ORUs, and they provide fiber
to RF conversion and communication between the headend and remote units.

PLV2 Fiber HE can support fiber connectivity for up to four remotes with single mode fiber
connecting an existing BDA to the PLV2 HE.

[UHF, VHF, or 700/800 MHz Fiber DAS][107]

# **Get TPA Protection with 5G Network Ampacity!**

Introduced earlier this year into a market straining to meet the needs of 5G network buildouts, the
NPTPA400D8-ST had quickly become a standard by providing a telecom fused disconnect of DC power to
active equipment from the central office to remote shelters.

[[NPDCB400VK, TPA High Density Panel Vertical Input Kit]][108]Now, the enhanced NPTPA400D8-ST-V
option includes vertical adaptors for input terminals for top-down input cable installation. This
new option eliminates the need to plan for the input cable bend radius while allowing maximum cable
size (maximum power) to connect to the panel.

[NPTPA400D8-ST High Density TPA Protection Panel][109]

# 3PL Logistics Provider Improves On-Time Delivery to 97% with AI Route Optimization

## About the Client

The client is a mid-tier third-party logistics (3PL) provider managing **over 25,000 shipments per
week** across regional and national transportation networks. The company serves a diverse portfolio
of retail and manufacturing customers that rely on predictable delivery timelines and cost-efficient
freight movement.As shipment volumes grew, the logistics provider struggled to maintain carrier
utilization efficiency and delivery consistency. Route planning relied heavily on manual processes
and fragmented systems, limiting the company’s ability to optimize fleet capacity and respond to
real-time disruptions.To improve operational efficiency and scale transportation planning, the
company partnered with **Zymr** to implement a **modern Transportation Management System (TMS) with
AI-driven route optimization and real-time shipment visibility**.

## Key Outcomes

On-Time Delivery Improved from 82% to 97%
19% Reduction in Transportation Spend

## Business Challenges

The logistics provider’s transportation operations relied on legacy planning tools and manual route
allocation. Dispatch teams had limited visibility into carrier availability, shipment routing
options, and delivery performance metrics.This often resulted in inefficient route planning,
underutilized carrier capacity, and delayed deliveries during peak shipping periods. Customers also
lacked real-time shipment visibility, leading to frequent service inquiries and operational
inefficiencies.As shipment volumes continued to grow, the company needed a more intelligent
logistics platform capable of optimizing routes dynamically, improving carrier utilization, and
providing customers with transparent shipment tracking.The organization required a scalable system
capable of managing increasing transportation complexity while maintaining cost efficiency and
delivery reliability.

## Business Impacts / Key Results Achieved

Zymr helped the logistics provider transform its transportation operations into a data-driven
logistics network. By introducing AI-powered route optimization and real-time shipment visibility,
the company significantly improved delivery performance and operational efficiency.
* **On-Time Delivery:** Improved from **82% to 97%**
* **Transportation Costs:** **19% reduction** achieved
* **Carrier Utilization:** Improved efficiency across routes
* **Shipment Visibility:** Enhanced tracking and transparency for customers
* **Business Growth:** **$200M in new contracts** won through improved service levels

## Strategy and Solutions
* **Transportation Management Platform Implementation**
Zymr implemented a scalable transportation management platform designed to optimize routing
decisions and improve shipment visibility across the logistics network.
* **AI-Based Route Optimization**
Machine learning algorithms analyzed route options, delivery windows, and carrier capacity to
generate optimized transportation plans.
* **Modern Transportation Management System (TMS)**
Implemented a centralized TMS to manage shipment scheduling, carrier allocation, and delivery
performance monitoring.
* **Real-Time Shipment Tracking**
Enabled end-to-end shipment visibility through live tracking and automated status updates.
* **Customer Self-Service Portal**
Provided customers with real-time delivery insights, shipment tracking, and reporting
capabilities.
* **Scalable Cloud Infrastructure**
Built the platform on cloud infrastructure to support increasing shipment volumes and peak
logistics demand.
